Thurs. May 18, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 2-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainer from Customer Service

Thurs. May 18, 2000

Hello again friends. Mike here for the weekly Pokémon chat. Pat is at a meeting and will join us in an hour or so. But first some MAJOR rules announcements. After R&D talked with Creatures Inc. in Japan last week, some rules changes (or corrections) that we need to pass on to you. First, for Ditto. R&D has reversed their ruling on Ditto Transforming into Mysterious Fossil or Clefairy Doll. When Ditto as-one-of-these-Trainer-cards is Knocked out the attacking player does NOT get to take a prize card. Many of you initially figured this out and R&D ruled differently. Well now, they are ruling it as you thought. Since Ditto is copying the Mysterious Fossil, it copies EVERTHING from it, including the text that says when it is knocked out the other player does NOT draw Prize.

Now for Devolution Spray. Devolving a Pokémon DOES count as evolving it (again, a reversal on a previous ruling). This means that if you use Devolution Spray on one of your Pokémon you CANNOT evolve it again on that same turn. Sorry if these rule changes are confusing. It just shows again, how nothing is set in stone when it comes to Pokémon. And lastly I would like to thank the two people who have sent in Weedle cards for the Space Weedle so far.

A big thank you to Evil Bob and to Koribouros for sending me a Weedle card for the upcoming Space Weedle. Thanks guys! So if you TOO want to be a part of Space Weedle history, please send your extra Weedle cards to Master Trainer Mike c/o Wizards of the Coast PO Box 707 Renton, WA 98057. Please sign the front of the Weedle card and when we get enough we will build the Space Weedle and get pictures of it up on the web for you. If we get enough cards in time you may also see it at the Super Trainer Showdown and other events in the future as well.

  48. Will you ever bring a huge league from Wizards Of the Coast To Green Bay Wisconsin?
    The league is already there…just check your local Toys R Us, Zany brainy, or Waldenbooks to see if they have one. If they do, sign up at one of those stores.

  49. Your opponent Mulligans and you draw 2 more cards, one of which is a basic Pokémon. Can you make that Pokémon your starting active Pokémon, or can you only start with one from the original 7 cards you were dealt?
    Since you haven’t laid down the cards yet for play…it is still technically part of your turn…so the answer is yes.

  50. How can I obtain a Prerealse Dark Gyarados can you send me one?
    You can check to see if your local league location still has those to give out. They were originally given out when TR came out.

  51. Do you have to be invited to play at any of the Super Trainer Showdowns (apart from LA) or can you just show up?
    You can just show up…but make sure you have obtained at least 3 badges.

  52. I know that in Japan, Here Comes the Rockets was really rare. Is it also rarer than other cards in America?
    No, in our set it’s no more rare than Dark Gyrados(holo).

  53. Can you evolve a base set Charizard on a Dark Charmelion?
    No you can’t…once you go to the dark evolutions, the next forward evolution must be the Dark Charizard.

  54. If I were building a deck, could I have 4 Dark _ and four-base/jungle/fossil __? I have been told both yes and no.
    Yes you could, my friend.

  55. Will Jigglypuff #7 cards be released through the league? the cards were poorly advertised and very few people knew about them.
    No.

  56. Say Ditto is copying an Abra, and I attach a pluspower to my Abra, then use Psyshock, then it becomes paralyzed, would the Ditto still be alive?
    If Ditto’s copying a Base Set Abra, he’ll be knocked out by that attack.

  57. If you attached a PlusPower to a Pokémon (for this, Scyther) and then Scoop Upped it (yes, a very dumb person), what would happen to the PlusPower?
    It goes to your discard pile.

  58. If I use Scyther’s swords dance and on my next turn I get paralyzed asleep or confuse but I full heal, will I be able to use the slash attack for 60?
    Yes.

  59. Why do the evolved rockets cards only say dark?
    They were trained by Team Rocket that’s why.

  60. The ed1 l16 Pikachu, was it randomly inserted as a common, uncommon, or rare?
    I don’t know, the person I traded for one, didn’t remember what slot it was in.

  61. If you have 2 Jungle Mankeys in play, can you use their Pokémon Powers (Peek) together, to look at the top 2 cards in your deck, or would they just let you look at the top card twice.
    You could only look at the top card twice.

  62. Referring to the Ditto on Porygon. If Ditto’s Weakness were changed to Grass, When Scyther gets bringed, Wouldn’t Ditto’s Weakness be changed into Fire?
    Nope, Ditto is still the active Pokémon and Conversion won’t end until the converted Pokémon is benched. We’ll double check on this one too, I understand that it’s kind of confusing.

  63. Can you have only 1 basic Pokémon in your deck?
    You could…but your opponents would have a field day with you unless you got a very lucky draw. Mulligans…bad…for you.

  64. If you made a Dark Raichu, Why isn’t there a Pikachu in Team rocket expansion>?
    Don’t know…it wasn’t in the original Japanese set so we didn’t print it…I think there are enough Pikachu’s in the previous sets.

  65. Can you retreat with a full bench?
    Yes, you’ll just exchange your active with a benched Pokémon.

  66. If your Mr.Mime is paralyzed then on your opponent’s turn can he knock it out with 40 damage, Or does it become unparalyzed and the Pokémon Power is back on?
    He would get knocked out because his Pokémon power is ineffective when Mr. Mime is paralyzed

  67. Is the Eevee going to be released via the Pokémon league?
    Yup, season 7.

  68. Are your coins weighted or something? They land on heads a lot more than tails?
    Not for me they don’t…gosh, I wish I had your luck?

  69. I’m planning on making a Haymaker Deck, What cards do you recommend I insert into my new deck?
    Here’s the basic Pokémon necessary for Haymaker decks: 4 Scythers, 4 Hitmochans. From there, trainers customize according to what other decks are popular in their area. I’ve used Jigglypuff/Wigglytuff before, but now I use Electabuzz and Pincer.

  70. Tournament question: I play an unsanctioned tourney every weekend, but I’d like to get ranked. Is there any way I can start a sanctioned tourney, or get a League location to start one?
    Sure, check out the DCI sanctioning section on our website for more info.

  71. Can Rocket Magikarp’s Rapid Evolution be used on the first turn it is put down, by placing 3 energy with Rain Dance?
    No, Rapid Evolution still counts as evolving, so you can’t do it the first turn you put down Magikarp.

  72. Will the Gym Leaders Set have the gym leaders picture on it in the US version?
    That is what I imagine will happen.

  73. How many English cards out so far including Promo’s?
    About 350, not including the duplicates in Base set 2

  74. Will there ever be any tours in Canada?
    Unsure of that one but I would certainly think so we haven’t forgotten about our good neighbors from the North.

  75. Will any of the Base and Jungle cards left out of Base Set 2 ever be reprinted?
    Many already have such as Porygon in the Team Rocket.

  76. Does Ditto’s HP stay the same or change to the defending Pokémon’s HP, and does resistance and weakness change?
    Weakness/resistance changes, so does the HP when Ditto becomes another Pokémon

  77. Does Ditto’s attack copy the effects like paralyzing, asleep etc?
    If the attack of the Pokémon he’s copying has those effects, so will Ditto.

  78. If you use a plus power then Prof. Oak, would the then ready to attack, would the plus Power still be there? Or, would you have to discard it if you attached it to you active, then professor Oaked, then attacked?
    If the active Pokémon that you attached Plus Power to is still your active after your Oak, it will still be in effect.

  79. If you go first, are you allowed to win the game before your opponent has a chance to have a turn?
    Yes I suppose so.

  80. In the TR Meowth, its attack says “don’t apply weakness and resistance for this attack”. Why put this text in when Meowth is a colorless Pokémon?
    It’s possible that a card that we expect to print in the future may effect the type of a Pokémon in play.

  81. In response to #137 – Mr. Mime would NOT be knocked Invisible Wall would be back on, since Mime is no longer paralyzed after its players turn!
    Yeah. You are right I think I misread the question my apologies.

  82. Does my serious Fossil still count as a basic Pokémon when in the discard pile?
    No.

  83. Can you retreat if your Pokémon is poisoned and asleep?
    You can’t retreat, but you can play switch.

  84. Will there be something after you get the earth badge and tms and the stickers and certified coach in league?
    I have been told that Wizards is working on something for people who have all the badges.

  85. Why not make an internet contest, to see who can make the best theme deck, and have the winner’s theme deck made?
    Possible, we’ll suggest something like that.

  86. What’s going to happen about Misty’s tears because some people say she is naked on that card?
    That will be interesting won’t it I seriously doubt she will look naked.

  87. My opponent plays a Challenge, and I accept. I place a Charmander on my bench. He ends turn. It is now my turn. Can I evolve Charmander into Charmeleon, or do I have to wait until my NEXT turn to evolve?
    You can evolve Charmander because he wasn’t played -that- turn.

  88. I’m trying to make a Wigglytuff deck and I need to know what Pokémon are good for backup. Can you help me?
    Anything, that allows you to get more Pokémon, on your bench.

  89. Can you evolve a dark Charmeleon into a Charizard?
    Nope.

  90. Any chance for Base Set 3?
    No.

  91. Will the fossil cards ever go out of print and/or will the foil be changed?
    Yes, but the foil will stay.

  92. When did you stop making first ed. team rocket boosters?
    3 days after we started printing it.

  93. What holographic cards are in the Team Rocket decks?
    Dark Weezing and Dark Arbok.

OK, if we didn’t get to your question, save it for next week or give us a call on the Pokémon hotline 1(800) 324-6496. We’ll check on those rulings for you by next week. So long, campers. See ya dudes next week!

Click on each spoiler to view entire log:

Thurs. June 1, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 2-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers from Customer Service

Thurs. June 1, 2000

Hey Trainers, it’s been a slow week as far as Poke-news is concerned. I just have some rulings from R&D for you from issues you asked about last week, so I’ll post those now and on the hour. Once again, MT Galen will be helping me out.

OK, here are all the rulings I double-checked on for you from last week.

Q: Can energy that has been changed to Fire energy with Charizard’s Energy Burn be moved by TR Charmander’s Gather Firepower?
A: Yes, energy changed in this way will be Fire energy till the end of the turn, you can use TR Charmander’s power to move this energy.

Q: If you attach a Plus Power to your active Pokémon and then retreat and then advance that Pokémon, will the Plus Power still be in effect?
A: Yes, it will.

Q: If you use TR Porygon’s Conversion 1 to change a Ditto’s(copying TR Porygon) weakness to Grass and then you retreat TR Porygon and advance a Scyther, will the converted weakness still be in effect on Ditto?
A: Yes, any effects of attacks on Ditto will remain.

Q: Can Ditto(copying a Gengar) repeatedly retreat and advance so that he can do Gengar’s Curse over and over?
A: Yes, every time Ditto advances and copies Gengar he can activate the Curse power.

On to the chat!

  1. If you didn’t win a tournament to enter the STS is there another way to get in besides the contest?
    Yes, if you have earned at least 3 Pokémon League badges you can get in.

  2. How do I get the Computer Error sticker?
    I know there’s a Computer Error promo card . . . does the sticker signify that you’ve earned it? Anyone?

  3. On Dark Golbat, when it says “Apply Weakness and Resistance”, well, at the end of the last sentence it has no space after the period, and before “Apply”. Why was that not on the misprint page?
    Is that the unlimited Dark Golbat? Because my Dark Golbat says “Don’t apply weakness and resistance.”

  4. Any chance for Base Set 3?
    There’s always a chance where Wizards is concerned but I have heard no such plans to do so.

  5. Will the holofoil on Fossil cards be changed?
    They’ll stay the same.

  6. Are the edition 1 cards on your website corrected from errors?
    Probably not…the misprints will probably be there.

  7. Are you going to make the vending sets?
    No news on that one yet, sorry.

  8. Will Fossil ever go out of print?
    Yes, eventually.

  9. Any more information on Cool Porygon in the league?
    No news on how that will be released, we just know that it will be available at some point.

  10. Any more info on the Gym Sets?
    Gym one is supposed to be released in August…that is about all we know.

  11. What will the Gym Sets be called?
    The first one will be called Gym Heroes, I don’t know about the second.

  12. If you use a plus power on an attack that does 0 damage, will it do 10 damage? Like for example, Kangaskhan’s fetch will it do 10 damage with a plus power?
    No, Plus Power will only add 10, if damage is done. Fetch doesn’t do damage.

  13. At the TCG Tour we were told that only people who qualified at the Tour could participate in the STS. However, on previous chats we were told if you had 3 or more badges you could participate. Which one is correct or are both correct?
    Both statements are correct actually. Earning 3 badges counts as qualifying.

  14. Last week it was ruled, that if Ditto is against a Pokémon that has a “once-per-turn” Pokémon Power. Say, Gengar – and Ditto rotates out to the bench and then back up, it can use that “once-per-turn” Pokémon Power a second time during the same turn (or more, if he continues to do so). If you used Gust of Wind to drop the opposing Gengar back to the opponent’s Bench, the then brought him back up again to the Active slot with another GoW, would Ditto now also be able to use that “once-per-turn” again?
    R&D has said that benching Ditto in this situation would allow you to use Curse again, so I would imagine that the inverse is true as well. If you send the opponent’s Gengar back to the bench and then move him back up when Ditto’s still active, you could do Curse again.

  15. If you have a Promo Eevee in play, and your opponent evolves up into an Aerodactly, how does that resolve? Since you can use Eevee’s Chain Reaction during your opponent’s turn if he evolves, can you use it “before” Aerodactyl’s Power goes into effect, or are you prevented from using Chain Reaction? Or, as I suspect, is it like Rapid Evolution in which Aerodactyl doesn’t enter into the equation since you’re not technically “playing” an evolution card?
    You’re not technically ‘playing’ and evolution card with Eevee’s Chain Reaction.

  16. Some attack text, such as Harden, Stiffen and Withdrawl, say that they prevent damage done on the opponent’s next turn, but do not reference, where the damage is coming from. Will these prove effective against things such as a failed coin flip from Digger, which does 10 damage to the losing Pokémon?
    So it means anything on the next turn of your opponent so yes it would prevent that damage.

  17. Last week, you said that Energy Burned Energies remain as such even if Charizard is put to Sleep that same turn (say, as the result of a failed Long Distance Hypnosis coin flip). However, looking back through some previous rulings, you said a month or two ago that if Charizard is paralyzed, etc. then the energies revert to their normal type. Which is correct?
    The energies will remain Fire energies until the end of the turn, even if Charizard is put to sleep. Certainly, some of our rulings may change as R&D corrects or reverses older rulings.

  18. Scenario: you have an Active Ditto with, say, 2 Fire, 2 Grass and 1 Water energy on him, and he is opposite a Dark Charizard. He could do Continuous Fireball and flip five times, since all energies attached to Ditto count as all types (including Fire). However, for each heads he gets, he has to discard a Fire Energy. So let’s say he gets three heads out of the five flips – does he have to discard the two Fire Energies first, and then one of the others, or can he discard the two Grass and 1 Water instead? Or do you state “which” energy card you are flipping for when you flip, and discard that specific one when and if it’s heads?
    Because Ditto’s energies count as any type when they are attached to him…you could choose which energies you discard by the amount of heads you flipped

  19. To show proof that you have 3 or more badges MT Pat told me in an e-mail to bring those badges and my DCI number. All of my family member’s DCI numbers are not in the system. One registered in Oct. 99, another in Jan. 2000 and I, on April 1st.
    I’ve been told by the person setting up the STS that trainers should bring their badges and DCI #, if you’re not in the system yet(as far as the DCI #'s are concerned) don’t worry about it.

  20. If you attach a plus power to Scyther and then retreat for Hitmonchan and do jab, will Hitmonchan do 30 instead of 20?
    Plus Power will stay attached to the Pokémon you put it on. It will not be in effect for the Hitmochan.

  21. Do you have a copy or know the formula used for computation of the best performing winners at the TCG Tour? Can this formula be posted somewhere?
    No we don’t, sorry.

  22. So if I understand your announcement correctly, Energy changed and then moved, remains changed for the rest of your turn?
    For the rest of that turn.

  23. You mentioned the ruling with Plus Power; would the same apply to other attached cards, such as Defender?
    The correct interpretation is that it is attached to the Pokémon you put it on not necessarily attached to the active slot per se. Sorry for the mistake guys I goofed.

  24. What are the movie promos?
    According to the Warner Bros. website the promos will be: Ancient Mew, Articuno, Zapdos and Moltres.

  25. Can Ditto change to any Mysterious Fossil or Clefairy doll. If so, is the ability copied?
    Ditto can copy either of those cards, but since Ditto can’t evolve, you won’t be able to use those cards to their full ability.

  26. Say, just a clarification for the record: ALL of Ditto’s abilities related to Transform are functional ONLY when he Active, including the “Rainbow” effect of attached energies, correct?
    As far as I know, yes.

  27. Concerning Rainbow Energy, the card states that when Rainbow Energy comes into play it deals 10 damage to the Pokémon it’s attached to. Does this 10 damage take place the one time it comes into play, or take place every turn?
    No you just take 10 damage when it comes from your hand and you put it on…it does no damage after words

  28. Will hard to get promos like cool Porygon & Jigglypuff be reissued at a later date?
    Cool Porygon I know will be released in some other way, but I don’t think this will be the case for Jigglypuff.

  29. Just for clarification - If I use Mew’s De-evolution beam on my turn against my opponents active Pokémon, can he re-evolve it on his turn? I don’t see why he can’t as his turn is a different turn than the turn I did de-evolution beam on.
    Yeah totally you could evolve him on your turn.

  30. If Dark Charizard is confused and tries to attack with Continuous Fireball, what is the exact procedure (assume the confusion flip is tails)?
    Flip a coin to see if the attack is successful due to confusion. If it’s tails, do 20 damage to D.Charizard.

  31. At the TCG Tour I came across some people who roll a die instead of flipping a coin for status effects. Is this legal in a DCI sanctioned event? I mean the card says to flip a coin, not roll a die. The die is OK actually just as long as it has someway of doing a 50/50 chance for heads or tails you would need to somehow designate which numbers represent heads and which ones represent tails.

  32. Is Digger’s damage considered an “attack”? (If Haunter is damaged by Digger, does Haunter’s Transparency require another flip? Will Defender protect against damage caused by Digger?)
    No.

  33. Can you tell me anything about availability of promo #11?
    Not yet only that it is going to be in the league next season (season #7).

  34. Concerning Clefable’s Metronome, can I metronome Dark Charmeleon’s Fireball attack when I have energy other than Fire on Clefable?
    No.

  35. What other ideas do you have for use for extra common cards not needed?
    Maybe decorate your car with them. Give them to charity. You see Pat is the good guy

  36. What is a good number of Gyarados’s to have in a deck?
    I would say 2 or 3 personally.

  37. My Toys 'R Us I go to in Durham, NC, just gives away the promo cards (I’ve gotten about 6 prerelease Gyarados, 3 Arcanine, 3 holo mew, and 25 non-holo Mew). Is that legal?
    Sure, but now everyone knows where you get your promos!

  38. The Pokémon DCI ratings have not been updated in over 6 weeks. When will they be updated?
    Dunno, try e-mailing the DCI@wizards.com

  39. Can you put more than 5 Pokémon on your bench by using the Challenge! card since it clearly says you can pick any amount of Pokémon?
    No because you only have five spaces on your bench.

  40. Pojo.com has a rumor that Dark Raichu had the error corrected, has it been fixed?
    Not that we know of.

  41. Can the Gym Leaders request more copies of the forms for Brock’s and Misty’s Challenge?
    I don’t see why not. Have them call our merchant services department at 1-800-821-8028.

  42. The Dark Golbat has no space after the period. It says “Dark Golbat does 10 damage to that Pokémon. Apply Weakness and Resistance.” See no space after the period, before “apply”?
    Gotcha, it must be on the unlimited version. I don’t know how they’ll rule on that one. Dang it, you gave me homework again!

  43. Why are you not allowed to tell us about the movie promos when Wizards already advertised them?
    Simple answer: we didn’t advertise them, WB did. We just weren’t told that WB made the info available that’s all.

  44. Concerning Clefable’s Metronome once again this time in relation to Hydro Pump (or similar attacks), since the initial energy is considering to cover the costs for the attack, if I have 2 Water Energies in excess of that first energy, will the Hydro P?
    Hydro pump specifies what kind of energy (water) you need to do excess damage so you would have to put extra (water) energy on Clefable in order to do more damage.

  45. What Rocket misprints have been corrected?
    I don’t know of any that have yet, though I know that the correction process has been started for a few cards.

  46. How do we get the promo 11 Eevee?
    Eevee will be available through the league during season number 7.

  47. When will we be able to get Eevee in the Pokémon league?
    Season 7

  48. If you make a first edition booster pack why don’t you make a first edition Theme Deck?
    All the Theme Decks are pre-constructed. They are geared more towards the game-player rather than the collector.

  49. Does smokescreen carry over if the person retreats or dies on that turn? For example, If fossil Magmar kills Oddish and the opponent brings up Gloom, does the opponents still have to flip?
    Smokescreen goes away, when the Pokémon affected retreats or dies or evolves so the upcoming gloom would not have to flip the smokescreen would not be in effect.

  50. Do you have to flip for an attack like fetch if the attack doesn’t do any damage?
    You mean if Kangaskhan is confused? Yes, you would.

  51. When using Raichu’s agility attack it states that if heads Raichu will not receive damage until after the opponents turn. If Raichu is poisoned and then gets heads will he take damage from poison at the end of his turn?
    Yes, Agility is referring to effects of attacks on Raichu during your opponent’s next turn.

  52. Referring to the question regarding Ditto and “once-per-turn” Powers: if Ditto can use said powers multiple times in the same turn if the opponent is Gusted out and back, is it because Ditto “resets” himself somehow when he Transforms? If so, this seems at odds with status effects, which are not lost when Ditto Transforms into a new Pokémon. Unless I’m just missing something, along the line here.
    No, Ditto doesn’t ‘reset’, but if he Transforms from Gengar to Ditto to Gengar, that second Gengar will be considered a ‘fresh’ one as far as the ‘once-per-turn’ use of Curse.

  53. If I attach a plus power to Dark Wartortle, and use Mirror shell, and the defending Pokémon does 20 damage to Dark Wartortle, does Mirror Shell do 20 or 30 damage back?
    No, the Plus Power will be removed at the end of your turn, so it won’t be in effect for the Mirror Move.
    It will do 20.

  54. If you really do plan to put Fossil out of print, about when will Fossil be out of print?
    I haven’t heard any dates on that.

  55. How does a store get to order Wizards of the Coast products to sell. My family started up a store recently and we’d like to know?
    Contact Wizards of the Coast Merchant Relations, call us and press the extension for ‘retailers’ for the phone number.

  56. Is there any new info on rules, tournament format (Elimination or Swiss)or other new details for the Super Trainer Showdown on July 22nd?
    No information about this yet, sorry. I think people are still working on what they want to do…at least I hope they are.

  57. Why did Giovanni put himself on the cover of a Pokémon card wrapper in a set called Team Rocket without revealing to the Pokémon league that he’s the team rocket leader. The Pokémon league will take away his gym. What was he thinking? Does he have a bigger ego then common sense?
    Nope, just an ego worthy of comparison to Ken Griffey Jr.'s

  58. When playing a rainbow Energy on a Pokémon, the 10 damage still occurs even if a Defender is played on that Pokémon, correct?
    Defender states that it only defends against damage done by attacks since that is not an attack the damage would be done if the Rainbow was played out of the hand on to the Pokémon in question.

  59. When playing a rainbow Energy on a Pokémon, will Mr. Mime’s Invisible Wall prevent that damage or not?
    No it would not.

  60. Will the movie promos be given to each group of people or for how many number of tickets are bought will determine the number given. It would stink it if was one per group because my little brothers will probably fight right their in line.
    We can’t say right now Haymaker but I am sure there will be some consideration to that request.

  61. When will the league web page be updated?
    Dunno.

  62. If you put defender on a Pokémon that has just been attacked by a Gastly with destiny bond will the defenders have any affect?
    The defenders won’t have any effect because Destiny bond has no value to the damage it does it simply knocks out the defending Pokémon.

  63. All my Dark Golbats say “Apply”, but it sounds like you have one that says “Don’t apply”. Please confirm for the masses. Thanks.
    Both of the ones I could find here say, “Apply weakness and resistance.”

  64. What was the reason for the 2.99-3.29-price hike?
    Costs associated with printing and producing the cards.

  65. If there are 4 Snorlax on a bench, won’t that break the bench?
    Probably, but not in the game, for the Bench is just the place where they wait to battle and not actually a real bench you might have a picnic on.

  66. To qualify for the 7/22 tournament, you need 3 badges correct? Does the league pretest badge count?
    No, only the 8 main badges count.

  67. Are we supposed to charge kids to join Pokémon League?
    That’s entirely up to the store you can choose to charge or you can choose not to.

  68. I’m a Gym Leader and I received Misty and Brock stickers and sheets, but NO instructions on using them. How do they work?
    Give us a call at Customer Service and we’ll try to get an answer for you.

  69. Why must the cards be released separately, it’s a pain the wallet for families, because kids want all the cards and parents won’t hear the end of it unless they get all the cards?
    Which cards do you speak of senior Haymaker?

  70. Nothing in my instructions said the kids can only earn Holo Mews during one season, but I heard that’s true. Is it? I still have lots of kids with stickers, and quite a few mews.
    You have authority to continue letting kids earn those if their wasn’t specific instructions prohibiting this.

  71. I’ve seen reference to “signing up for next season”. What does that mean? I thought they fill out DCI card once, get a book, then that’s it. They come when they can.
    Well, you should still keep a sign-up sheet so you only sign-up as many people as you can handle.

  72. Can you play if most of your Pokémon cards use colorless attack if I don’t have any colorless cards?
    Well colorless attacks mean that you can use any color of energy to activate that particular attack you don’t just need the double colorless energy to use those attacks.

  73. Below dark Raichu’s left foot, there is a ‘blob’ of something - is this a error or damaged card? Or are they all like that?
    I don’t know. I’d have to see the card.

  74. Is the Brock and Misty challenge coming to Canada? Our league never seemed to get it?
    I imagine that you’ll get those activities eventually.

  75. My league location temporarily shut down. Will they replace the promos they missed?
    That depends if your League organizer continued to order the League kits.

  76. My brother tried to play a deck with no Pokémon at the super trainer showdown qualifier, but the deck check lady said it was illegal. I see no where in the rules where it says its illegal and a master trainer told me on chat that it was ok too.
    If you don’t have any Pokémon in your deck the game will never start. If you want to make a deck like that, you’re welcome to, but, be prepared to get kicked out of a lot of tournaments.

  77. Will Dark Raichu be legal for international tournaments?
    I think it will depend on how fast the distribution goes for the Rocket Cards internationally.

  78. Is 0 damage still damage? My friend said that his Hitmonchan with 2 plus powers on it did 20 damage, but I said NO. What’s the ruling?
    No, 0 is not damage. Hitmochan with 2 Plus Powers on it and no energy, will do 0 damage.

  79. Why doesn’t WotC put a price on the wrapper like $3.29 in the corner so stores don’t over charge them? I’m fairly disappointed at how some stores charge $10 for a pack it’s ridiculous and why can’t the just make them $3.29?
    Because our cards are sold all over the world and to put just an American MSRP would be pretty shortsighted. We do our best to publicize the correct price of the cards and to make them available for that price on our website.

  80. Am I the only one that thinks letting anyone with 3 badges in to the STS will allow too many people in? Is there any limit?
    Don’t know that yet first they have to get to L.A. ya know?

  81. If we finally finish handing out enough Mews to fill the replenishment sheet, is it too late to send it in to get more?
    I believe so, though you’re welcome to try.

  82. Can you make a book with all these rulings from R&D so I can show my tournament director? He doesn’t believe me!

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 2-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers from Customer Service

Thurs. June 22, 2000

Hello again gang. So first, the announcements.

Most of you have probably already heard that the STS format changed for the 2 youngest age groups. Here is the letter that is being sent out:

Dear Master Trainers,
Its true! Due to amazing customer feedback we have decided to add these two sets into the Pokémon card sets that can be used at this event in July. All age groups will be able to use Base Set, Base Set 2, Jungle, Fossil and Team Rocket. In addition all promo cards that have been released in English can be used as well. We feel that this will create the most exciting and interesting play experience for all the master trainers coming to the Super Trainer Showdown. Good Luck, Master Trainers, and have a great time!

Secondly I would like to thank all of the people who have sent in Weedle cards already. Thank you! We still need more to build the Space Weedle though. If you have any extra cards and want to be part of Pokémon Chat history, please mail your Weedle cards to Master Trainer Mike c/0 Customer Service Wizards of the Coast PO Box 707 Renton, WA 98057. Please sign the card with your name so the world will see how generous you are.

And lastly, the STS will be a DCI Sanctioned event meaning some of the shenanigans we’ve heard about at some of the Qualifying events will NOT be allowed. If you are unsure of what the DCI rules for Pokémon Tournaments are check them out on our web site.

  138. Earlier I asked about the fire energy only on Dark Charmeleon. If Rainbow Energy works, then what is the card referring too?
    It is worded that way so the other player could NOT Metronome that attack without fire energy (or a rainbow energy) being attached to the Clefable/Clefairy.

  139. Let’s say I have a promo Eevee and I go second. On my opponents second turn he evolves a Pokémon can I evolve Eevee?
    Sure.

Ok gang, gotta go! It was fun as usual to talk with you all! See you next week!

Thurs. July 6, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 3-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers from Customer Service

Thurs. July 6, 2000

Hey gang! Welcome to the new 3-5 PST Pokémon chat!
Master Trainer Pat is out so you’ll just have to put up with me alone!
First though, the announcements.

Fresh from R & D are the announcements:

First, How does Agility and Dark Wartortle Mirror Shell interacts? Agility does NOT prevent Mirror Shell from happening, as it does NOT refer to the Defending Pokémon when this attack is done.

Secondly, someone asked if there is a shuffling rule for Pokémon. Normally you follow the DCI rules, which allow you to shuffle or cut your opponent’s deck.

Thirdly, a definition that may help with future rulings. Any card that provides Energy is considered an Energy card of the type it provides. So if you were to Energy Burn a DCE, it counts as a Fire Energy card that provides 2 fire Energy until the end of the turn. So it could be gathered by Team Rocket Charmander but would only provide 1 coin flip for the Continuous Fireball attack on Dark Charizard. As for the Eevee Chain Reaction questions, R & D is still researching into the “Counts as Evolving” rule. So hopefully we will have answers on it in the future. We have heard all about the concern for some upcoming Pokémon cards such as Team Rocket Trap, Chaos Gym, and Team Rocket Zapdos. Rest assured that we are aware of your concerns and are looking into them. Lastly I wanted to thank all of you who have contributed to the Space Weedle project so far. I have received 115 Weedles so far and more are coming in every day. I also wanted to thank Tyais for helping get the word out for the Space Weedle. Many of the cards coming in have the Pokegym on them in support of his site. If you want to contribute and be a part of Pokémon history, please send your extra Weedle cards to Master Trainer Mike c/0 Customer Service Wizards of the Coast PO Box 707 Renton, WA 98057. Be sure to sign your name on the cards so all can see how you took part in this fun project. Now, on with the questions

  1. Will there be a second Pokémon league after this one ends?
    Yup yup! No details available yet though (sorry).

  2. What is going to be the next Pokémon League Promo card?
    Dunno! Eevee right now, nothing to announce (yet).

  3. What other events will happen at the STS instead of the tourney?
    Well, there will be a King of the Hill tournament, gun slinging against WOTC’s best Pokémon Masters, a place to get your picture in front of a Giant Pokémon card (I’m hoping for Weedle), and other side events as well.

  4. For Venomoth when it uses its “Shift,” how do you know what its Weakness is? Or do you count that?
    Its weakness remains the same, which is to Fire.

  5. Do you know what set of Pokémon cards you are releasing next? I really want to know!
    That would be the Gym: Heroes set coming out in August.

  6. Are you going to use Pokedex data from the Gameboy Yellow version of Pokémon?
    Hmmm, not that I’ve heard.

  7. When will we get our golden invitations?
    You should get them in the mail within 2 weeks of the event. If you haven’t please email us at custserv@wizards.com with your information so we can get this corrected for you.

  8. Will there be any Pokémon in gold and sliver be release as a promo card here in US?
    Sorry, I have no info on any Gold or Silver or Neo cards yet.

  9. Are there any other Pokémon Trading Card Game CDs besides the Base Set 2 one?
    Not yet.

  10. Are Pokémon Leagues holding weekly drawings to send people to the STS? If so, when do/did they start?
    My understanding is that they should have. I heard it was a contest that each league was supposed to send entries in for. Ask for Gym leader for details.

  11. What will be the Pokémon League promo card for the first season of the new Pokémon? Will there be a new league?
    There are plans for a new league, no info beyond that, sorry.

  12. Seeing as the STS showdown has people from Europe, are we to use rocket Grimer and fighting weakness Vileplume as they were intended to be printed? (Poison, not sleep and fire weakness?)
    Good question! Since the English translated cards will be in the far majority; my understanding is that you play the cards as they are printed still. So if you have a Vileplume with the error weakness it is still played as is.

  13. How come Mew and Mewtwo don’t have very many HP? I thought they were like the strongest Pokémon!
    I don’t think they drank enough milk growing up.

  14. Scenario: Mr.Mime with Defender receives an attack that does 40 dmg. The online rulebook says that Trainers are figured before Pokémon Powers; so the Defender would reduce the dmg from 40 down to 20, and this would slip under the Invisible Wall, right?
    Right!

  15. Computer Error: is there any rule or “etiquette” on who goes first when drawing cards? Or do you alternate (I draw one, you draw one, I draw one, etc.)?
    As stated on the card, you (the player who is playing the computer error) draws your (up to) 5 cards first, then your opponent has the option to do so.

  16. Computer Error: do you have to announce up front how many cards you’re going to draw? Or can you draw one at a time & stop at your own choosing?
    You must announce up front how many you will draw and then draw that many.

  17. From Last Week: Would Dk.Wartortle’s MirrorShell stop working if the opponent benches their Pokémon first (same as Smokescreen)?
    Nope, since the Mirrorshell is NOT referring specifically to that Pokémon.

  18. I presume that when Dk.Wartortle’s MirrorShell is used that you apply weakness & resistance. Is this correct?
    Correct!

  19. Are the promo cards shown in the Chicago sun times the upcoming movie promos?
    Dunno, I’m in Seattle so I didn’t see them.

  20. Are these cards all new?
    Dunno (if you mean the Chicago Sun cards).

  21. Are you guy going to release any gym promos?
    Probably.

  22. OK, you said in an earlier chat that individual stores could choose to ban people due to age. Is there some other way to get badges in order to get into the STS showdown because all the stores in my area do the “If you’re over 12, you’re a sicko and can’t come here anymore”?
    Hmmm, I would definitely talk with the managers of the stores about this issue. Most of them can be reasonable if you talk calmly with them.

  23. From Last Week: How much damage is done to each Pokémon if Rapidash uses Agility(Heads) followed by opponent Dk.Wartortle’s Mirror Shell followed by Rapidash’s Agility(Tails)? Is it 0, 30, or 60? Take your time & think about this one carefully please.
    Turns out I gave you the correct answer last week, it’s 60.

  24. I have Japanese cards that have the same attacks as the promos pictures in the newspaper, so why are they called all new 9(other than the cool Articuno pic, replaced with an ugly one)
    Guys, we only make the translations of the original Japanese cards. They are all new in that they are translations. Remember we do NOT own Pokémon, we primarily just translate them.

  25. Any new promo info? like on the league cool Porygon or any new ones, previously unannounced
    Nope, sorry.

  26. I’m just curious. Do you know any of the new Pokémon?
    Personally? I did see Lugia at the grocery store once.

  27. Are there just Holo Dark Raichus or are there Unholo Dark Raichus?
    Only Holo Dark Raichus.

  28. Is there going to be a big Super Trainer Showdown on the East coast like there was one on the west coast in California?
    Yup! Though it may be called something different.

  29. Why was it pushed back and hour, for the chat?
    We have been very busy here and usually the chat runs out of steam at the end. Now you get 2 fun packed hours!

  30. Did Japan copy off of Wizards when making dark Raichu, or did Wizards just move the dark Raichu card from another set to Rocket (got it from a later set of Japanese cards)?
    I believe we made that card first.

  31. Has the WB store promo jumbo card been released? My WB store released them yesterday.
    Dunno.

  32. Is there an official release date for gym heroes?
    Not official no, mid-August.

  33. What would you say is a reasonable price for a piece of cardboard with writing on it?
    Hmmm, certainly not what I see them going for on the secondary market.

  34. Why do you believe that Pokémon are so popular?
    Hmmm, well some say cuz they are so dang cute, some say because of the strategy involved, me? Weedle makes it all work out!

  35. Why is the art on some cards changed?
    Different cultures, different cultural values.

  36. Will people in the East Coast tour be allowed to use gym cards?
    As far as I know, yes.

  37. Why is card art sometimes changed? for example Team rocket Grimer, why are these cards changed? nothing was wrong with it before. there might have been some sick people that would joke about certain cards, but they are ignorant, why should it hinder our cards? I’d be disappointed if cards like Grimer and Misty’s tears were banned or changed because of a few sick jokes by jerks.
    Understand that people form different cultures and countries find different things objectionable. Since this is primarily children’s game, we do not wish to publish anything that would upset parents.

  38. Has Wizards decided what they are going to do with League after the 8th season? I became a Gym Leader 2 weeks ago but I have no info and many trainers are asking me during League.
    Sorry, we are very busy getting ready for the STS. They should have info sent out in the near future.

  39. Do you guys get tired from “computer lag” from chatting for hours?
    Nah, too many years of computer games prepared me for it!! Anyone remember Zork??

  40. Any new info on the Best buy giving out ancient mews for buying more than $50 thing?
    I passed that info along that’s all I know.

  41. Is Wizards considering altering or banning Team Rocket Trap?
    As stated in the opening announcements, we have heard your concerns and are having meetings about it.

  42. Will any Pokémon “celebrity’s” be at the STS *Example: Imakuni or Mitsuhiro Arita like they were last year at the Tropical Mega Battle?
    Hmmm, well Master Pat and Boss Mike and I will be there, does that count?

  43. Have you acquired the rights to print the NEO expansion yet?
    Nope, not yet.

  44. How will I recognize Mike and Pat at the STS?
    We will be helping to judge the main tournament. Just ask any Wizards employee, they will know us.

  45. What’s the Space Weedle card count this week?
    115

  46. If Venomoth Shifts to Psychic and a Muk comes into play, does Venomoth stay Psychic or is he back to Grass.
    Venomoth would remain Psychic.

  47. What do the initials “DCI” stand for?
    Duelists Convocation International.

  48. Do Team Rocket American card alike with the Japanese one?
    They are mostly the same.

  49. Will you put a picture of the space Weedle on the web when it’s done, or put it in an issue of top deck?
    It will probably appear in both places (I’m hoping to have it at the STS as well).

  50. Prolly this is on R&D, When you have no cards in deck and use Rattata’s Trickery, Would you end up with 1 less prize card? Or the Card in Deck condition doesn’t allow it to be used.
    You would not be able to use it, it says to Switch a card, meaning there must be 1 card in each area (prize pile and deck) in order to use this Pokémon Power.

  51. How many Gym (Stadium) cards are going to be in the Gym: Hereos set?
    Dunno exactly 6 or so I think.

  52. Can you give us any information on the Legendary Bird promos for P2K?
    Only that they will be be given out starting the second week of the movie while supplies last.

  53. After this Pokémon league has ended will there be another league?
    There are plans for more, yes.

  54. If you use mew’s devolution on a stage 2 Pokémon that has been evolved using a Pokémon breeder does the stage 2 Pokémon turn into the basic Pokémon?
    Yes it would, as the Stage 1 Pokémon card isn’t there.

  55. Has there been any east coast STS schedule changes?
    Not officially yet.

  56. If Ditto copies a promo Eevee, then you evolve one of your benched Pokémon, can you use the copied “Chain Reaction” power and search for and evolve Ditto to an Eevee evolution?
    Yes you can!

  57. Can you retreat if you have a full bench?
    Yes, you switch your active Pokémon with one of them from the bench.

  58. Wait where do I send my extra Weedles and what do need to do sign them and what else?
    If you want to contribute and be a part of Pokémon history, please send your extra Weedle cards to Master Trainer Mike c/o Customer Service Wizards of the Coast PO Box 707 Renton, WA 98057. Be sure to sign your name on the cards so all can see how you took part in this fun project.

  59. If you attack your opponent with a team rocket Eevee using sand attack, then your opponent uses gust of wind to switch Eevee, and your opponent keep the defending opponent the same, does your opponent need to flip when they attack you?
    Yes they do, the Sand Attack only references the defending Pokémon (not Eeevee).

  60. I haven’t seen any Wizard’s stamped Dark Charmeleons anywhere. How many were released and where were the issues of Top Deck sent? The Wizards of the Coast and GameKeeper stores in my area never received it.
    The Dark Charmeleon that was released in Top Deck did NOT have a stamp on them. They were regular Dark Charmeleons that were released early.

  61. Is there any possibility that DCI will start using different formats for Pokémon like Type 2 and stuff?
    Many things are bing discussed.

  62. How many emails have you gotten in favor of card bannings?
    16 so far.

  63. I am a member of the Pokémon League, but my DCI number isn’t on your site. Why?
    I know that the data entry folks are WAAAY behind.

  64. When will wizards release the vending sheet promo or won’t release it at all?
    No dates set yet.

  65. When did the league start and when will it end?
    It started in most locations last September. It will end this summer and then more league stuff should go on past the ending of this league.

  66. Sorry if you already answered this, I just joined. To join in the STS tournament @ Long Beach, is it sufficient to simply bring your 3 badges and your official League book with stamps in it?
    Correct!

  67. Has Wizards or DCI released info about what next season’s promotional card will be? If yes, what is it?
    We haven’t.

  68. Will wizard’s make they’re own sets since we are copying cards faster than Japan can make them?
    We don’t have the rights to do so, so I dunno.

  69. Do you have connections with Topdeck Magazine?
    We make it.

  70. Are there going to release a gym Prerelease card in the league?
    Maybe, I dunno for sure.

  71. If you want to see the newspaper cards, look at pojo.com?
    Ok I will, thanks.

  72. Why don’t WOTC make real card versions of the TCG GB cards (GB only)?
    Nintendo made up those cards and they own them.

  73. If you don’t “own” it then how did you make Dark Raito and Promo Eevee?
    We have some small amount of leeway but that is all.

  74. I see you guys posted at PokeGym, why don’t you also post at Pokeschool. I hardly go to Gym but go to School like 6+ times a day.
    We are so busy its hard to hit all the sites (sides I have posted there).

  75. Is the jumbo lendgendary bird card that’s going to be giving away at the WB studio store going to be in English? How many more jumbo cards will there be?
    Unfortunately I have not been told much about the jumbo cards friends, sorry.

  76. The original Japanese Gym set had approximately 90 cards, while the new American Gym set has about 130 cards, does that mean wizards made new cards for Gym?
    No, we are combining the first 2 Japanese cards sets into Gym: Heroes.

  77. Any response to the promo Ninetales idea?
    Not yet sorry.

  78. Will you guys adopt the non-archetype format to prevent everyone from playing haymakes and raindance?
    All of this sort of thing is in discussion, that’s all I can say.

  79. I heard that the Cool Porygon and the Jiggilpuff promo card are coming to the league and I’m just wondering if it came out, were the original Cool Porygon be worth more than the league one?
    We have nothing to do with the secondary market and card values. We figure cards are worth whatever you can get for them.

  80. Will gym be a sub set that can’t be played with the other cards or will it be like a normal expansion?
    It will be like a normal expansion.

  81. Is the trainer Pokedex culminative (like using 2 Pokedex to change the order of the top 10 cards of your deck)?
    No it isn’t. You play one and it resolves, then if you play another you would rearrange the same 5 cards.

  82. Will ancient mew be allowed in gameplay?
    There will be a translation made available for it through the league, beyond that I dunno.

  83. Will the Ancient Mew given out at the movie be English or Egyptian?
    It will be in the same odd picture language as the Japanese version was.

  84. Is Gym Heroes currently being printed? Literally, is it coming off the presses as we speak?
    I think so.

  85. Who is Imakuni?
    He is a rather popular though goofy character in the Japanese Pokémon card game lore. He runs around wearing what appears to be a teddy bear suit.

  86. If you ban those cards from gameplay, will you still publish them? I’d still like to add them to my collection.
    Sorry gang, no comments on bannings or anything like that at this time. All different possibilities are being discussed.

  87. If you been absent from the Pokémon league will you get kick out?
    I don’t think so.

  88. Can I get points for completing TR in Pokémon League.
    Do you mean completing a set? You would have to check with your gym leader.

  89. Why would someone use Gengar in a no energy stall?
    Dunno, I would need to hear more specifics. Ask the player doing it why he made that choice.

  90. If a Ditto is facing a sleeping Muk, would it be a Muk or Ditto?
    The end result is that Ditto is Ditto, not Muk.

  91. My league allows use of Japanese cards, are they supposed to?
    Only as long as they are versions of cards already released in English, you have an English copy with you for translation purposes, and your entire deck is in opaque card sleeves.

  92. Who makes the decks featured in TopDeck, because they’re really bad.
    Dunno, send your own suggestions in to them.

  93. If I use Dark Wartortles “Mirror Shell” then my opponent uses Rapidashes “Agility” and flips heads does Mirror Shell do anything?
    Right, it would do nothing.

  94. When is the super trainer showdown?
    July 22nd.

  95. How many cards are in gym and gym2?
    130 cards in Gym: Heroes, not sure about Challenge.

  96. Do you know when the UK will be able to get the P2K promos?
    Sorry but I don’t. I would contact WOTC in the UK and ask them.

  97. If the promos run out at p2k, will there be a place to mail in the stubs to get the promos?
    I have no idea that would be up to Warner Brothers.

  98. Will there be a “big prize” for having all eight league badges?
    Dunno.

  99. Will you still be able to work on the first badges after season 8 gets done?
    Sorry but I don’t have any specifics yet on what will happen after the league ends though we are working on future league activity.

  100. Are there any plans for any official Pokémon stuff other than Pokémon League for the Omaha, NE area?
    Sorry, I dunno. The League is the main thing we do with Pokémon.

  101. At the P2K Movie site they said there will be a premiere on July 17 at Mann’s Village in Westwood, Ca. Will the Ancient Mew cards be given out that night?
    You would have to ask that theater that one.

  102. I have a card with a pokeball symbol on the card (Japanese)(it’s not from the gym heroes), what does it mean? A vending card? A promo?
    It is probably the Japanese vending card symbol.

  103. Can you verify the cards shown in the newspaper and pojos? The Articuno had diamond dust attack and Zapados had lightning burn attack.
    sorry, I can’t.

  104. Will the American promo Mew be foil?
    Yup.

  105. Any promos being given away at STS?
    Dunno.

  106. In question 72 you said that Ditto opposite Promo Eevee could evolve. But Ditto’s Pokémon Power says it can’t evolve. Please clarify.
    Wondering if someone would catch that. R & D is verifying the specifics. The Eevee Chain Reaction (like the attack on Team Rocket Magickarp) ignore the normal evolution rule in that you do NOT play a card from your hand but instead pull a card from the deck and place it on top. While this has the same effect as evolving the Pokémon (removing attack effects for example) it is NOT the same as Evolving the Pokémon.

  107. When using Dark Dragonair’s Evolutionary Light can you evolve that Pokémon on that turn?
    Yes, as long as you hadn’t just evolved to Dark Dragonair that turn.

  108. Yesterday I got a non-1st edition rocket booster and I got a dark Ninetails misprint and I was wondering if the misprint was fixed yet?
    Haven’t heard about that one.

  109. Will the movie promo cards be distributed to all movie theatres or just a certain chain?
    I don’t have that sort of info sorry.

  110. Can Clefable use Metronome with Magikarps Rapid Evolution?
    Yes it can.

  111. Why is it that y’all haven’t updated your page with anything other than STS stuff?
    I asked at the meeting today and was told it should be up today or tomorrow (there were some last minute editorial changes).

  112. I came in late, but did I hear right that Ditto can copy Eevee’s Chain Reaction to evolve? I thought Ditto could not evolve, no matter what. Maybe you meant Clefable could do it?
    Nope, the last ruling I got (which could always change) is that Ditto could do so since the Chain Reaction pulls a card from the deck NOT from your hand. If it pulled a card from the hand then it would NOT work.

  113. Why is it that Dark Raichu is no longer an American exclusive?
    We don’t own Pokémon remember.

  114. I saw the legendary Dragonite card from the GB game in a store. Is it a real card?
    Not that I know of.

  115. If you used Mew’s devolution beam on a stage 2 Pokémon that had Pokémon breeder on it. Would the Pokémon breeder be discarded or would it do back to the player’s hand?
    You actually do not leave the Breeder on a Pokémon when you play it, it goes to the discard pile when played and you place the Stage 2 Pokémon on top of the basic Pokémon to evolve it.

  116. If we send you are hand drawn cards, could you make them into Promos? And give us Credit, and even give us copies?
    Sorry, but no.

  117. Where do I send my card ideas?
    I would send them to fan sites or magazines like Top Deck, Scrye, or Inquest. They usually like to hear from the public.

  118. Is the vending series being released here a likely possibility!
    A good chance.

  119. What does cool Porygon do?
    Well it can actually do some damage unlike the original.

  120. I’m confused about the gym sets… so sets one and two were combined to make Heroes? Could you please give a DETAILED description of both/the gym set/sets?
    Sorry but no. Top Deck should have articles on it soon though.

  121. Will the Pokémon league give jumbo energy cards like how magic gives out jumbo land?
    No plans that I know of.

  122. Wheres the Pokegym and the pokeschool?
    Just search for them on the web. Easy to find and they are very active (the pojo as well).

  123. Whats the news on the new promo cards from Pokémon 2000? I think there was an article in the sun times.
    I haven’t seen it yet, sorry.

  124. When will WOTC release an official schedule of events for STS Long Beach? (or has it already been released?)
    Should be in the next day or two.

  125. Are wizards going to make a non-holo version of the base set?
    Don’t think so.

  126. How will gym be divided?
    Gym 1 and 2 combined to make Gym: Heroes, Gym 3 + 4 combined to make Gym: Challenge.

  127. Can you do something over at DCI to encourage more drafting tournaments?
    It is not up to us, it is up to local business’s and organizers who set up and are willing to run tournaments.

  128. Will future sets have more cards in a booster?
    Not that I know of (it would cost you more which most people do not want).

  129. Will there be a foil in every booster like in Japan?
    Nope (it would cost you more which most people would not want). Also foils would become more common and their collectibility would drop.

  130. Where is the gym leaders face going to be placed on the card? Will it be the same as the Japanese card format?
    I think it will be the same as the Japanese cards.

  131. Well Ancient Mew be banned from play?
    Dunno, they are looking into this one for me.

  132. OK, I’ve got to leave soon, so here’s the URL for the petition 38.200.160.83/ubb/Forum11/HTML/001585.html I’m planning to get a lot more sigs, so please consider a stop in North Carolina. Thank you.
    I will pass along your suggestion.

  133. Is it true that Base 2 and Team Rocket are no longer being printed?
    Not true, they are still in print.

  134. I own a card store and want to start running the Pokémon league here, what do I do?
    Contact our Merchant Relations department at 1-800-821-8028.

  135. Why haven’t you made transcripts for the last 2 chats?
    They are being worked on.

  136. Why doesn’t Imposter Oak cause the other guy to discard his hand?
    Dunno, we translate them as they are made. Keep in mind gang that this game was never really designed to be balanced, just to be fun.

  137. Why doesn’t Wizards take a more serious look at Pokémon like it does Magic rather then just say it’s only a Sociable game for fun and completely blow off all the competitive players of the game?
    As previously stated, we do not own this game, we own Magic. We can do what we think is best for Magic, for Pokémon we must negotiate with several owners of the license (we have been negotiating for the Neo rights for 6 months now).

  138. Can you evolve Eevee into one of the rocket evolution lines?
    Sure.

  139. In a Gym Heroes ad it said Misty, Brock, Lt. Surge, Erika and you, does that my that the (your name)'s Chansy will be in Gym heroes?
    I dunno, Top Deck should have a card list in the next issue.

  140. Do Base 2 cards count toward collecting Base and Jungle in the TCG League?
    Hmmm, dunno. I will ask for you.

  141. Are the basic energy cards going to be in the Gym Heroes set?
    I’ve heard that they will.

  142. Can you use Ancient Mew in decks since its background is supposedly different? (at least in Japan)
    I don’t know if it will be allowed in League or tournament play yet. If so, you would have to have your entire deck in opaque sleeves so that that card wouldn’t be marked.

  143. I’m sure you Wizards are aware that all is not well amongst Pokémon Leagues out here – much inconsistency, Gym Leaders not sending in DCI numbers for badges earned, etc. Are you working on ways to get the Leagues in order?
    Our 5 very overworked people are doing the best that they can. If you ever hear of any problems please email us with any details.

  144. At my league in order to get a badge, we have to win a match with the “gymleader” , but I thought we get it automatically when we get enough points
    You shouldn’t have to beat the gym leader. Please email us at custserv@wizards.com with the details so we can look into it for you.

  145. Should the league give points for completing a set that is only in Japanese?
    I don’t know.

  146. Is there still gonna be the tcg tours or whatever? And if there is can one come to southern Utah?
    The Mall tour is done for now. East Coast dates will start late this summer.

  147. In reference to Q135, doesn’t Rapidash’s Agility say that if anything happens during the opp’s next turn, prevent it, so wouldn’t Rapidash take 40 from Mirror Shell since it’s during your (not opp’s) turn?
    Good catch! You are probably correct. I will confirm with R&D but I think you are correct. My bad.

  148. Why do WotC UK never give an answer when I ask when things that are out in the US will be out here?
    They might not know yet. Keep in mind that release dates change right up until the last minute (delays in printing, licensing, etc). Since release dates usually change we usually choose to not give out a bad date.

  149. When does league end?
    Season 8 ends this summer. There may be more to it though.

  150. After the first week will Ancient Mew still be given out?
    Only while supplies last.

  151. Is the bilingual Eggxeccutor (sp?) from the Tropical Mega Battle legal in tournament play?
    It should be.

  152. My basic Magneton has a red background instead of yellow why?
    Probably a misprint.

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 3-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers from Customer Service

Thurs. July 13, 2000

Hey gang! You don’t mind if we start a couple of minutes early do you?
Here are the announcements.

First, an R&D ruling. Team Rocket’s Magickarp and Promo Eeevee’s Chain Reaction can be used the turn those Pokémon come into play. Since they pull an evolution card from your deck instead of playing an evolution card from your hand they are NOT limited to the normal rule of evolution and thusly will also NOT be stopped by Aerodactyl’s Prehistoric Power either.

Here is the latest POSSIBLE East Coast Mall Tour information. Please keep in mind that it is STILL being worked on and thus not finalized.

August 26-27 Troy, MI
Sept 9-10 Townson, MD
Sept 16-17 Cinncinnati, OH
Sept 23-24 Schaumburg, IL
Sept 30-Oct 1 Independence, MO
Oct 7-8 Alpharetta, GA
Oct 14-15 Braintree, MA
Oct 21-22 King of Prussia, PA
Oct 28-29 Nanuet, NY
Nov 4-5 Miami, FL

Some rules information on the main tournament at the upcoming STS. It is a Swiss style tournament. You will earn 3 points for a win (meaning take all 6 prizes, deck him out, or knock out his last Pokémon), 2 points for a draw (anything NOT a win or loss), and 1 point for a loss. When time is called, the player that is playing gets to finish his turn and then the other player gets one last turn. Players will be allowed to use dice instead of coins if they so choose.

If you are late to your match your opponent gets to take one of his prize cards, if you are more than 5 minutes late, the gets 2 prize cards, and you forfeit if you are 10 or more minutes late to your match. Matches will still be 20 minutes long and there will be 15 minutes between matches to finish up, learn your next match pairing and get settled for the next match.

Lastly, the judges will all be trained and ready to help keep this a fun event for all, unsportsmanlike conduct and stalling will be dealt with accordingly (from a warning to a lost prize card to a game loss to a DQ). Please keep in mind that these rules may vary somewhat at the match but these are basically as it will be.

And finally, I want to thank all of the folks who have sent in their Weedles to be a part of the Space Weedle (Thank you to Tyais for helping to get the word out on the Pokegym as well). I’ve received over 250 so far and if we keep getting more then we may have to build more than one Space Weedle as well. If you want to be a part of the Space Weedle project, please sign the front of your extra Weedle cards and mail them to Master Trainer Mike c/o Customer Service Wizards of the Coast PO Box 707 Renton, WA 98057.

Not quite. I’ll let MT Mike post something about it, as I’m sure you’re all curious to hear how R&D ruled.

Here is the latest ruling from R&D on the whole evolution question.

First, Ditto CANNOT evolve whether he is a copy of TR Magickarp or promo Eevee as it states on Ditto he cannot evolve and so that takes precedence. Second, Clefairy/Clefable COULD evolve if you Metronomed an attack tat in effect evolves a Pokémon like TR Magickarp’s Rapid Evolution. This is of course, assuming that you have a Gyarados in your deck. Third, the whole Revive a Pokémon and then evolve it in one turn has been ruled NOT possible.

Basically REGARDLESS of how a Pokémon is brought into play; it CANNOT be evolved normally on that turn (meaning you play an evolution card from your hand). You COULD Revive a TR Magickarp, Rain Dance 3 water energy on it, switch it up as the Active Pokémon and then use its Rapid Evolution attack to pull a Gyarados from the deck and place it on the Magickarp. This is allowed as you are NOT normally evolving the Pokémon but using an attack to do so.

Lastly, it is possible for you to have a Pokémon evolve BEFORE your 2nd turn but NOT on your first turn. An example: your opponent plays first, on your turn you play or already have promo Eevee out. On his second turn he evolves a Pokémon, you could now use promo Eevee’s Chain Reaction to pull out an evolution card and put it on Eevee. This is BEFORE your second turn but AFTER your first turn.

    I’m only telling you how R&D has ruled on it and they state: Clefairy/Clefable could evolve if you Metronomed an attack like Rapid Evolution _and_ you had a Gyardos in your deck.

  11. Is there going to be a prerelease of a special gym Heroes card like the dark Gyrados?
    Yeah…it’s the Misty’s Seadra.

  12. What is the official release date of the gym heros set?
    It will be released to all stores by August 14th.

  13. I read on pojo.com that you can use Ancient Mew in legal decks, is this true and if so does he count as a mew for the purposes of having four Mews in your deck?
    Yes, and yes.

  14. If Arcanine keeps on using Take Down until he K.Os himself does the opponent get to draw a prize?
    Anytime a Pokémon is knocked out in the field of play the opponent takes a prize.

  15. Is the Promo you get with the Coupon that comes with the Legendary bird cards a Misty’s Seadra Prerelease, or something different? If so can you say what it will be?
    Yes, it’s Misty’s Seadra. But you can also earn that through the leagues the normal way.

  16. I’d just like to say that the idea to restrict the number of trainers in a deck would be perfect to stop the dominance of Wiggly and Haymaker decks, without going down the treacherous road of bannings?
    I agree?

  17. Should there be theaters handing out the bird promos already? My friend went to watch it the second day it came out and he got a Zapdos.
    It depends on the theater’s supply of cards…traditionally if they have the ancient mew card they should be giving it out until it runs out…the legendary birds should be given out the second week of showing, but it depends on the theaters card supply. (Like I said before.)

Time to wrap it up for today. We’ll see you all again next week, same Poke-time, same Poke-channel.
Later, gang! Goodbye all!
