Click on each spoiler to view entire log:

Thurs. Aug 3, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 3-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers Mike and Pat from Customer Service

Hey Pokémon hardcores! Not much new to announce this week, but MT Mike will be joining me shortly to help answer your? I don’t remember telling you about this so.

There will be a foil-stamped Misty’s Psyduck card with issue #10 of Top Deck magazine. That’s the only new promo to announce so I’ll dig into the questions for this week.

Gym Heroes is missing many cards from the original Gym 1. Do you have any plans to use the missing cards in Gym: Challenge?
Yea, the way it worked out is that the cards from the original sets will be spread out among the two sets

  1. How many of different rarity are in each pack (ex.4 commons 3 uncommons etc.)
    Usually it will be 7 3 1 though one of the commons is energy?

  2. Are you considering errata on the misprinted Team Rocket cards?
    Not that I know of.

  3. When a card’s attack “does damage to itself”, is this damage considered to be an ATTACK against the Defending Pokémon? Let’s say you had an Electabuzz versus a TR Porygon and TR Porygon switched Electabuzz’s Weakness to Lightning. You Thunder punched with Electabuzz and flipped tails. Would Electabuzz receive 10 or 20 damage? Furthermore, would Defender prevent this damage? (Defender prevents damage from attacks).
    Well, assuming it was an attack that did damage to itself then defender would help with that damage.

  4. Have you gained the rights to print the Neo series?
    No word yet. We’re hoping to hear something soon.

  5. Can you use Ancient Mew without an opaque black sleeve?
    Absolutely not.

  6. If an attack Knocks Outs and Paralyzes Gyarados at the same time, would he be able to do Final Beam. The rule book, page 21: “f) … Do any damage first, then do any other effects, and finally, Knock Out…”. However page 22 indicates that you do g) Powers before I) status effects (thus coming to a “yes” conclusion last week). According to page 21, the attack will paralyze Gyarados, disable Final Beam, and then Knock Out Gyarados without him able to do Final Beam. Does “g) relevant Pokémon powers” on page 22 is referring to powers that modify the damage done, not Pokémon Powers which trigger when a Pokémon is Knocked Out?
    The answer has already been ruled on. Dark Gyarados would get off its final beam, as it would take damage and be knocked out BEFORE the attack effect (paralysis) goes into effect. This has been ruled on before and this is the official answer.

  7. Are the boosters at the pre release tournament 1st edition or unlimited
    I’m guessing they’ll be unlimited

  8. What is promo #19?
    We don’t know yet.

  9. How many of different rarity are in each pack (ex. 4 commons 3 uncommons etc.)
    7 common, 3 uncommon, 1 rare one common will be energy

  10. What is the latest status on the 15-trainer rule?
    Still testing

  11. When will league locations get Misty’s Seadra prerelease for legendary bird’s ad?
    I would guess they’ll be getting those within a couple weeks.

  12. Where is the 1st edition symbol on gym hero’s packs and where is the 1st edition symbol on gym hero’s box?
    On the pack it’s in the lower left. I can’t check a box at the moment though

  13. Will there be an East STS Qualifier in NJ?
    I’m not sure all the dates have been finalized yet, though I would imagine there would be one within driving distance of NJ

News from the latest Pokémon meeting (just got back). We are looking into sanctioning the East Coast Mall Tour qualifiers and the East Coast STS. So playing in them will effect your DCI rating if this goes through.

Many people have asked how do you get invited to the Tropical Mega Battle. Simple, the top 12 ranked players between the ages of 10-14 will receive an invitation. This event is happening specifically to interface with Japanese players that are being sent over with Creatures Inc. It is a smaller event and thus will not have qualifiers for it.

There have been lots of questions about any rules changes in the game (like Trainer limits, minimum Pokémon numbers, etc.). Rest assured we are looking into several possible changes for sanctioned tournament structure to help maintain game balance and encourage variety for the game. It will take plenty of time and testing on our part before any such possible changes will most likely occur.

Lastly, one last thank you for all the people who sent in Weedle cards for the Space Weedle. While I was very sorry that it got lost and never made it to the STS, it was returned days later. There are some new pictures of it (and Pat and I) up on my web site at home.earthlink.net/~seawolven/ . We plan on unveiling it to the public now at the East Coast STS instead (and we will ship it so that the airlines can’t lose it again)!

  1. Will there be a prize for the winners of gym hero’s prerelease tournaments? If so, what?
    That ultimately is up to the store running the event.

  2. How many cards does Gym Heroes consist of?
    132

  3. Exactly what language is Ancient Mew in?
    A made up one.

  4. Hi when will 1st editions go on sale on the Wotc on line store?
    Dunno, I would recommend just checking it daily (they never tell us.

  5. When will the second Gym Heroes set be released?
    Gym Challenge will be out in October.

  6. Is the new top deck already released?
    Should just be coming out now.

20.When will Gym: Heros come out? On the website, it once said Aug. 7th, but it says Aug.14th now.
August 14th as far as I know.

  1. How many energies do you get in Heroes boosters?
    1

  2. If you use gambler and it was the last card in your hand do you still have to shuffle your deck?
    Yup

  3. Is Gym Heroes Release Event on the 5 or 12? I konw of a WotC & Game Keeper doing it on the 5.
    August 5th

  4. Jungle Vileplume’s Petal Dance attack says it becomes confused after doing damage. If all 3 flips are tails and the attack does no damage, does it still become confused or does it not?
    If it doesn’t do damage then it doesn’t get confused. Excuse me on the Vileplume answer. The card states’’ Vileplume is now confused"

  5. Is the release date for Heroes the 7 or 14? If the 7, what locations/stores?
    August 14th.

  6. Why not pairings in the Gym Heroes tournament? That way you can prevent experienced players from feeding off the less experienced
    The point of the Release event is primarily to sneak some new cards to the public so they can see them early. It is not really intended as a competitive tournament (it is not sanctioned).

  7. With Dark Alakazam’s Teleport Blast attack do you have to switch Pokémon?
    Nope, it says you “may”. Your choice.

  8. How do I get a Misty’s Seadra?
    Either join the league and do the activity or just stop by a league location and the do the activity (don’t have to join). Or you can earn it through the leagues the regular way

  9. What will come after GYM challenge?
    Nothing announced yet.

  10. How come most of the stores that are doing prerelease don’t have any info?
    Please contact us with any specific stores so we can look into it for you. Some stores should be getting their kits today.

  11. What are the rares in the Heroes theme decks?
    Not public info yet, sorry.

  12. Which cards will not appear in gym heroes?
    Why that would be all of the cards besides the one that come in Gym Heroes.

33.What happens if I use Prof. Oak and have less than 7 cards left in my deck? Do I lose immediately, or do I draw out the remainder of my deck and lose at the beginning of my next turn (if I don’t do anything to replenish the deck like Recycle, Mr. Fuji,
You only lose when you don’t have any cards to draw on the card draw you must do on the start of your turn. So you would lose on your next turn if you didn’t somehow get some cards back into your deck.

  1. Any news on the Gym PCDs?
    Rares in Hero’s decks: Misty’s-Misty’s Tentacruel and Misty, Brock- Brock’s Rydon and Brock, Lt. Surge- Lt. Surge’s Magneton and Lt. Surge, Erika-Erika’s Vileplume and Erika.

  2. Since Ancient Mew is now legal in tournament play, how do you “prove” its translation? With Japanese cards you must have an English equivalent. Do I have to carry around the Pokémon League playmat in my pocket or what?
    You’ll have to have a special decoder ring. Just kidding’ I would expect good trainers to know that card.

  3. Any info after the league Victory Road season?
    We are working on year 2 of the league but nothing official to announce yet.

  4. Any info on the East Coast STS? Date/Location?
    Sometime in November most likely. Beyond that nothing signed yet.

  5. Will you make Koga and Giovanni PCDs for Gym: Challenge?
    Most likely.

  6. Why is it that whenever a Pokémon chat comes along one of you is missing?
    This is our busy time of year…we go to alot of shows, tourneys, cons, etc Cuz MT Pat is actually schizophrenic, I am just his dominant personality. hee heee hee D’oh Actually he is right, busy time of year. I will be at Gen Con btw. Anyone here going?

  7. What kind of Psyduck is promo #20? (Is it the same as the fossil Psyduck?)
    Sorry, no specific info on it yet.

  8. Will there be new league prizes?
    Sorry, no info there yet either.

  9. If Ditto is against a Clefable, can it keep on metrenoming metrenome and not consider STALLING?
    Nope.

  10. Will there be energy for Gym Challenge?
    Yes.

  11. Can Mewtwo pull any energy from the discard pile, such as rainbow energy?
    I assume you mean the WB Mewtwo. Yes it can. Furthermore, putting a Rainbow energy on from your discard pile won’t make Mewtwo take 10 damage.

  12. What cards are left out from the Gym Hero set?
    Like I mentioned earlier all the original Gym sets are split between the two sets now

  13. Why do 15+ people not get to go to the Tropical Mega Battle?
    I don’t know which ones are missing from the original sets. This is an event set up to interface with Creatures Inc form Japan. And they only want kids ages 11-14 to participate.

  14. How many different energy cards are in the Gym Heroes set?
    I’ve only seen the basic types so far.

  15. Why did you change the Gym Symbol for Gym Heroes?
    I’m not sure of the reason for that change.

  16. Do know what the official wording of The Rocket’s Moltres is?
    Yes, I won’t tell you the whole thing but it’s power is Rebirth: When Rocket’s Moltres is knocked out, put it back in your hand after discarding it. You can’t do this if R Moltres is Asleep, etc

  17. Will there be any new promo’s this year?
    Yes.

  18. Why didn’t any of my leagues have Misty’s Seadra to give out for doing the legendary bird crossword? Will they get them soon? And When?
    Well, they hadn’t been sent to stares yet. Yes they’ll get them soon. I don’t know.

  19. Can you make a Ninetales Promo?
    Hmm. We’ll work on it.

  20. Are you gonna stop making Fossil when Gym Heroes are out?
    Nothing announced like this yet.

  21. Can Wizards print neo, vending sets, or Southern Islands sets yet?
    Still working on getting future sets.

  22. How many badges are there going to be after the Victory Road season?
    Sorry but they are still working out next years logistics.

  23. Are there Sabrina’s Gastly-Gengar and Sabrina’s Abra-Alakazam in Gym Heros?
    The latest Top Deck has a complete card list.

  24. You guys considering limiting trainers to 15 a deck?
    One of the many options that are being looked into and tested for possible tournament formats.

  25. Why reprint the energy in heroes when we have base set 2?
    Base Set won’t be out forever.

  26. Is their any plans for bans/restrictions?
    Same answer, no plans but things are being looked into.

  27. Will the Pokémon cards of GB will be published by Wizards like the GB Meowth?
    Haven’t heard of that happening.

  28. Why didn’t WOTC use the Japanese format of Holo AND rare in every pack?
    Different markets have different needs.

  29. Is Gym Heros going to have the same foil pattern as Base1-Fossil?
    Roughly the same, yes.

  30. Where will I get a Cool Porygon?
    You can try and earn 1 in the Victory Road season in your league (after season 8). But you have to have all 8 badges to try.

  31. In a previous chat session, you guys stated that if a Pokémon knocks out a Dark Gyarados with an attack that causes paralysis on a coin flip, and the flip is heads, Dark Gyarados still may use its Pokémon Power: Final Beam since it was knocked out before the paralysis was applied, however, the rulebook says that Pokémon are knocked out after effects are applied, even if the Pokémon already has taken enough damage to KO it, can you please explain the ruling?
    Not really, there are some things that R&D is discussing with Japan about timing in the game. For now, our answers stands but do keep in mind they are subject to change.

  32. Can you answer any question about Gym Heroes yet?
    Sorry but not until they are mass released.

  33. Are there going to be exclusive “theme deck” cards like there were in Japan in gym?
    Our theme decks won’t be the same as japans.

  34. What are the odds of getting a holo in a Gym: Heroes packs
    Same as usual, 1 in 3.

  35. When a card’s attack “does damage to itself”, is this damage considered to be an ATTACK against the Defending Pokémon? Let’s say you had an Electabuzz versus a TR Porygon and TR Porygon switched Electabuzz’s Weakness to Lightning. You Thunder punched with Electabuzz and flipped tails. Would Electabuzz receive 10 or 20 damage?
    20, it is considered an attack.

  36. My holo jungle Clefable is lighter in the text and the flower symbol than it should be. But it past the light test with flying colorless (get it?) Is it counterfeit?
    I can’t say without looking at it, it might just be a misprint.

  37. Did WOTC tell the stores doing the prerelease to make it have a fee?
    It is up to the individual store (just like for the league itself).

  38. Are the bottom of the cards going to keep the style and add a pokedex box where the head is suppose to go?
    Nope, the heads are on the cards. The weakness/resistance/retreat stuff is moved over slightly.

  39. Why does Ancient Mew have to be in an opaque black sleeve?
    Because otherwise it would count as a marked card.

  40. What is the official release date for Gym: Heroes know, and will it change again?
    August 14th is the last date I was told.

  41. Does Alakazam’s Damage Swap Pokémon Power apply Weakness and Resistance?
    Nope, it is NOT an attack.

  42. Will promo 18 Team Rocket’s Meowth have a GYM style bottom with the rocket head?
    Haven’t seen it yet, sorry.

  43. Will the east coast STS be under our current format, or might there be rules changes?
    Dunno yet.

  44. Can I play an Ancient Mew card without an opaque back sleeve but with a Pokémon card in the back to cover?
    Nope. It would be too thick tat way.

  45. My Dark Raichu says evolves from Pikachu Put Raichu on the Stage 1 card. Is that a mistake?
    Yes.

  46. Rumor has it on the PokeGym that you will be using the old foil patterns for Gym, the same as Base-Fossil. Is this correct?
    No.

  47. How many different energy cards are in the Gym Heroes Set?
    6 all basic.

  48. Where can I get an opaque back sleeve?
    Card collectibles shops have them.

  49. Now, if two cards, which may be different, have the same name, they are considered the same card, and must have a 4 card per deck limit. Now, I was wondering about Japanese cards…I think it’s been mentioned that you may play Japanese cards in your deck.
    Yes. And Japanese don’t count as different named cards if that’s what you were going to say.

  50. If my Dark Charizard was hit with smoke screen. What order would I do the attack?
    You would check for Smokescreen BEFORE you flip coins for the attack and then later discard fire energy.

  51. Can Clefairy, Clefable, or Dark Wartortle evolve into Gyarados or Dark Gyarados?
    It is possible for Clefable or Clefairy to Metronome TR Magickarp’s Rapid Evolution and thus evolve into Gyarados or Dark Gyarados, yes. Dark Wartortle? No. Clefairy, Clefable Yes.

  52. If I use Dark Alakazam’s Teleport Blast attack do I have to switch my Pokémon or can Dark Alakazam remain active?
    You have the choice; it says “may”.

  53. If Trapper becomes as dominant as a lot of people are predicting, what will WotC do to change that?
    A lot people predicted Aerodactyl decks would dominate and they didn’t. Why not wait and see what happens?

  54. Will Gym PCDs be more expensive than normal because they have 3 rares? Or will the price be the same?
    3 rares? Where did you hear that? They will be the same price as normal. 3 rares. You’re speculating’ now.

  55. How do you know your DCI ranking number?
    The top players are listed in Top Deck.

  56. How do I get an Eevee Promo card?
    You could have earned them in Season 7 in the league.

  57. If Gym Heroes has Sabrina’s Gastly Gengar, will it have both versions of each?
    Gastly, Haunter are in Gym Heroes.

  58. Instead of trainer limit, would you do a Pokémon limit? Like least number of Pokémon = 20 or something?
    Any suggestions you have, email them in to us so we can check them out.

  59. What kind of coin is in Gym Heroes theme decks?
    Starmie

  60. Will the East Coast have any possible changes in effect? Is this undecided or a definite no?
    Nothing announced yet.

  61. Can I take all 9 cards with nightly garbage run? Official ruling please.
    What do you mean? You can only return 3 cards (energy or Pokémon only).

  62. When should leagues get the Team Rocket’s Meowth?
    That is not public knowledge, sorry.

  63. Clefable CAN use MP Moltres’s Hyper Flame if the Clefable had a Fire energy, right? What about a Rainbow energy?
    That would work too.

  64. Are any of the Japanese promo cards going to be in English?
    Probably.

  65. Will there be an arctic Mega tournament for Alaska?
    Hmmm, No.

  66. Will there be a promotional card in the Pokémon the Movie 2000 video?
    Too early to tell.

  67. Does the rule about showing up if you have 3 badges apply to the East Coast STS?
    I haven’t been told but my guess is yes.

  68. How many different promos are there including prerelease, black star, foil stamped, etc.
    At least 30 though.

  69. Will Heroes cards be legal in the upcoming STS East Qualifiers?
    Yup.

  70. Will the GB Pokémon cards like GB Promo Meowth Will be released like Courtney’s Moltres from Pokémon Trading Card game from Game Boy?
    I have no idea.

  71. Was the Space Weedle really lost, or do you just want it all for yourselves? : Eyes MT’s suspiciously:
    Hey! We were at LAX airport until 1 am waiting for the darn thing so you could see it at the STS. I was bummed it disappeared. It showed up back here at WOTC 2 days later.

  72. Will there be a promo card in the Pokémon 2000 video?
    Dunno

  73. Is there another way to sign up for the gym heroes release event then going to the store because I don’t have time to get to the store and sign up
    Nope, you might try calling them though.

  74. Will there be any STS locations in Canada?
    You mean for the mall tour? Not that I know of this time.

  75. Are there plans for a regular size legendary bird card?
    Haven’t heard of one.

  76. How many rare cards do you get in a Gym booster?
    1

  77. Any news about the Pokémon League after Victory Road?
    There will be one, beyond that? Nothing’ yet.

  78. What is the maximum amount of people that are supposed to come to a prerelease tourney?
    36-54 (up to the store to decide).

  79. Is there any way you can get the past Promos from the TCG League besides trading?
    Nope. Besides the cool Porygon you can try to win in Victory Road season.

  80. On the jungle Seaking card it says put Seaking on the Stage 1 card, Seaking is the stage 1 card so could you evolve Seaking into Seaking and cure ailments?
    Nope

  81. If I use Venusaur promo’s Megadrain, can I take off 20 damage COUNTERS? The card says take off a number of damage COUNTERS equal to half the damage done to the defending Pokémon.
    No, don’t be silly.

  82. You mention that Gym: Heroes isn’t out yet, but technically it is. The spoiler was already released in the recent TopDeck issue.
    Right! The spoiler was, the cards are not out yet.

  83. The Jungle Vileplume card says “Vileplume is now confused (after doing damage)”. So what if NO DAMAGE is done?
    It is still confused. It is just stating when you would place the confusion effect.

  84. Can multiple Defenders be attached to one Pokémon to prevent a “self destruct” attack from killing themselves?
    Sure.

  85. Will the East Coast STS help you decide on possibly banning cards, or imposing trainer limits?
    Maybe.

  86. More info on prerelease Misty Seadra, please. I thought you got it by taking in the extra card that comes with the legendary bird promo cards.
    Correct, you take it to a league location, do an activity and then you get the card. OR you can join the league and do the activity to get it.

  87. How many rare card do a gym booster have?
    Same as normal.

  88. Is Erika’s Graceful Attack card in Gym Hero’s? IF it is, did u guys change the text for it?
    Check out Top Deck for a spoiler on Heroes, otherwise you have to wait until it is out.

  89. What will be the next promo card after the DK Persain?
    Well there is the Team Rocket Meowth for season 8 in the league, and you can try to earn Promo Psyduck and Cool Porygon in the Victory Road season after that.

  90. Is it true that when I get Gym Challenge (is that it?) that I will get a Sabrina’s Venomoth even though Sabrna isn’t even released yet?
    Dunno, check out the spoiler.

  91. MT Mike where, when, etc. is Gen Con?
    August 10-13th in Milwaukee, WI.

  92. Are there any plans for Gym 2 Yet?
    You mean Gym: Challenge? Out in October.

  93. Do you plan on creating another Space Weedle so I can send in the rest of my Weedles?
    I will be building a wall of Weedles to place behind the Space Weedle (to help accentuate it), feel free to keep sending Weedles So the world can see who you are.

  94. What was the final Weedle count for the Space Weedle?
    Last count was close to 900.

  95. Are you sure about the Metronome Rapid Evolution thing? You’re breaking your own rules with that ruling. It says in the rulebook, “if it evolves from so-and-so”. Clefairy/Fable isn’t so-and-so, since it has no picture of it in the corner of a Gyarados?
    That is the OFFICIAL answers from Japan my friend.

  96. Hey Pat, did MT_Mike give you one of the copies of the Rulings Compendiums I gave to him at the STS, or is he hoarding them all to himself (grin)?
    He has seen it from on the web. I wrote to pokesensei about it, make sure he writes back to me.

  97. Why are some of the Japanese Cards that were common in the Japanese Set rare in the American Gym Set?
    Different markets gang, please stop trying to compare them, they are NOT the same.

  98. Did you all intend for people who wanted to translate Ancient Mew to get a sheet for it from the League? If so, what are you going to do about the sites that allow you to simply print up a translation, like Pojo.com?
    That was how it was originally intended, but information flows freely in the cyber-age.

  99. Are there any plans for another American exclusive card?
    Maybe.

  100. What is your email addresses?
    Write to us at custserv@wizards.com .

  101. Will the East Coast STS have a limit on people?
    Hopefully not.

  102. Will the Nintendo Power Mewtwo and Dark Persion be released in the league so more people have a chance to get those wonderful cards?
    It is always possible but I haven’t heard of any plans yet.

  103. Will you consider going back to a 3-hour chat from 2-5 PM PDT? The last few weeks all questions haven’t been answered at the chat.
    If it stays real busy maybe. But it would have to be a few weeks from now as we are very busy with convention season.

  104. What are you going to do about the cards that are “Too Broken,” AKA TR’s Trap and Chaos Gym. Will they be banned?
    No plans on any bannings at this time.

  105. Where can we see the MT trainer cards that you guys made for fun?
    Hmmm, I would probably lose my job if I showed them, but I’ll ask

  106. How much would it cost EXTRA to produce a foil in every pack? $1, $2 extra…
    It has more to do with flooding the market with them, the fact that you don’t need many of them for a balanced deck (and it is a game after all), etc.

  107. Has the latest Topdeck with the Psyduck promo come out everywhere yet?
    Well, I’ve got mine, should hit everywhere soon.

  108. How long will the Victory Road session be?
    6 weeks as usual.

  109. What will happen if I don’t have all 8 badges in Victory Road? (Will I still get a Victory Road book? How will I get the promos?)
    You will have the chance to keep trying to earn you remising badges during Victory road season. You can only get the book if you have all 8 badges though.

  110. Can multiple Plus Power trainers be attached to a Pokémon to cause extra damage?
    Sure.

  111. Will WotC ever create a set that will never be released in JAPAN?
    We don’t own the game gang. So unlikely.

  112. Is there gonna be a W stamped Psyduck in the next Top Deck?
    Yup!

  113. People at my league say Blastoise is a stage 3 I think different who is right
    He is a stage 2.

  114. At the Gym Heroes Prerelease Tournament will you be able to use cards you traded for? (Like say I got a Misty’s Seadra and traded for an LT. Surge’s Electabuzz. Could I use the Buzz?)
    Technically you are only supposed to use your deck and the cards form the boosters you are given. It would be up to your store to decide the specifics.

  115. When the new gym cards are released, will I be able to go somewhere and by an “Erika” deck?
    Yup!

  116. What is a marked card?
    A card that you can tell what it is by a glance (without seeing the front). It might have a different back, be scratched or written on in some way, be more worn out than the other cards, etc.

  117. Ugh. I truly blame I chat for that it’s been mentioned you may play Japanese cards in your DECK, but Japanese cards don’t necessarily have the same names as their American counterparts. So, what about this loophole? Or will you simply allow us to put?
    It will be counted as the same name as the English version.

  118. Does the Gym Hero set have a card numbered 133/132 like Team Rocket had 83/82?
    Nope.

  119. Do all Pokémon in Heroes relate to one of the first 4 leaders, or are there some from all 8?
    There are some from the second 4 trainers

Master Trainer Pat: Hi Gang! We’ve done some homework for you guys with respect to hunting down some answers for last week. MT Mike Do you have those ready?

Master Trainer Mike: Hi gang. Let’s start with some rules answers to last week’s questions.

First Misty’s Staryu’s SWIFT attack. The SWIFT attack ignores all Pokémon Powers, Weaknesses, Resistances, or ANY other effects that attempt to alter the amount of damage done by this attack. SWIFT does NOT prevent anything that prevents the attack from actually occurring however like Smokescreen or Transparency. So SWIFT will ignore a Defender that is attached to the Defending Pokémon, as it is an affect that is attempting to alter the amount of damage done by the attack.

Second, the RECALL Trainer cards. This has the same sort of effect as Metronome or Ditto in that any self-referencing in the attack is changed to the active Pokémon’s name instead. Meaning if you used RECALL to use the Energy Loop attack on Sabrina’s Abra when it is evolved to Sabrina’s Kadabra (or Sabrina’s Alakazam), you would replace the topmost evolution step’s name into the attack. In other words you would still have to return a psychic energy card attached to it in order to the Energy Loop attack. The easiest way to think of it is that the RECALL Trainer gives the Active Pokémon the attack of your choice from one of its previous evolutions, with all of its positive and negative effects affecting your active Pokémon. So if you used RECALL on Gyarados to use Magickarp’s Flail attack, it is possible for that attack to do up to 90 damage.

Rocket’s Scyther’s Shadow Images attack is NOT cumulative.

Clarification on the whole Knock Out/triggered effects steps in Pokémon as well. When a Pokémon receives sufficient damage to be knocked out it is INSTANTLY knocked out (before anything else is done). HOWEVER, Prize cards are NOT drawn AND replacement Pokémon is NOT moved up until ALL triggered effects are resolved. Meaning that if Blaine’s Moltres does its attack and Knocks out Dark Gyarados, the Dark Gyarados would get its chance with its Final Beam attack effect BEFORE the Moltres can return to your hand (if you flipped tails). Blaine’s Moltres states that it would be returned to your hand AFTER DOING DAMAGE. This means AFTER all triggered effects are resolved (in this case the Dark Gyarados’s Final Beam). So after everything has resolved THEN prizes are drawn and replacement Benched Pokémon are moved up (with the player whose turn is next choosing first).

Lastly as some of you may have heard, we will be making appearances at some of the East Coast Mall Tour stops. Dark Master Trainer Mike (our boss) will be at the Baltimore and Miami stops, Master Trainer Pat will appear at the Chicago location, and I (Master Trainer Mike) will be at the Boston stop. So stop by and say hello, and bring your best decks to show us what you can do!

Thurs. Aug 25, 2000 - Gym Heroes TCG Hour

TCG Hour: Pokémon: Gym Heroes
Featuring Robert Gutschera

Fri., Aug. 25, 2000

WizO_Bilbo: Evenin’ folks and welcome to TCG Hour with our special guest, Robert Gutschera! From Cerulean City to Pewter City and beyond, you can find powerful Pokémon trainers called Gym Leaders. These are some of the best trainers around, and the Gym Heroes™ set lets you check out some of the gyms as well as the Gym Leaders’ personal Pokémon and training methods. Robert Gutschera from Wizards R&D gives you the scoop.

WizO_Bilbo: Robert, do you have any comments to open up the chat with?

WotC_Robert: I don’t have anything special to say . . . I’m happy to dive right in!

guest22: Are these the same cards that are in the Japanese set?

WotC_Robert: That’s a good (and surprisingly complicated!) question. Let me try to explain . . . . The cards are all the same cards as they appeared in Japan, but the way we are releasing them is different. They had a release of two decks; then two more decks; then boosters; then two more decks; then boosters again. There was a lot of time between these different releases, and it was very hard for fans to keep track of what came from where. We decided to simplify it so that there would be two releases: Gym Heroes and Gym Challenge. We also wanted people to be able to collect all the cards from the boosters. So if you want to buy a theme deck, that’s great, but if you just want to buy boosters you can do that too. In the Japanese releases, some cards were only available in theme decks. I hope that all made sense!

guest22: That’s very interesting. Thanks!

Scrye_Fung: Ancient Mew is the nickname for a card just like the movie promo Mewtwo is a nickname for a card. Why is this card considered different from Mew and you’re allowed to have four of each (Ancient Mew and Mew) in a deck? After all, there are only 3 symbols on top of the Ancient Mew card, which should indicate the word Mew. Also, now that Ancient Mew is banned from tournament play, why is it still being allowed at the DCI-sanctioned East Coast STS?

WotC_Robert: Ancient Mew was never meant to be a tournament playable card . . . it was just meant to be for fun. We don’t want to have cards in play that people can’t read! And of course it has a different back. Remember we want to keep the environment fun and casual . . . don’t just think about the big tournaments with the top-level players (who of course are heavily represented in places like this chatroom!) In more casual environments, it’s important that people can read the cards, play them as written, play without sleeves if they want, and so on. Also, as far as I know, they don’t allow it in Japan, and we want to keep the same cards legal or not legal in the two places

guest17: I participated in the Gym Heroes Prerelease tourney. I was charged an entry fee of $5 and had to pay extra for booster packs. They also allowed Japanese cards . . why did this happen?

WotC_Robert: I’m sorry to hear it didn’t work out for you . . . it’s hard for me to respond to the specifics since I don’t know what that tourney organizer was doing, or what he had promised beforehand, and so on. But I would say the best thing to do is to write Wizards Customer Service in an email giving the particulars, and if the tourney organizer is playing fast and loose they can try to whip him into shape!

King_Blastoise: Why did Wizards take some of the cards out of the original Gym set and throw in some Blaine and Sabrina cards? Why didn’t Wizards just keep Gym like the original one was set up?

WotC_Robert: Good question. I’m the one responsible for all that (I picked the Heroes and Challenge sets out of the Japanese cards). The main reason was that we thought it was important to represent all the colors. We didn’t want some kid whose favorite color was Psychic to find that there were no cards at all for him in Heroes. We didn’t particularly want to make our set different just for the sake of it being different, though. Within the bounds of having all the colors, we tried to have the emphasis on Heroes be on the first four Gym Leaders and the emphasis in Challenge be on the second four. Remember, not everyone (especially younger kids) knows exactly what the Japanese release structure was. We wanted something that would make sense to someone just buying Heroes straight up without advance information about the Japanese sets. Sorry if it didn’t match what you wanted . . . I’m hoping that having all the different colors will appeal to lots of the people buying Heroes!

guest22: Why is the trainer called Misty (which is a foil) rarer than most of the Pokémon?

WotC_Robert: She shouldn’t be . . . I know it seems that some of the foils are rarer than others, but really they are all about the same! It might seem like one or another is rarer, but that’s mostly randomness having to do with time and place. There can be very slight differences . . . for example, if most foils go on the sheet four times, but there are still a few extra slots on the sheet, we put a few foils on five times rather than waste paper. But none of the foils are deliberately put on many times less often. We try to make them all as equally close in rarity as we can. Really. I’ve done a lot of the layouts (I did all the early ones, although I didn’t do the Heroes ones).

Scrye_Fung: Well . . . because the queue is so long now . . . this will probably be my last chance to talk before the end so I’ll make some general comments and then my question at the end . . . I’d like to thank you for coming out. Wizards has made a continued effort to reach out the public. That I thank you for. Now my question . . . you actually forgot to mention last time you took my question . . . will Ancient Mew, because it’s now banned, be allowed at the East Coast STS and on a lighter note, how long does it take for Wizards R&D to get rulings from Creatures? Does it vary on the complexity of the question?

WotC_Robert: I can’t give an official answer on Ancient Mew, but I’ll pass the question along to the tourney people (R&D advises them, but we don’t directly determine ourselves how they run the tournaments). I will try to make sure the Customer Service people have the answer when they go on chat! My guess would be that it wouldn’t be allowed, but that’s NOT official. Rulings from Creatures . . . it varies quite a bit. Typically what happens is that we save up our questions, and then the next time we see them (maybe to talk about an upcoming set, maybe at a big tournament or other event) we ask the questions then. Most of the questions never see the light of day . . . we ask lots of questions when we are writing the English versions of the cards, so that we can clear up as much as possible in terms of how the cards work *before* we actually print them . . . that way the English wordings can be clearer (at least that’s the goal!). Of course, if something really important comes up, we can try to hasten the process, but that’s how it usually works. The complexity of the question is usually less important than when we are scheduled to see them . . . it’s so far from here to Japan (and they are very good at giving us lots of time we do get together) that we usually have big meetings with lots of questions rather than lots of short questions. Meeting face to face turns out to be pretty important in communicating these things.

Reubot: Why won’t Imakuni’s Doduo be in Gym Challenge?

WotC_Robert: Hmm . . . I don’t want to comment about specifically what will and what won’t be in Gym Challenge . . . I will say generally, though, that we often wrestle with what to do with the “weird” cards. Imakuni of course being an example. We worry that for the people who don’t follow the Japanese cards (like the younger kids) it just won’t make any sense, but then we realize some people want us to do all the cards, no matter how goofy. So it’s a judgement call. I don’t think that card is tournament legal, though, so it shouldn’t affect the tournament scene . . . it is very funny, though. I personally like the card, but specifically which cards we put into sets isn’t my decision anymore!

Zapdos_6669: Sorry if this was asked earlier, but if I successfully use Tickle Machine against my opponent, and then on his turn he draws an Oak and plays it, must he discard his face-down cards? Also, what cards will make up the extra slots to fill the 132 cards in Gym Challenge(there weren’t 264 cards in the Japanese Gym sets).

WotC_Robert: For rules stuff, remember this isn’t official . . . but the rules people did come and ask me yesterday what I thought about that very question . . . . My feeling was that you don’t have to discard the facedown cards, because they aren’t in your hand (Tickle Machine says to put them back in your hand later, so they must not be there now). So that was the advice I gave. But it’s not official until the rules team says so! (Let’s hope they follow my advice, I say! As to the extra cards, there aren’t any extra slots, really. Remember the Japanese sets are six decks plus two sets of boosters, and there are cards in each of the decks that aren’t in the boosters. So the full Japanese Gym set is much larger than it would seem from just the count in the two booster sets they did make. Heroes and Challenge are the same size (to within a couple of cards) and the total cards in Heroes plus Challenge equals the total of all the cards in the Japanese sets, more or less.

guest17: What Gym card do you think will change the game the most?

WotC_Robert: Hmm . . . an interesting question. I actually asked the Creatures people about this, and they pointed me to a card I might not have thought of . . . namely, Misty’s Tears, which just might be the card to push the Blastoise deck into the top . . . hmm but that’s in Challenge, so let’s not talk about that. For Heroes, cards I think are interesting are Erika’s Dratini (as a hoser against Haymaker decks . . . although it’s not clear if it’s strong enough to do the trick by itself) and Misty’s Poliwag can be a pretty good stall card. At a more casual level, the No Removal Gym might make a lot of people who are constantly being Energy drained happy. By the way, Misty’s Tears was originally scheduled for Heroes, but it wound up in Challenge instead . . . . I won’t say any more about that . . . you guys will have to puzzle it out.

guest21: With Challenge due out mid-October, can we look forward to Neo in our Christmas stockings?

WotC_Robert: Sorry . . . can’t talk about release schedules . . . the Pokémon Brand team would kill me!

King_Blastoise: Okay, I don’t know if you answered this yet but they have a Blaine’s Charizard and an Erika’s Venusaur but not a Misty’s Blastoise. Why is this?

WotC_Robert: The sad answer is I don’t know exactly . . . I never asked the Creatures people this question. But my guess would be that Blastoise isn’t a very “Misty-like” Pokémon, so they tried to pick Pokémon like Staryu that are more directly associated with Misty. Erika and Blaine aren’t as well known from the show as Misty, so what Pokémon they have is more open. That’s just a guess though.

guest22: Why do the same Pokémon have different designs and attacks? (for example, Misty’s Tentacool)

WotC_Robert: The basic answer is that there are only 150 Pokémon, so if people still want new Pokémon cards, some Pokémon need to be repeated. Normally, of course, Pokémon with the same name but different powers (which you can think of as different levels of the same Pokémon, if you like) only appear in different sets. I’m not exactly sure why they decided to change that in Gym . . . my guess is that they wanted to have lots of cards that went well with a given Gym Leader. For example, Misty is very strongly associated with Staryu, so rather than doing lots of totally different Pokémon as “Misty’s Pokémon” (and have some of them not seem very “Misty-like”), they decided to do different versions of Staryu. Also, keep in mind that it would be really hard for the colors like Psychic and Lightning where there are very few Pokémon!

    Master Trainer Mike: His undying enmity. Except that it will actually be MT Pat in Chicago and he is much nicer than DMT MIKE is.

  90. The winner of the West Coast STS 11-14 division got to go to the Mega Tropical Battle (I believe), will the 11-14 East coast STS winner be able to go to the 2001 MTB?
    Master Trainer Mike: No he did not.

  91. If it happened that you guys could not get the rights for neo, what would happen then, would the whole Pokémon tcg come to an end? Because I certainly do not want that.
    Master Trainer Mike: Don’t know cats and dogs living together, floods, bad McDonalds food served everywhere. Etc.

  92. Could you have 5 Squirtle in your deck as long as they have different levels? Rocket and Base set Squirtles have different levels.
    Master Trainer Mike: Nope, only 4 of the same named Pokémon max.

  93. Why didn’t you call Gym Challenge Gym Darkness?
    Master Trainer Mike: I voted for Gym Shorts but was outvoted.

  94. “How do you figure Out the Damage” makes no reference to knocking out Pokémon, but merely how damage is actually figured out. The Expert rules are disagreeing with your ruling where it DOES mention knocking out.
    Master Trainer Mike: Ok Scott and everyone else, once again I will say that this is a Japanese card game with weak game balance that is then translated to a very different language with very different meanings. Since we do not own the game, we CANNOT fix the cards before these sorts of issues arise. We do the best we can with this scenario. Unfortunately there are many inconsistencies in their game and the translation templates. Your best bet is to understand that and take the rulings as given and to not necessarily apply the logic from one ruling to another one. Sorry it can get confusing; we are working on trying to be more involved with the front-end design for future sets.

  95. Is it illegal to randomly shuffle your deck, and if yes what are the penalties from doing so?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yes it is illegal. The penalties depend on the tournament rules.

  96. How was the prerelease Clefable obtained, can you still get it, and what is its value?
    Master Trainer Mike: It was sent out to Leagues that started when it all first began last September. We ran out of them pretty quickly and have none left. I don’t know about its value, check mags like Top Deck, Scrye, Pojo, etc for secondary market price lists.

  97. Any word on Year 2 for the Pokémon league?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yup, starts in January, 8 seasons, there will be more activities to do for the folks who earn their badges quickly.

  98. Some kid stole my badge book then ripped it; do I have to start all over again to get them back? Since I got the last badges in Tennessee?
    Master Trainer Mike: I have no idea, you would have to talk with your old Gym Leader for any of these sorts of questions.

  99. RE: #159 what does enmity means?
    Master Trainer Mike: It means DMT Mike is watching you Tyais! Enmity means that he would consider you his enemy.

  100. What is the MTB?
    Master Trainer Mike: Mega Tropical Battle.

  101. Who did they pick to go to the Mega Tropical Battle?
    Master Trainer Mike: 12 kids ages 11-14 from the States, 12 from Japan, 2 from various other countries.

  102. OK, a friend wants me to ask this. Do you need to have at least 6 Pokémon in a deck?
    Master Trainer Mike: Not by the current rules, no.

  103. If a Ditto transformed into a Snorlax, and it was confused, would it change back into Ditto or would it stay Snorlax because of thick skinned?
    Master Trainer Mike: If the Ditto was already confused it could not Tranform into Snorlax, if it Transformed into Snorlax it could not be confused.

  104. Do you know what the Japanese metagame is like?
    Master Trainer Mike: We learned some of it in Hawaii. It seems to be a game played by a much younger and less aggressively competitive crowd.

  105. I know this might be a little early but I think an American card has something like it. Anyway, Sabrina’s Alakazam (not released but I believe another card has similar text, not sure) has a Pokémon Power that allows you to use the attacks of any in-play Psychic Pokémon. Does Sabrina’s Alakazam have to have that attacks energy (Like I wanted to use Mewtwo’s Psychic, would I need 1 Psychic and 1 Colorless energy to use Psychic or can I use it without energy)
    Master Trainer Mike: Sorry but that card Isn’t out yet so I can’ t gives you any rules advice on it.

  106. What is all the different prerelease out there?
    Master Trainer Mike: Pre Release Clefable, Aerodactyl, Dark Gyarados and Misty’s Seadra so far.

132a. How many promos are out there?
Master Trainer Mike: Roughly 30.

  1. What is promo 19?
    Master Trainer Mike: No info on that yet.

  2. Is there any penalty for accidentally seeing your opponent’s hand?
    Master Trainer Mike: As long as you both agree it was accidental, then no.

  3. If you don’t draw basics in your hand 3 times in a row, do you lose automatically?
    Master Trainer Mike: No.

  4. How did they pick people to go to the MTB?
    Master Trainer Mike: Different for each country some held tournaments, we sent the top 12 DCI ranked players in that age group.

  5. What is promo 24?
    Master Trainer Mike: No info on promo 24 yet.

  6. Are you guys planning on banning any broken card or changing the card writing (I.e., Wigglytuff, Rocket’s trap, etc.)?
    Master Trainer Mike: No.

  7. Who is on the R&D Committee?
    Master Trainer Mike: The various employees who work here in R&D as well as the leaders from organized play. We also sit it on rules meetings as well.

  8. Do I only need 1 Rainbow Energy to use both of Sabrina’s Venomoht’s attacks? (BTW: what is promo 19?)
    Master Trainer Mike: Yup that would work.

  9. How often does WOTC update DCI standings?
    Master Trainer Mike: Sorry I don’t know.

  10. Can you take some of these confusing rulings back to R&D with a chat log?
    Master Trainer Mike: We do.

  11. I heard you and Dark MT Mike battled some ferocious creatures over the weekend… any comments?
    Master Trainer Mike: There were baby Pokémon, strange Trainers and energy cards and Imakuni yelling out whenever his Weedle attacked me.

  12. Is there going to be any new tournaments like the STS somewhere else?
    Master Trainer Mike: Maybe, nothing to report yet.

  13. What’s your favorite kind of deck?
    Master Trainer Mike: Thread the Weedle of course.

  14. How many qualifiers can you participate at the mall tours? P.S. (Would 8am be a good time to get there, in your personal opinion)?
    Master Trainer Mike: You can only be registered or involved in one event at a time. Once you finish one then you can register for another.

  15. Are Misty’s Sabrina’s Golduck nasty?
    Master Trainer Mike: We prefer the term ill tempered.

  16. Does Wizards have a New Zealand division? I can’t find any info on the wizards web site. We’ll be living there for 5 months and wondered what the Pokémon scene was like
    Master Trainer Mike: No, Nintendo of Australia handles Pokémon in New Zealand right now.

  17. I heard there was a prerelease Raichu that was made accidentally, I doubt it is true, but is it?
    Master Trainer Mike: No sorry.

  18. Do you guys ever change the way a card works during translation?
    Master Trainer Mike: Sometimes if it is unclear.

  19. Was transportation provided to those who went to the MTB?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yup.

  20. We all know your favorite Pokémon is Weedle, but what new Gym cards are you guys getting lots of questions about?
    Master Trainer Mike: Mostly about Recall, Rocket Hitmonchan, Rocket Scyther, and the ever confusing basic grass energy.

  21. Do you have any info about what the promos will be after Psyduck?
    Master Trainer Mike: Nope.

  22. Have Wizards gained rights to the Vending Machine cards?
    Master Trainer Mike: Don’t know.

  23. Are you guys ever going to create a new set, not released in another country?
    Master Trainer Mike: It’s not our game so it is unlikely.

  24. Are you guys ever going to make Imakuni cards?
    Master Trainer Mike: No plans yet that I know of.

  25. Is there an R&D site that I can look at?
    Master Trainer Mike: No.

  26. Will WOTC ever hold a Pokémon Tour through Canada?
    Master Trainer Mike: Don’t know.

  27. What Weedle is your favorite Weedle card?
    Master Trainer Mike: That would be the dreaded promo Oingo Boingo Weedle.

  28. Can you give us the contents of “Thread the Weedle?”
    Master Trainer Mike: If I did then I would have to knock you out.

  29. Even if you win/loss one, can you participate one at a later time that’s what you mean?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yes that is correct.

  30. Since the rulings are gone. got any favorite cards from Heroes?
    Master Trainer Mike: Erika’s Dratini works great against those boring Haymaker decks. Misty’s Poliwag is pretty fly for a water guy too.

  31. What is your favorite Archetype (Raindance, Haymaker, ect)?
    Master Trainer Mike: I used to play Raindance allot. Trying to expand my horizons now.

  32. I heard there was a huge misprint that delayed the Dark Persian Promo from being released in April, if so, what was the misprint?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yes there was, no I won’t tell you.

  33. How do you feel about Wizards getting bought by Hasbro?
    Master Trainer Mike: Cool Star Wars stuff.

  34. What is the next new set in Japan after neo 2(are there any plans for a neo gym leader set?)?
    Master Trainer Mike: Neo 3 I think.

  35. Why doesn’t R&D host this chat?
    Master Trainer Mike: They are busy testing stuff, also they are not trained to deal with the public as much, heck some of them shrivel in the light of day.

  36. Could you guys make a Dark Weedle card that evolves from Magikarp? Please, Please, Please.
    Master Trainer Mike: Well, if it was up to ME.

  37. What does Misty’s Magikarp’s first attack do, and what is Rocket’s Trap?
    Master Trainer Mike: What Misty’s Magickarp?

  38. Wizards of the Coast representative Mike Boozer told me “2001 will be a big year for Wizards and Pokémon.” Any new comments on this as to what it means, or was I being led on…
    Master Trainer Mike: He was referring to when we fly out to the moon of Jupiter a la Arthur C Clarke’s vision. You don’t think they only find a black monolith there do you? Anyone get that one?

  39. I forgot one more things, that means you can win multiple prizes (I heard one was a cap, and the other was a gameboy, and I want both)
    Master Trainer Mike: Sure if you do well enough.

  40. Are you going to use a Weedle deck in the East Coast STS?
    Master Trainer Mike: I can’t play in it but I will bring one to play for fun.

  41. Will the Cool Porygon received at the Pokémon League be exactly the same as the one received in the Pokémon League just not wrapped?
    Master Trainer Mike: I don’t know about its wrapped state but it is the same exact card.

  42. Is there any special info about the tour coming to NC? What time should I be there to get a place in the tourney?
    Master Trainer Mike: Don’t know, contact the mall sponsoring it.

  43. Does Defender take away the effects of the 10 damage from rainbow NRG?
    Master Trainer Mike: No, that is damage caused by an attack.

  44. If a Buzzapped electrode is returned to your hand, would it still be considered an energy card, or would it revert back to a Pokémon card?
    Master Trainer Mike: It would revert.

  45. So HAL is actually a closet Pokémon fan?
    Master Trainer Mike: Someone got it?

  46. When will WotC tell us about the prerelease and what stores will be holding it?
    Master Trainer Mike: Whenever they have anything to announce, not sure there will be one for Challenge though.

  47. Do you think Brock can see?
    Master Trainer Mike: As much as Arkansas.

  48. How many Caterpies could a Weedle Poison in one hour?
    Master Trainer Mike: As much wood as a woodchuck would chuck wood.

  49. Say I use Movie Promo Mewtwo and Absorb up Rainbow Energy, does Mewtwo get damaged?
    Master Trainer Mike: Nope, it only damages when played form your hand.

  50. If a Dark Jolteon used Lightning Flash causing the defending Pokémon to be knocked out, would the effect go on the next defender?
    Master Trainer Mike: No it wouldn’t.

  51. About that promo Dark Persian misprint… The text is slightly changed from the rocket version. The rocket version says at the end, "This attack can’t be used if your opponent has no benched Pokémon,” there fore making your opponent having benched Pokémon being a “requirement” for the attack, thus allowing you to metronome it, choose a Pokémon from you’re opponent’s discard pile, then put it on the bench, the Fascinate right on up there! (Provided when you Metronome your opponent has no benched Pokémon). You may not plead the 5th.
    Master Trainer Mike: Nope that’s not it.

  52. What will the gym challenge prerelease card be?
    Master Trainer Mike: Don’t know yet.

  53. How do you guys get the new expansions?
    Master Trainer Mike: Begging and pleading works well. True but since I’m not very funny to begin with.

  54. If promo Mewtwo absorbs a full heal energy, does poison get off?
    Master Trainer Mike: Nope, its full-heal effect only works from your hand.

  55. What can you say about the Victory Road promotion? Our local league doesn’t have any information on this yet. I know you must have 8 badges, but nothing else. Dates?
    Master Trainer Mike: It starts after the end of season 8, if you have earned all 8 badges then you can get a victory road point book and work on earning promo Psyducks and Cool Porygons. If you have not earned all 8 badges yet you can keep working on them will last the typical 6 weeks.

  56. Do you know what the designs on the Gym Challenge packs are?
    Master Trainer Mike: No not yet.

  57. This might be a stupid question, but I thought there was gonna be a Dark Charizard Prerelease for doing something
    Master Trainer Mike: Hadn’t heard of it, sorry.

  58. Can I make DCI tournaments without having a store?
    Master Trainer Mike: Sure, just get sufficient space to hold an event, the paperwork is on our website.

  59. Why doesn’t the WotC website have card strategies and stuff that is updated regularly? I am sick of looking at the Psychic Assault.
    Master Trainer Mike: Unfortunately we are very busy here. That is what Top Deck magazine is for.

  60. Is there a challenge 4 victory road season?
    Master Trainer Mike: I don’t think so.

  61. Will there be a maximum amount of Cool Porygons you can earn during Victory Road?
    Master Trainer Mike: Supposedly not, though they won’t be easy to earn.

  62. If Prop 15 goes into affect, how will Wizards get it well known?
    Master Trainer Mike: If we decide to try out any tournament formats we would post it in the same places that we tell you about the event itself.

  63. Will gym challenge be allowed in the East Coast STS?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yup.

  64. Wouldn’t it be easier to ban or restrict the cards instead of making a limit on the trainers, all of the expansion sets in Japan have some sort of hose for the archetypes?
    Master Trainer Mike: We are looking into various solutions.

  65. What is the chance of using an uncut card sheet of Rares for a prize or promo?
    Master Trainer Mike: There was a contest last year for a Fossil sheet of cards. Don’t know of any new ones.

  66. Do you know Promo Psyduck’s attacks?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yes I do.

  67. Is it legal in a game to make a deck of nothing but energy and deck your opponent?
    Master Trainer Mike: No, as your opponent does not have to take 2 additional cards. If the game never starts, you can lose due to stalling.

  68. Is it true that if you use Dark Weezing, the one with the misprinted date, you can actually travel to the year 21000
    Master Trainer Mike: DMT Mike is from there.

  69. Will Challenge be allowed at the qualifiers occurring after 10/7?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yup.

  70. Can you ask the DCI people if they could make DCI tournaments online? DCI tournaments are too far from my house?
    Master Trainer Mike: We don’t have any online play yet.

  71. Do you ever play at Seattle area stores or is work enough for you? If yes, which ones?
    Master Trainer Mike: I haven’t much yet, but may look into doing that.

  72. So when can we have a chat w/ Mike Elliot? He was in Hawaii last week.
    Master Trainer Mike: Well he was standing over my shoulder the first half of this chat. I will ask him if he has the time to do so.

  73. What about apprentice, don’t you guys support it?
    Master Trainer Mike: No we don’t.

  74. How’s the status of the “personal web pages coming along?”
    Master Trainer Mike: As far as I know, they may be removing them in the future (too much data to try and keep up with).

  75. Which wizards do you play at?
    Master Trainer Mike: I have played at Games and Gizmos in

  76. What next after Victory Road?
    Master Trainer Mike: A break and then year 2 in January.

  77. If Gastly uses lick and KOs the other Pokémon, does your opponent bring out another Pokémon and then you do the status effect?
    Master Trainer Mike: No, a Pokémon is SLATED to be removed when it has sufficient damage assigned to it. Attack effect resolve BEFORE a replacement Pokémon is brought up.

  78. What are the chances for getting a dedicated Pokémon rules guy like they have for Magic?
    Master Trainer Mike: We are working on increasing our resources for Pokémon.

  79. Need any non-WotC people for play testing?
    Master Trainer Mike: Not specifically but feel free to send in any results you may find out.

  80. I heard that a promo Pikachu is in G/S. Is this true?
    Master Trainer Mike: Don’t know.

  81. Why doesn’t wizards run their own tournaments?
    Master Trainer Mike: We do, in house (employees only).

  82. Any thing on any new promo cards other then cool Poryogon for victory road?
    Master Trainer Mike: Sorry, no.

  83. What are the prospects for getting chat logs on your web site quickly. Perhaps less chance of repeat questions!
    Master Trainer Mike: Again, we are so busy, we are working on it.

  84. Does Gyarados do Final Beam if it is paralyzed?
    Master Trainer Mike: If it is already paralyzed no, if the attack tat knocks it out ALSO paralyzes then yes.

Master Trainer Mike: And with that it is 5 o’clock and time to go. I will be sure to have some more songs ready for you next week since you enjoyed them so much. MT Pat will be back next week too. Thank you all for coming and see you next week!

Thurs. Sep 7, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 3-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers Mike and Pat from Customer Service

Sept. 7, 2000

Master Trainer Pat: Hello everybody, I’m back from a relaxing weekend of live music. Sorry I missed out last week. Once again MT Mike will be joining us shortly, he’s finishing up some announcements for today.

  1. Can you use a gambler if you get that in you’re first hand when you have no basic Pokémon cards?
    Master Trainer Pat: If you mean start without a basic in play, then no. You must have at least one basic Pokémon in your opening hand.

  2. My Pokémon league has already started victory road, but they don’t have the cards or new badge books yet. When will they get them?
    Master Trainer Pat: I would imagine that they’d be getting those soon. I don’t send them out so I’m not certain on a date exactly.

  3. Can we please ask questions about Gym2?
    Master Trainer Pat: Sorry, no. We’ve told you more than we should already. Meaning me leaking info about what cards are in there. Though I figure if you’re savvy enough to know what cards are in the Gym sets you’ll figure out what is in Challenge.

  4. Did you meet Imakuni at TMB?
    Master Trainer Pat: I wasn’t able to go; though DMT Mike and MT Mike did get to meet and play Imakuni.

  5. Any new, news on promos, Neo, or Prop15?
    Master Trainer Pat: Nothing new on that front but I think MT Mike has some tidbits for you. Mike?

Master Trainer Mike: Hi gang, let’s start with the announcements. First, as some of you may have heard, the East Coast STS Main Tournament’s Constructed Format rules will be announced on Oct 9th. We do not know what these rules will be, if they will even be different from the West Coast STS rules at all, so please do not ask about them, as we will not have any info on it until Oct 9th. At that point, they will be posted on our web site and you will be able to call Customer Service and get the full explanation of it.

Secondly, after talking with R&D I want to pass along some ruling changes and clarifications. If you have a promo Eeevee in play and you or the opponent evolve Grimer into Muk, then the promo Eevee’s Chain Reaction Pokémon power would be triggered by the evolution of Muk and would still occur even though Muk’s Toxic Gas states to ignore all other Pokémon Powers. Of course, any evolutions done after this case would NOT trigger the Chain Reaction due to the Toxic Gas Pokémon power.

If you use Porygon’s Conversion attack on a Ditto, the effect takes place. If the Ditto transforms into another Pokémon, the Conversion effect is still on it. This is because the use of a Pokémon Power does NOT end an attack effect. If the Ditto were to Transform into a Pokémon that did NOT have a Weakness then it would still not have a Weakness as the Conversion effect states: If the Defending Pokémon has a Weakness, you may change it to a type of your choice other than Colorless. This does mean that if that Ditto were to later Transform to a Pokémon that DID have a Weakness, the Conversion effect would still be on the Ditto and would effect the resultant Weakness. Conversion, as all attack effects would be removed if Ditto was Benched or left play.

Some clarification on how attack results is calculated. Follow the chart in the rulebook under How Do You Figure Out the Damage. Ignore the rules in what order do you do Your Attack (specifically f). When your Pokémon attacks go through the normal steps through h, IF enough damage is put onto the opposing Pokémon to knock it out then that Pokémon is considered Knocked Out. DO NOT ACTUALLY REMOVE THE CARD; TAKE A PRIZE CARD, OR MOVE UP A REPLACEMENT UNTIL ALL ATTACK EFFECTS ARE DONE. What this means is that if the placing of the damage on the Pokémon TRIGGERS a return attack (like Dark Gyarados’s Final Beam or Rocket Hitmonchan’s Crosscounter attack) then you jump back up into the order and resolve this NEW attack BEFORE you do step i) Now that damage has been done, if the attack does anything else besides damage, do all of that. This explains how an attack that paralyzes does NOT prevent Dark Gyarados’s Final Beam effect if the Dark Gyarados is knocked out. Only AFTER all damage and attack effects are resolved do you actually remove the Knocked out Pokémon, draw a prize card, and replace it. Keep in mind though, that as soon as a Pokémon takes damage equal to its current HP it is considered Knocked Out regardless of what other attack effects occur after damage.

Lastly, what you have heard is true about the promo Jigglypuff #7. It is being earned on the East Coast Mall Tour. Our apologies for telling you otherwise. We only learned of this ourselves recently.

Master Trainer Mike ; Phew! I know lots of stuff to read. Back to the questions (I beat Imakuni by the way).

  1. Will there be a Prerelease for Gym: Challenge? or is it still in Discussion? If so, when?
    Master Trainer Pat: Unfortunately, we didn’t have time to put together a pre-release event for Gym Challenge.

  2. Will there be a new symbol for Gym Challenge?
    Master Trainer Mike: Should be, don’t know what it is yet.

  3. Any info on year 2, of the Pokémon League?
    Master Trainer Mike: Starts Jan 6th, runs 8 seasons, lots of cool promos coming up for it.

  4. Recently it was ruled that Ditto’s transform was triggered. So could you Goop Gas and it be the same as the Defender after Transform?
    Master Trainer Mike: No,

  5. When will TCG league season 2 start?
    Master Trainer Pat: You mean year 2? That starts January 6th 2001

  6. So what’s so special about that announcement by DMTM regarding that Special October 7 regarding the East Coast STS? What’s WotC cooking up? Some more Weedles?
    Master Trainer Mike: It just means that all of the info on the STS will be released before that date and the tournament construction rules (whatever they end up being) will be released on that date.

  7. Any new plans for Promos? Moreover, will the Jigglypuff CD Promo be handed out at the East Coast Tour?
    Master Trainer Pat: Yes, we did find out that the video for Pokémon 2k will have a promo in it, but we don’t know what they’re planning yet. The Jiggly will be given out at the East Coast mall Tour as MT Mike mentioned.

  8. What’s the prerelease card for Challenge?
    Master Trainer Pat: We don’t know of one yet.

  9. Any info on East Coast Tour Deck Restrictions, bannings, or the 2 Props (15 and 2T)? Or still in play testing?
    Master Trainer Mike: Still testing.

  10. Does crosscounter apply weakness and resistance?
    Master Trainer Pat: Yes.

  11. Are you guys making Vending?
    Master Trainer Mike: No but I frequently use vending machines.

  12. Any info to divulge on the deck contents of the Gym: Challenge Koga & Sabrina theme decks? If, so what holos will be in them?
    Master Trainer Pat: I can’t tell what’s in them, I’ve been hushed under threat of losing my pastry privileges.

  13. You said you don’t use the Starry Foil pattern because the world’s supply has run out. Where do you get it? Why did it run out? And where do you get the Cosmo foil pattern for the Foil Cards?
    Master Trainer Mike: Sorry but that is production information and besides we don’t know.

19.Master Trainer Pat: Imported from lower Venus
Master Trainer Mike: Rings of the 7th planet

  1. When will England get gym leader 1 officially?
    Master Trainer Pat: Sorry, they don’t tell us the international release dates.

  2. If I play Tickling Machine, and get the heads, and then I play Impostor Oak, are the cards that are set aside shuffled back into the deck?
    Master Trainer Mike: Nope.

  3. If a Vending Set is released by Wizards, and there is a drawing contest, will the pictures be chosen for the Pokémon that originally had people win the Japanese drawing contest, or will more of the pictures be changed?
    Master Trainer Mike: It was prematurely announced in Top Deck. There are no official release dates for the set if we end up doing it at all. As for the possible drawing contest, that will depend on whether the Vending set ever comes out or not. No details beyond that, sorry.

  4. When considering the format for the East Coast STS, are you looking at the pokegym post on that?
    Master Trainer Pat: We do read those posts, but we also do a lot of testing here and talk with other play test groups.

  5. Who has been doing the official testing prior prop 15 and/or prop T2? I personally don’t think Prop 15 or Prop T2 will be any better than the way things are done now, and want to make sure things are being taken very seriously.
    Master Trainer Mike: game development professionals are testing it in house. Of course it is being taken seriously. sheesh.

  6. Are they going to make the 15-trainer rule official?
    Master Trainer Pat: Dunno

  7. Any news on the American version of Vending?
    Master Trainer Mike: Nothing to report yet.

27.I know you will ignore this question but…Why did you change the picture on Sabrina’s Gengar? Is it because of the graveyard?
Master Trainer Pat: Consider your question ignored.

  1. Will there be any security increases for the Pokémon League in year 2? Lots of promo cards are stolen from many different Leagues and I find this a very concerning, value degrading issue. The Promos, which could fetch an ok trade, now are practically worthless in any trading environment due to people stealing them, and it isn’t just at my League either.
    Master Trainer Mike: What would you suggest, fingerprinting? Of course we are doing the best we can with the league, keep in mind there are over 4000 league locations in North America alone. We are looking into how we can improve security and availability.

  2. Can you tell us what the most likely candidates are for the East Coast STS format is?
    Master Trainer Pat: No that’s confidential.
    Master Trainer Mike: I’m hoping for an all Weedle Competition.
    Master Trainer Pat: Limit the Weedles.
    Master Trainer Mike: HEY!

  3. Will the promo #15 Cool Porygon received from the Pokémon League be individually wrapped like the Pokémon Stadium bundle one?
    Master Trainer Pat: I don’t know, does that make it special

  4. Is the East Coast mall tour coming to Miami, FL
    Master Trainer Mike: Yup!

  5. In the regular Pokémon league, do we have to follow the Prop 15 Trainer rule or ignore it?
    Master Trainer Mike: Guys, there are no rule changes in the card game. Just some proposed possible tournament construction formats. No effect on the league.

  6. Can you please give a reason as to why many of the southEastern states did not receive a STS Qualifier? Furthermore, will there be any other forms of the STS, such as a “Gulf Coast” STS?
    Master Trainer Pat: I think it had allot mall availability and space considerations. I don’t know of any other STS being planned.

  7. What is the formula for DCI ratings?
    Master Trainer Mike: Dunno.

  8. How are tournament formats tested?
    Master Trainer Mike: Lots of hours of research and game play.

Thurs. Sep 14, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 3-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers Mike and Pat from Customer Service

Thurs, Sept. 14, 2000

Master Trainer Pat: Hi everybody! Hope you all had a good weekend. D. MT Mike said he had a blast at the Baltimore Mall Tour event. It sound like he had a chance to meet some of you. Big thanks goes out to Kori for the neat personal poke-cards he made for all of us.

Master Trainer Mike: Yes, thank you Kori for the card and the book “Wheedle on the Needle”! It’s great!

Let’s start with the announcements. Unfortunately there is not a discount program set up for hotels for the East Coast STS. Turns out there are several events going on in the area that weekend and the 5 closest are already booked up. If you plan on going, I would recommend booking early. Speaking of the East Coast STS, the Mall Tour stops so far have been hitting capacity for the qualifying tournaments. If you plan on going to one, make sure to get there early. There is good prize support as well with the winner getting a game boy, the ETCG cartridge, a box of boosters, and a jacket, a T-shirt, along with his invitation to the STS. If you do not win an invitation in a qualifying event, then as long as you have earned at least 5 badges through the league you can enter. Capacity has been doubled from the West Coast STS but it is still limited. We are working on a pre-registration program for the main tournament that will start 3 weeks before the STS. If you plan on participating in the main tournament and have not won an invitation, then watch our web site and the chat for details. Also keep in mind that the construction rules for the main tournament will be announced on Oct 9th on both our web site and you will be able to call us here at customer service for details as well. Make sure to find out what it will be before you go to the event!

We have also been receiving lots of email and calls about the various tournament formats that are being tested and considered. The 15-trainer limit is probably the one that you have heard the most about. There seems to be lots of confusion about this and the other formats being testes so I wanted to give a brief explanation. As we have said before, the Pokémon TCG was never intended to be a truly competitive game. It was made to be socially competitive (meaning friendly fun). The tournaments that are held in Japan are few and infrequent with an emphasis on fun for all.

Here in North America we play our games a bit differently. Its all about winning in our tournament scene and so we tend to play harder, quicker, and much more cutthroat than the game was designed to be played. With that in mind, it has become obvious that out of the 500+ cards that have been released so far, roughly 20-30 of them are ever used in the must-win tournament scene. This is a sign of a broken game. There have been many discussions about the dominating Archetypes in Pokémon, mainly being Wiggly decks, Haymaker variants, the new Trapper deck, with some other deck types being occasionally played (Raindance, Stall, Sponge, etc.). In the West Coast STS (the first main competitive event we have held) almost 90% of the decks play were almost identical. This is clearly a sign of an out of balance tournament environment.

Since we do not own the card game, banning and restrictions are not really an allowable option. Nor is changing the rules of the game (like only allowing 2 trainers played per turn). That leaves us with constructed tournament formats to try out. We have been play testing various formats here in the offices and also reading all of the results that you have sent in to us. Whatever format we come up with (if any) might NOT be a final answer in an ever changing and growing competitive environment. Keep in mind that we are looking at the overall longevity of the game and the competitive scene, which is remarkably different than the Japanese market, which the game was originally designed for. Sort of fitting a square peg in a round hole. The reasoning behind these proposals is to promote diversity in the competitive environment, and to help players try other sorts of decks that have even a slight chance of competing with these decks.

Trainer profusion, BBP’s, the relative slow speed of evolution decks, the rapid spreading of any new deck tech through the internet and popular fan sites are all issues we are aware of and are discussing with Creatures for our different market than that of Japan. We are also talking with them about becoming more involved in the creation and play testing of Pokémon and possibly even helping to design additional cards (like Dark Raichu) that may help to bring balance to a “fun” game that we in North America play so hard with.

Please feel free to keep sending in your opinions and thoughts on the future of Pokémon, we do read them, and listen on the phone. Understand though, that no matter how strongly you may feel about a particular aspect, there will be lots of others who feel the exact opposite. Such is the spark that a democracy gives us. I hope you have all heard about the Pikachu Promotional set that is being sold at the Australian Olympics. We have info about it on our web site. Check it out! Don’t worry though, the unreleased cards in that set will be coming out in North America (and the rest of the world) in your local language through various promotions like the Pokémon League and movie releases.

Also, we are having our first in-house Pokémon tournament tonight! MT Pat, Dark Master Trainer Mike, and I will compete with Mike Elliot from R&D, Kiernan Chase from the DCI, and lots of other tough WOTC Pokémon Trainers. It is a 15-trainer limit tournament and we will give you a report of how we did and what deck types were used next week.

Lastly, I want to recommend that you check out the Team Compendium web site at pokegym.thedojo.com/compendium/. They do a great job of collecting our wisdom (and screw ups from the chat) and put it into an easy form for you to research at. Check them out! Now, to the questions.
