  50. Is Fossil out of printing yet?
    Master Trainer Pat: As far as we know, it is not. Though I wouldn’t be surprised if it goes out of print soon. Stock up now.

  51. What is your favorite kind of doughnut?
    Master Trainer Pat: glazed old-fashioned.

  52. Have Base set and jungle set gone out of print?
    Master Trainer Pat: Yes, they have.

  53. Will there ever be Ash’s Pokémon in a future set?
    Master Trainer Pat: I don’t know, though I’ve heard that Ash makes an appearance in Pokémon Gold/Silver for the Game Boy

  54. Is Misty’s Tears going to be printed in English/?
    Master Trainer Pat: Yes.

  55. How big is the Space Weedle?
    Master Trainer Mike: 7 1/2 feet tall

  56. What is the MOST annoying question you have ever been asked?
    Master Trainer Mike: beyond this one? Why don’t you do the same thing as is done in Japan? That one really ticks us off. The most annoying question we get asked is “why isn’t Pokémon sold/released/etc the exact same way in the sates as the Japanese product is?” To clarify

  57. Sorry but I sent the question “How terrible” I forgot to finish it. That day [Dec. 1] is a Weekday why did you choose that day?
    Master Trainer Pat: Simple, we didn’t.

  58. What is the “stupidest” question ever been asked on this chat (no offense to the person who wrote it)?
    Master Trainer Mike: We used to get a lot of questions about nacho Pokémon.

  59. What’s the most CONFUSING card- that you get the most questions about?
    Master Trainer Mike: Ditto
    Master Trainer Pat: Ditto.
    Master Trainer Mike: metronome a close second

  60. Do you have rights to Imakuni? Cards yet?
    Master Trainer Mike: nope

  61. Since the Neo release won’t occur until at least next year and the GB Gold/Silver is already being released, will the badges in Year 2 reflect both the Orange League _and_ the Joto League? (You said there would be another eight but the Orange League only has four)
    Master Trainer Pat: Zip.

  62. How did you guys get your job?
    Master Trainer Mike: begging and pleading seemed to help.
    Master Trainer Pat: Playing lots of games and looking good in a suit and tie (for the interview, silly)

  63. Are you going to print the Lucky Stadium Trainer cards in English or perhaps the VERY rare holo Porygon (which is a new promo in Japan that you can get after earning 700 points) or any other Japanese rare promos? If so, what?
    Master Trainer Mike: the lucky trainer stadium was given out as a bilingual card at this years TMB. No plans on those other cards.

  64. Did you ever think the Pokèmon TCG would come this far? Did you ever think that you would be idolized by millions? How long have you been working at Wizards?
    Master Trainer Mike: It caught us by surprise.
    Master Trainer Pat: Yes, No, and 1 1/2 years.
    Master Trainer Mike: As for being idolized I always knew I would be infamous, but will settle for being well known in this area. I’ve been here over a year.

  65. Are you going to have different art on the vending cards?
    Master Trainer Pat: We really don’t know much about that set.

  66. I’m sort of new at battling. I’d like to know, can I mix sets when making my own decks (i.e: using Base 2, Fossil, and Rocket)?
    Master Trainer Mike: Sure.

  67. Can you give us some examples of other formats you are considering?
    Master Trainer Pat: Sorry, we can’t
    Master Trainer Mike: making you play checkers instead has come to mind.

  68. Do you support the banning of socks? (see an earlier question)
    Master Trainer Mike: Depends on whether they are the itchy kind or not.

  69. How 'bout Proposition Weedle? Every player must have at least 3 Weedles in his/her deck. Would you guys be able to do that?
    Master Trainer Mike: Only 3?

  70. Do you have an estimated completion date for the Space Weedle…if so can you guys invite me to the ribbon-cutting party?
    Master Trainer Pat: The Space Weedle is complete and will be making it’s debut at the East Coast STS

  71. What is prop 15…How does it relate to Pokémon?
    Master Trainer Mike: On eof many possible tournament formats being testes (no more than 15 trainers in your deck).

  72. Can you tell us what props they are (reference to question#182)
    Master Trainer Mike: The no sock-wearing prop comes to mind.

  73. Why in the neo and neo 2 did they change Pokémon like Poliwhirls types to say water to fighting in Poliwhirls case?
    Master Trainer Mike: Did they?

  74. I didn’t see my question get answered so will you guys be a King of Prussia pencil mania qualifiers?
    Master Trainer Mike: WE did answer, sorry but we won’t be at that one.

  75. Is Base set coming back to print?
    Master Trainer Pat: Nope

  76. Could you make a set that pertains ONLY to like; Ash’s, Professor Oaks, Tracy’s, Gary’s, etc. Pokémon? Please!
    Master Trainer Mike: How about an all Weedle set?

  77. Where on the WOTC site is the info. For UNCON? It’s getting hard to navigate there.
    Master Trainer Mike: It’s at www.wizards.com/uncon/

  78. Why did you choose a weekday for the release of Challenge?
    Master Trainer Mike: start of a new month

  79. When do foresee “Super Energy Retrieval” being released here?
    Master Trainer Mike: no idea

  80. Will there be an American mew?
    Master Trainer Mike: there already was right? Promo Mew

  81. Could you re-announce the announcements please?
    Master Trainer Mike: at the end, we will

  82. Will there be a Pokémon trading card game for Gameboy with gym leaders?
    Master Trainer Pat: That’s a Nintendo question.

  83. How can you guys answer all these questions?
    Master Trainer Mike: They beat us with sticks if we don’t.

  84. Do you think that you are gonna change the rule about having more than 4 of the same cards in a deck, like maybe 6?
    Master Trainer Mike: Oh yeah, that would really help the game.
    Master Trainer Pat: Cool 6 Scythers!

  85. Will there be other “Cool” cards? Does Porygon have that title because his mechanics or is it just a coincidence?
    Master Trainer Mike: cool Weedle!

  86. How can I get a job for WotC?
    Master Trainer Mike: Living in Seattle helps.

  87. What is the release date of challenge?
    Master Trainer Pat: 10/10/2000

  88. Why did they make Gyrados’s weakness grass? In the game boy game he is weaker to electric.
    Master Trainer Mike: you would have to ask creatures that one.

  89. Is it true that Hasbro forced WotC to make those common pokes in heroes(Misty’s Tentacool, etc.)?
    Master Trainer Mike: no

  90. Do you play magic?
    Master Trainer Mike: yes
    Master Trainer Pat: Yea. Lots.

  91. Why didn’t they include Poison type in the trading card game?
    Master Trainer Pat: They just didn’t include all the different types, I don’t know why.

  92. What kind of sticks do they beat you with?
    Master Trainer Mike: Ones with donuts on the end, its called tough love.
    Master Trainer Pat: Donuts on a stick. Sounds like a carnival treat. Are they dipped in Caramel?
    Master Trainer Mike: no maple bars allowed

  93. This may be a funny question to ask but if inside Misty’s Duel, can you pretend to not know how to play Paper-Scisor-Rock, then say heads, you win, tails, you win? Silly question but maybe fun to answer.
    Master Trainer Mike: umm, no

  94. Is it true now you’re only allowed 15 trainers and 2 per turn?
    Master Trainer Pat: No.

  95. Do you answer questions at toll free Game Support line too?
    Master Trainer Mike: maybe
    Master Trainer Pat: maybe

  96. I thought it was the 7th is 10/10/2000 the right date?
    Master Trainer Mike: somewhere around there, dates sometimes fluctuate a bit

  97. Could you take some rules from Magic, and apply them to the Pokémon TCG, like tapping mana?
    Master Trainer Pat: Nope

  98. Are there going to be NEW types of Pokémon in the future?
    Master Trainer Mike: I am leaning towards low fat ones myself.
    Master Trainer Pat: Spongy Creme-filled Pokémon hopefully.

  99. Is Oct.10 the official release date for Challenge? I thought it was supposed to be Oct. 7th (or was it 14th?).
    Master Trainer Mike: sorry not sure of exact date

  100. Can team rocket’s Meowth evolve (I believe he cannot as there are Rocket’s Pokémon, no team rocket’s Pokémon other than Meowath)?
    Master Trainer Pat: Not yet.

  101. Has or will there be any promo cards made as regulars?
    Master Trainer Mike: dunno

  102. Do you know the color types of the Challenge PCTs yet?
    Master Trainer Pat: There’s a spoiler in Top Deck # 11

  103. How come it takes you guys forever to post chat transcripts?
    Master Trainer Mike: Because there are only 2 of us in the entire company, didn’t you see the earlier answer?
    Master Trainer Pat: And we only use half of the same keyboard.
    Master Trainer Mike: (stay on your side Pat!!!)

  104. Will WoTC make their own cards again like dark Raichu?
    Master Trainer Pat: Possibly…

  105. Will there be a pre-release for challenge?
    Master Trainer Mike: no

  106. Are you guys ever going to create an online way to play the Pokémon TCG (other than apprentice, which stinks!)?
    Master Trainer Mike: I hear something might be in the works but no specifics.

  107. What does the Ancient Mew CARD ACTUALLY do?
    Master Trainer Pat: Ancient Mew is most useful for signaling planes when you’re lost in the woods.
    Master Trainer Mike: also good to carry when you walk at night, makes a good reflector

  108. If there were ever enough promos, would you guys re-release them in an expansion?
    Master Trainer Mike: probably not but not sure

  109. Why is it taking you guys so long to get the rights for Neo?
    Master Trainer Mike: we keep running out of crayons.

  110. If you poll people on Prop15 on your site wouldn’t it be better for you to decide [easier too]?
    Master Trainer Mike: no it would not as the overall metagame and its effects is beyond most casual players.

  111. Do you know if there is going to be a Pokémon league season 3?
    Master Trainer Mike: dunno yet

  112. What sets will be usable in the East Coast Qualifiers / STS?
    Master Trainer Mike: All that have been released in English at that time.

  113. Is there any plans for any other anime card games you will make?
    Master Trainer Pat: Loony Tunes counts, as Anime doesn’t it?

  114. Are all the jungle cards in Base Set 2?
    Master Trainer Mike: No, a few didn’t make the ark

  115. Were you at the Queen Mary for the STS? If so was you at the Erika’s challenge? What was you wearing?
    Master Trainer Mike: We were there.

  116. Will you two be at STS New Jersey?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yup

  117. Why aren’t you making a challenge pre release?
    Master Trainer Pat: Gym is one big set.

  118. Wants to know your opinions on archetypes?
    Master Trainer Mike: they go well with a nice side salad
    Master Trainer Pat: and beans

  119. You guys gonna be at the King of Prussia, PA STS qualifier? If your not, who is?
    Master Trainer Mike: Pat and I won’t be, but the great DSL folks will be there.

  120. Anything new in Gym Challenge or will it just be a “Gym Heroes part 2”? Has WOTC changed the card list translation—as they did with mew in Fossil and Dark Raichu in TR?
    Master Trainer Mike: There might be a card or two you won’t be expecting.

  121. How wills the pre-registration for the STS work?
    Master Trainer Mike: You will be bale to call us here at customer service starting late in October and as long as you have earned 5 badges you can pre-register for the main tournament for the East Coast STS as it will have limited seating.

  122. I’ve heard of younger kids (11-14) taking spots in the 15+ tourney’s at the Qs. Is this true?
    Master Trainer Pat: No, you could not at the Chicago Mall Tour.
    Master Trainer Mike: I have heard that you can move up an age group if they have room but you CANNOT move down an age group, ever.

Master Trainer Mike: Ok, that is it for now, see you all next week!
Master Trainer Pat: Later Guys and Gals!

Thurs. Oct 5, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 3-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers Mike and Pat from Customer Service

Oct 5,2000

Master Trainer Pat: Hi everybody! It’s been a busy week here for us at the Wizards Gym. MT Mike will be joining us momentarily, so I’ll begin with the announcements…

It seems like we may still be having some tech. difficulties, but we’ll see what we can do…

MT Mike and I were able to get a sneak peek at some of the Gym: Challenge cards and we’re sad to report that our good luck with no misprints in Gym: Heroes did not carry over to Gym: Challenge.
Specifically, there are two misprints, which make the cards either unplayable or very weak.

The two cards in question are Blaine’s Charizard and Rocket’s Minefield Gym. Blaine’s Charizard has a Fighting energy symbol on it instead of a Fire symbol and Rocket’s Minefield Gym is missing the number 2 right before damage counters’. On the bright side, the set as a whole has several possible tournament worthy cards, some Pokémon with new attacks or Pokémon Powers that do things we have not seen before.

OK, so now on to some questions, of which I’m sure you’ll have many.

  1. Will gym challenge be available this Saturday at the Pokémon league for sure?
    Master Trainer Pat: I don’t know if it will be available for sure at your location, the Wizards stores and Premier stores should have them though.

  2. Will there be a Gym Challenge prerelease tournament? If so, when and will there be entry fees?
    Master Trainer Pat: None, for Gym Challenge

  3. When is Gym: Challenge being released? The Wizards site has said the 7th, 10th, and 16th.
    Master Trainer Pat: Premier stores and Wizards stores should have them on the 7th, mass-market retailers should get them by the 16th.
    Master Trainer Mike: Sorry but there are no plans for a Gym Challenge prerelease event.

  4. Two weeks ago you said that you can’t “Damage Swap” to Clefairy Doll because it would KO that card. However, in previous rulings (May 11 Q4 & Aug 3 Q55) you said that you can because Clefairy Doll doesn’t count as a KO’d Pokémon. Which is correct?
    Master Trainer Mike: The correct answer is that you CANNOT Damage Swap onto a Clefairy Doll or Mysterious Fossil for that matter, period.

  5. From last week: It’s down to one prize each, your turn with 10HP left, and you’re poisoned. You attack and KO your opponent to draw your last prize. But you take poison damage and would be KO’d now too. Do you win or does it go to Sudden Death?
    Master Trainer Mike:] you win, you must complete the rest of the combat sequence, but then if you win BEFORE the end of the turn, you win, period. Poison doesn’t happen until after the end of your turn.

  6. If you have a Pokémon, which would take 10 recoil damage for each energy of a particular type (say, lightning), would it receive the recoil damage for any attached Rainbow Energy? And how much would it take for a Buzzap’d Electrode?
    Master Trainer Mike: Rainbow energy yes, the buzzaped electrode depends on what type of energy you chose when you buzzap’ed it.

  7. If Misty’s Tentacool uses Crystal Beam on a Pokémon, can an Electrode be Buzzap’d onto that Pokémon?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yes it could, the Crystal Beam ONLY prevents the attaching of energy from your hand (your free normal attachment).
    Master Trainer Pat: We’ll be asking Creature’s specifically about what Crystal Beam will prevent when we next meet.

  8. If “Here Comes Team Rocket” turns all prizes face-up, then if you use TR Rattata’s “Trickery” does the new prize card go face-up or facedown? (My guess is face-up).
    Master Trainer Mike: Face up as you are switching the cards.

  9. Is there any info on neo…? Vending machine promos…or the evil monkey that lives in my closet?
    Master Trainer Pat: The Monkey’s tired of rooming with your skeletons
    Master Trainer Mike: no, but the monkey is getting hungry. FEED HIM FOR GADS SAKE!

  10. Let’s say a confuse Pokémon tries to retreat. I pay the retreat cost but the Pokémon fails to retreat. If I use say a full heal energy can I then pay the retreat again and retreat Pokémon like normal.
    Master Trainer Pat: No, Confusion states you may only try once during that turn.

  11. Can someone be kicked out of the Pokémon league for using bad language and/or insults?
    Master Trainer Mike: Gosh yes!

  12. Hay MTM hop to see you at ECSTS on Saturday. How many wins does it take to get a golden invite?
    Master Trainer Mike: Uh, not sure, I’ve heard usually at least 5-6. Hope to see you there too.

  13. When will the League get Birthday Pikachu, some says that the none holo is out but my Gym Leader has now clue.
    Master Trainer Pat: They’re telling us that B-day Pikachu will be used for one of the first seasons of year 2 of the leagues

  14. Any new news on promos? Or new sets or exclusive American cards?
    Master Trainer Pat: Nothing new other than the release of Challenge soon.

  15. When will you start selling gym challenge on the website?
    Master Trainer Mike: Should be this weekend.

  16. Can I use Magikarp’s rapid evolution to search for Gyarados even if an Aerodactyl is in play?
    Master Trainer Pat: Yes, you can. Check out the text on Aerodactyl

  17. Some weeks ago, my sister asked if ____'s Chansey would be in challenge, yes was the reply. I later find it was cut from the set. What is with this?
    Master Trainer Pat: To my knowledge, every time I’ve been asked that question I’ve answered no, it will not be in Challenge.

  18. Will the league news letter at the PKMN page be updated ever again?
    Master Trainer Mike: Dunno but there is a major site upgrade that will happen on Dec 1st. Check for it.

  19. Now we know that there are major errors on GC cards (as announced by MT Pat), is WotC considering official errata?
    Master Trainer Pat: If a card is rendered unplayable or severely weakened by an error, we will issue errata for that/those cards.

  20. If I bench jungle Scyther after swords dance, is swords dance still in effect?
    Master Trainer Mike: Nope.

  21. When is Gym Challenge available in stores?
    Master Trainer Pat: 7th for Wizards and Premier stores, 8th for Toys R Us and 16th for other stores.

  22. Can I use energy flow to get back a buzzaped Electrode?
    Master Trainer Mike: Sure, it is an energy card at that point.

  23. What would happen on an attack like maybe a TR Oddish used on of its damage less attacks and you used pluspower would it just be wasted?
    Master Trainer Mike: Do you mean if the attack does no damage? Then the pluspower is wasted.

  24. My Pokémon League still hasn’t received it’s Victory Road Supplies yet. Is there a direct number the gym leader can call to see if they can still be shipped? I know the store where the league is held is in good standing with WotC. Please help…I wanted the promo cards and they’re not there,
    Master Trainer Mike: They MUST talk to their sales rep or if they are a chain store, their DM. Every single store has been shipped its stuff!

  25. What are your top five favorite cards from challenge and why?
    Master Trainer Pat: Give us a little while on this one, we’re still just getting them now. For starters…TR Zapdos, Rocket’s Mewtwo, Chaos Gym and B. Charizard look good.

  26. Can Eletrode be energy trans? I know this is an old question.
    Master Trainer Mike: If it is part grass energy, sure.

  27. In the WotC flyer “What’s Playing” it says there will be a “Release Event” for Gym Challenge this weekend (Oct 7th). Won’t this be like the Heros Prerelease Tournament?
    Master Trainer Mike: It was canceled, sorry.

  28. (1) Since there is no Challenge pre-release tournament, and (2) the Challenge cards will not be in full availability until the 16th, does this mean the Challenge cards are or are not legal for the NC STS Qualifier? (BTW, Canadian flag bearer here… /look at Pokémon_John)
    Master Trainer Mike: The cards will be available in most locations so they will be legal that day.

  29. So will the 3 Stadiums be part of the 15 donuts?
    Master Trainer Mike: I plead the 5th on that one.
    Master Trainer Pat: Donuts? Did he say donuts!

  30. I’m trying to help a local store become a league. Presently we have no league places cause toys r us is the only place and they took a break. Is there a toll free number they can call to sign up?
    Master Trainer Mike: Sure, they need to call Merchant Relations. Call us at cust serv at 1-800-324-6496 for details.

  31. Are there any of those dumb "Misty’s Goldeen "rares!
    Master Trainer Pat: I my opinion there are a few ‘lame’ rare’s but I think there are several really cool uncommon that make up for it somewhat. Like Master Ball and Max Revive
    Master Trainer Mike: yeesh, just can’t make everyone happy huh?

  32. Hey MTM … Remember me asking to ask you check the PokeGym? The Contest is there now. I think you should pass it since you all the names of the cards. Lol pokegym.thedojo.com/articles/gc_weekend.shtml
    Master Trainer Mike: Sure! There ya go.

  33. How many places on Blaine’s Charizard are there fighting instead of fire?
    Master Trainer Pat: Just the first attack in the first sentence of the text.

  34. Now I am confused. The rules state a CONFUSED Pokémon can only attempt one retreat per turn. If you play an F.H. energy, it’s no longer confused, and then no longer subject to that rule, right?
    Master Trainer Mike: If you look in the rule book it states “On, tails, the retreat fails, and that Pokémon can’t try to retreat again that turn.” This means that if you attempt to retreat a Confused Pokémon and fail, this status effect goes into place. Whether you remove the Confusion or not, that Pokémon still cannot try to retreat again that turn.

  35. Are you looking forward to getting beat senseless again in the next trivia? (If we have one, please yes!)
    Master Trainer Mike: Me? I seem to recall being the best! I think.

  36. I have heard rumors that there will be another STS for the Central US… is this true, or are there plans to have an STS for any other areas besides the West and East Coast?
    Master Trainer Pat: No news on any others right now, sorry.

  37. Will B’s Charizard, and TR’s minefield be corrected in future printings?
    Master Trainer Mike: Not in the US. It may be corrected for future Base Set runs or foreign printings.

  38. Why is only the Wizards Store the only one that will have a tournament that gives 2 Gym Challenge booster packs? (I guess it is a Prerelease Tournament for Gym Challenge but not confirmed yet)
    Master Trainer Pat: There is no _official_ pre release, individual stores can still do their own events if they want

  39. How will the First Edition Gym Challenges be distributed? Through what store will wizards sale them.
    Master Trainer Mike: Same as normal, evenly spread throughout the market.

  40. How in the world did you fit the left over gym cards into a 132 (126 new) card set?
    Master Trainer Mike: With a Cuisinart.

  41. I’ve heard of and Seen pictures of a Gym Leader Giving away League Promo _____'s Pikachu without the Pikachu sign Sidney. Is it possible for him to have gotten that card other then having a fake?
    Master Trainer Pat: We have not released any outside of those 9 card sets, they were probably fakes.

  42. Will there be any Erika’s Pokémon in Gym Challenge?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yup!

  43. Will there be a Prerelease for the Gym Challenge? If so what will it be? I hope it will be Brocks Ninetails or Blain’s Ninetails.
    Master Trainer Pat: Nope

  44. Earlier you said a prize flipped by here comes tr would go face up to the deck w/Rattata’s trickery. Now, if something happens like tr Mankey’s attack that makes you shuffles your opponent’s deck, would that prize be face down?
    Master Trainer Mike: Wait a minute, I didn’t say the card in the deck would be face up but the new prize card would be. No cards can be face up in your deck.

  45. My local Pokémon league won’t send in the badge reporting forms. The Wizards site says I have 1 badge, but I have 8. Can I get in to things like STS that need 3 badges just by bringing my badges/book along?
    Master Trainer Mike: The league pages are done, they won’t be upgraded again, and it’s canceled. As for your league location, if they are not sending in the forms, please write in to us at custserv@wizards.com and report it.

  46. Will you guys ever have a tour/tournament/sts exclusive to Canada?
    Master Trainer Pat: Not that I’m aware of, if we did something like that, it would be unlikely that it would be exclusive to Canada.

  47. My cool Porygon I got from victory road its promo symbol is littler than all the other promos why is that?
    Master Trainer Mike: No idea, just they way they were printed?

  48. Where did the trainer web pages go?
    Master Trainer Mike: To a happier place, where little lambs dance about.
    Master Trainer Pat: It was too difficult for the DCI to keep up with updates on them, the decision was made to drop them for other content that’s being worked on.

  49. Could you please explain the Dunkin Donut theory, in detail? *Grin*
    Master Trainer Mike: Hmmm, DMT Mike is the purveyor of that particular gem, we thinks he’s a bit funny in the head.
    Master Trainer Pat: Black Coffee+Donut=Happy Master Trainers

  50. MTM when I see you at Braintree, where will you be located at the event?
    Master Trainer Mike: I should be in front of the league zone, look for the tired and balding Master Trainer that’ll be me.

  51. Can you please repeat the announcements? ONCE AGAIN, I forgot about the chat and am late.
    Master Trainer Pat: Yup.

  52. Are there any surprises in gym challenge, like you did with team rocket? You know team rockets Raichu?
    Master Trainer Pat: If we told you it wouldn’t be a surprise, right?

  53. Any promo news?
    Master Trainer Pat: Napes

  54. Any news on neo?
    Master Trainer Pat: Nada

  55. On that site, is that a REAL pic of the Blaine’s Charizard? If so, what is up with it?
    Master Trainer Mike: Which site?

  56. What is the error on TR’s minefield?
    Master Trainer Mike: Missing the number 2.

  57. My local Wizards of the Coast store said that Gym Challenge will come out on Oct. 7 but your site says Oct. 16. Which is it?
    Master Trainer Pat: 7th for our stores and Premier stores, 16th for just about everyone else.

  58. Who do I contact if I wanted to start my own branch of Pokémon league, including getting all the promo cards and supplies?
    Master Trainer Mike: The league is a program run through retail locations only, if you are one, then contact us at custserv for more details.

  59. On the Blaine’s Charizard, do you have to discard a fighting or a fire energy to use the first attack?
    Master Trainer Pat: Lugia see above announcements. Its all there

  60. When will the official rules for the East Coast STS be solidified? (IE. Standard rules, Prop15 and/or T2 enforced, or combinations thereof with a sprinkling of rainbow donuts and apple fritters)
    Master Trainer Mike: It will be announced on Oct 9th. And I would like to take this moment to throw my favorite donut into the ring, which is far superior to these silly maple bars (which aren’t even donuts btw) or apple fritters. I likes chocolate covered Bavarian creme donuts! Heart attack in a donfection.
    Master Trainer Pat: Bean and Cheese BearClaws
    Master Trainer Mike: Err, confection. We can never sit by Pat after he eats those. We won’t say why.
    Master Trainer Pat: Ow quit it.

  61. In GC, what are the six foils that have a non-foil version?
    Master Trainer Mike: There are only 4, the 4 gym leaders cards.
    Master Trainer Pat: They all have the same artwork BTW

  62. Yes, I know there is no prerelease tournament, but will there be a Prerelease CARD for challenge, and what might it be?
    Master Trainer Mike: There is no pre-release card, sorry.

  63. Can Giovanni be use with Pokémon Breeder? Like to evolve Nidoran M to Nidoking on your first turn?
    Master Trainer Pat: No you can’t; though Giovanni says that you can evolve 2 stages if you have the Pokémon necessary.

  64. Hello, I am the Gym Leader for the Pokémon League for Layton UT at Toys R us. I have not received my victory Rods supplies yet and wanted to know if I can get them soon.
    Master Trainer Mike: We shipped out the supplies for ALL Toys R Us stores weeks ago, it is probably somewhere in Toys R Us’s warehouse. Call your DM and demand that he contact us ASAP.

  65. My friend sent me a picture of Blaines Charizard!
    Master Trainer Pat: Right on!

  66. How do we prove that we have 5 badges when we call to reserve our spot for the STS?

  33. Do you think the Pokémon campaign will lose popularity in the void between League years and between expansion sets? If not, what counter-measures has WOTC taken?
    Master Trainer Mike: Any hot property will lose some steam over time. We will continue to support it and encourage game play.

  34. How fast is Wizards making set compare to Japanese?
    Master Trainer Mike: We are playing catch-up.

  35. Mike, have you though of a record? I would seriously think about it. : Evil plan: Mike makes record, and by contract can’t sing at chat:
    Master Trainer Mike: Well, I’ll just say some music is being looked into.

  36. When we are catch up to Japanese, will Wizards release set the same time as Japanese?
    Master Trainer Mike: That is our eventual plan.

  37. Do you have any errata for Year 2–as it differs from Year 1?
    Master Trainer Mike: Not yet, sorry.

  38. Is the CD in the new boxed set the same as the trainer CD, or can you modify the cards?
    Master Trainer Mike: It is version 2, which includes sound effects for all the Pokémon, better training, and a deck builder and collection software

  39. Have you guys decide about the 15 trainer cards or play two trainers cards a turn?
    Master Trainer Mike: For the STS main tournament, no more than 15 trainers in your deck, and no more than 3 copies of any non-basic energy card. But ONLY for that tournament.

  40. How many badges in the year two?
    Master Trainer Mike: 8

  41. When does Year 2 of the Pokémon League start and will Toys R Us have it?
    Master Trainer Mike: Jan 6th and yes, they should.

  42. Do you have your OWN Pokémon card collection? If so, do you already have all the neo cards?
    Master Trainer Mike: I have about half so far.
    Master Trainer Pat: Yes, but I only have a few Japanese NEO cards.

  43. How many points to earn a badge in the year two?
    Master Trainer Mike: Should be the same I think (500).

  44. This has probably been answered a million times already, but how many cards does the Space Weedle contain?
    Master Trainer Pat: I don’t know but we received almost 1000 cards.

  45. What is your best deck and what is the name?
    Master Trainer Mike: I liked the Blaines Charizard deck I played in Braintree and the Koga’s Thread the Weedle deck.
    Master Trainer Pat: Right now I’m running a Blaine’s deck called Krusty Pup.
    Master Trainer Mike: My best deck is still under construction and I will name it George.

  46. What’s your favorite Neo Pokémon?
    Master Trainer Mike: Too early to tell but Feraligatr is pretty darn cool.
    Master Trainer Pat: I have seen that promo Scyther evolution. That’s very cool.

  47. Was the Dark Raichu an American developed card that was added to the Japanese Neo 2 set, or a Japanese card that was allowed to be used as a promo?
    Master Trainer Pat: Dark Raichu was an American developed card.

  48. Are you tired of people asking questions about Neo?
    Master Trainer Mike: Figure we will be soon enough.

  49. Is there going to be a Central STS?
    Master Trainer Mike: No plans yet.

  50. How many seats are in this STS again?
    Master Trainer Mike: The main event can handle up to 1600.

Master Trainer Mike: Ok, so no new questions so we are outta here. Have to go write for Top Deck anyway.
Master Trainer Pat: By gang, we’ll see ya next week.
Master Trainer Mike: see ya!

Thurs. Nov 2, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 3-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers Mike and Pat from Customer Service

Nov 2, 2000

Master Trainer Pat: Hey Poke-fiends and friends! We have some interesting announcements for you this week about some new cards on the way and some ruling clarifications from last week. Realize that many Bothans died in order to get us this information.

All right! Here’s the deal with Ditto and Brock’s Ninetails: When Ditto is opposite B. Ninetails and B. Ninetails has a Pokémon attached to it (that it has Shape shifted into) Ditto _only_ copies the B. Ninetails, _not_ the Pokémon that it has Shape shifted into. If Ditto uses the Shape shift Pokemon Power to attach a Pokémon to it, and then Ditto’s Pokemon Power is turned off some how, the card that is attached to Ditto stays right where it is and doesn’t have any further affect on the game unless that Ditto manages to copy B. Ninetails again. Also regarding Ditto (no surprise there!): If Ditto is copying a Brock’s card and Brock’s Protection is attached to Ditto during this time, the Brock’s Protection card will not go away if Ditto becomes a copy of a non-Brock Pokemon. Whew! That’s it for now… Mike do you have anything?

Master Trainer Mike: Some NEO info! Info on the first upcoming Pokémon Neo expansion. It will be called Neo: Genesis. It will contain over 60 all new Pokémon, including the Baby Pokémon. 2 new energy types (along with some Pokémon) called Darkness and Metal. It will be out within the next few months (no specific dates yet).

  1. What is the next “W” promo?
    Master Trainer Mike: Foil stamped Brock’s Vulpix with issue 13.

  2. When is Pokémon neo coming out?
    Master Trainer Mike: No release dates for Neo Genesis yet.

  3. Neo: Genesis Great name MTM. Where did WotC get it?
    Master Trainer Mike: Kierin is a true Phil Collins fan, he runs around singing from the Tarzan soundtrack.

  4. At the ECSTS what format will the playing field be (not decks. Swiss type?)? How long will it be and when would it start?
    Master Trainer Pat: Swiss. Check the Pokémon page on our site for more info.

  5. Last week, you said that if Brock’s Ninetales uses Shape shift to attach a Muk, Muk’s Toxic Gas power would shut down Shape shift and cause Muk to be discarded (“Muk-B-Gone”). But Shape shift ignores powers, so the Toxic Gas shouldn’t work, correct?
    Master Trainer Pat: Correct. Also, see my announcements from this week for more on Ditto/B. Ninetails.

  6. If Ditto is up against a non-Shape shifted B’s Ninetales, can it use the Pokemon Power to search for an evo card to attach to Ditto (since it’s not truly evolving, I think you can). And when Ditto transforms into something else the evo is discarded, ya?
    Master Trainer Pat: You can’t use the Shape shift power to search. When Ditto copies something else the card that is attached stays right where it is.

  7. How come we do not get a fossil mew? Do we have it another form? Is it promo #8? -
    Master Trainer Mike: Promo #8 and #9 were the Mew cards.

  8. Any word from R&D yet on whether you can play a Sabrina’s ESP on a Ditto copying a Sabrina’s Kadabra? And if you gust up a different non-Sabrina Pokémon, could you still use the attached ESP when you attack?
    Master Trainer Pat: Yes, you can and you could still use it.

  9. A DCE on ditto can be any two Energies right?
    Master Trainer Mike: Any 2 basic energies right.

  10. I have a gold invitation to the STS do I need to pre-register, I don’t right?
    Master Trainer Mike: Correct you do not, a space is held for you as long as you mail in your paperwork

  11. What is the next promo to come out after the vending Pikachu and how will it be distributed?
    Master Trainer Mike: That would be the Foil Stamped Brock’s Vulpix in the next issue of Top Deck.

  12. Is there going to be a Central STS?
    Master Trainer Mike: No plans have been finalized for any new events yet.

  13. If I am using Sabrinas Alakazam and I use Sabrinas Gastly (97-1320 If I use fade out do I return Sabrinas Alakazam or the Sabrinas Gastly to my deck?
    Master Trainer Pat: The Sabrina’s Alakazam and all cards attached to it.

  14. If my wife has a ditto and I have a Blastoise and I play a Goop Gas, does Ditto stop being a Blastoise and goes back to being a Ditto for one turn? I had to sleep on the couch last night because I beat her with this one last night. Plus the argument?
    Master Trainer Pat: We do not advocate Pokémon playing to resolve domestic disputes but. Yes Ditto becomes just plain old Ditto for a turn. Sorry, 'bout the couch man.

  15. When is WOTC starting the online contest for the Happy Birthday Pikachu?
    Master Trainer Pat: We’ve been told Dec. 1st on our website.

  16. Thus far, the announcements about 15-3 for the ECSTS have all been on the Internet. Will those people who qualified but aren’t on the web find out about 15-3 before they arrive?
    Master Trainer Mike: They are all informed by mail as well.

  17. Has the Rocket’s Minefield card been corrected yet?
    Master Trainer Mike: It isn’t going to be. Just play it as if it had a “2” on it for the number of counters.

  18. How much did the Pikachu world collection cost in Sydney?
    Master Trainer Mike: Around $12 US.

  19. How often do we have a Pokémon trivia here?
    Master Trainer Mike: Once so far, they are looking into adding more.

  20. If my opponent has various energies attached to his Charizard, and I play Goop Gas Attack, do they revert to their original states during my opponents next turn?
    Master Trainer Pat: Fire Burn will only change energy types until the end of that player’s turn.

  21. If Brock’s Ninetales has an evolution card attached, and the opponent uses Mew’s Devolution Beam, what happens?
    Master Trainer Pat: I think it would devolve B. Ninetails into B. Vulpix…we’ll check to be sure.

  22. What time does the main event of STS start?
    Master Trainer Mike: 11 am

  23. Why isn’t Team Rocket’s Meowth in the format like Gym cards? And shouldn’t it be Rocket’s Meowth?
    Master Trainer Pat: Because it’s not part of the Gym sets.

  24. I know this might seem weird, but if I had Dark Dragonair out, could I use Evolutionary Light, then evolve it to Dark Dragonite, use Summon Minions, and then use Devolution Spray on it, can I use Evolutionary Light again
    Master Trainer Pat: No you can’t.

  25. Is there ANY way I can get my hands on the “W” stamp Dark Charmeleon?
    Master Trainer Pat: That’s pretty tough from what I understand. We don’t have them here. I think you can only get it in Australia.

  26. Why is Sabrina’s Abra promo in Gym format?
    Master Trainer Pat: Sabrina’s Abra came out after the Gym sets were in wide circulation. Team Rocket’s Meowth came out before those sets were widely available (at least they were shipped to retailers before they were)

  27. Will the whole 9-card Pikachu set eventually be translated in English?
    Master Trainer Pat: The separate cards will be, but the set will not be released as it was at the Olympics.

  28. If team rocket’s Meowth was JUST released right NOW, would there be a pic of Jesse and James on the card? (where the trainer pic usually is)
    Master Trainer Pat: Nope.

  29. In Thunderstorm, does the 3 boosters contain all elec. type cards or mixed?
    Master Trainer Pat: Just regular boosters.

  30. In Thunderstorm what type are the booster?
    Master Trainer Mike: Gym Heroes, Base Set 2, and Rocket.

  31. If my league is part of a chain, and the chain ends the league. Is it possible to have the my league location reopen getting the stuff straight from you?
    Master Trainer Pat: Most chains will be restarting next year for the Leagues.

  32. When are you gonna update the site? Some new stuff are already out and you still haven’t update?
    Master Trainer Mike: the site is getting overhauled and will be updated on Dec 1st.

  33. Will neo contain Energy cards?
    Master Trainer Pat: Probably.

  34. Not anything definite but WOTC is planning to have some kind of big events next year right?
    Master Trainer Pat: Yes, we’re working on it.

  35. In league year 2, can I still earn badges like the soul, thunder, volcano, etc?
    Master Trainer Pat: Most likely not.

  36. Are they going to make the prop 15 3 c perment?
    Master Trainer Pat: I don’t think so.

  37. Why did you call it Metal instead of STEEL like in the game boy game?
    Master Trainer Mike: We were told we had to.

  38. Is there anyway I can get Pokémon Flute, Clefairy Doll, or Revive? Cuz they’re not in BS2 or Jungle.
    Master Trainer Mike: Check out fan sites to try and trade for them (not very useful cards though).

  39. Which kind Electrode is in BS2?
    Master Trainer Pat: The one with the Buzzap Pokemon Power.

  40. Any word on the LEANING TOWER OF PIKA?
    Master Trainer Mike: Won’t make it to the STS. May appear in future Top Deck issues.

  41. Darkness and (Sigh) METAL energy cards are not basic?
    Master Trainer Mike: Correct.

  42. Any word on a US IMAKUNI type person
    Master Trainer Mike: Still in the works.

  43. Will there be TMS year 2 of league?
    Master Trainer Mike: TM’s? No I don’t think so.

  44. Will you guys eventually make the 3-neo sets Japan released?
    Master Trainer Pat: We hope so, but I don’t think it’s all confirmed yet.

45.If Ditto copies a Brock’s Ninetales shape shifted to Dark Arbok, then uses the PP disabling attack on Ninetales, does shape shift go off, making Ninetales and ditto both Ninetales, or does nothing happen because Arbok has no Pokémon power to disable
Master Trainer Mike: Ditto doesn’t copy Dark Arbok, he copies Brock’s Ninetails.

  1. How does one go about setting up a league location (I may have asked this already)?
    Master Trainer Mike: It is only held through retail locations, if you own or run one you can call our merchant relations department and they will help you.

  2. What are the Rare-Holo cards in Blaine, Koga, Giovanni, & Sabrina’ deck?
    Master Trainer Pat: Blaine’s Arcanine, Koga’s Beedrill, Sabrina’s Alakazam and Giovanni’s Persian.

  3. Is there any place online that teaches how to play Pokémon tcg?
    Master Trainer Mike: Sure check our web at www.wizards.com/Pokémon/learn.asp

  4. Are there 1st edition PCDs? I have never seen one.
    Master Trainer Pat: No.

  5. If an attack does enough damage to knock out a Ditto, but the attack also switches the attacker with a Pokémon with more HP (enough that Ditto would have enough HP to survive the attack as that Pokémon
    Master Trainer Pat: If when you’re placing the damage counters on Ditto, he takes enough to KO him. Then he is KO’d.

  6. If I am using Lt. surges Raticate and I do super fang can I use a plus power to add ten damage?
    Master Trainer Pat: Yes, it does.

  7. Sorry for blurting this question out earlier by accident. Do the effects of Rainbow Energy, Potion Energy and Full Heal Energy work on Ditto or the Erica’s Oddish with Photosynthesis?
    Master Trainer Mike: Sure they would work.

  8. With Raindance can you switch water energies on water Pokémon?
    Master Trainer Pat: No, you cannot.

  9. On the letters in our Trivia Competition prizes, did you actually sign that with your own hand? Or was it just copied from a computer?
    Master Trainer Mike: We signed them.

  10. The top 8 players will go into the finals at the ECSTS right?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yup for each age group

  11. Will the tournament at the STS end before the other events that way I can get in on that too?
    Master Trainer Pat: The tournament went pretty late on the Queen Mary. I don’t expect it to be over before the other events finish.

  12. If you play a Blaine Trainer do you have to attach the two energies simultaneously or can you attach one Fire Energy and then attach another one later in your turn, say after you Oak and draw another Energy.
    Master Trainer Mike: You have to play them at that time or not at all.

  13. When I use Blastoises Raindance will I be able to switch the water energy with other water Pokémon (I take an attached energy card from Blastoise and add it to Articuno)?
    Master Trainer Pat: No you can’t. Check out Blastoise’s Pokemon Power.

59.If you use a Blaine trainer, attach 2 fire energies to a Pokémon (with Blaine’s name), then use recycle and it works, can you use the Blaine trainer again?
Master Trainer Pat: Are you sure you’re reading Recycle correctly, Lugia? If it worked, the trainer would be put on top of your deck.

  1. Is there ever going to be Orange League badges in the Pokémon League?
    Master Trainer Mike: Don’t know

  2. Please make a Rocket’s Articuno! Zapdos and Moltres have Rocket versions! And make Pryce’s Articuno in the NEO: Gym sets (I know this is a futile plea but, hey!)
    Master Trainer Mike: What you want, have you ever stopped to think about what we want?

62.Now, what happens if I smoke screen Syther, on his turn he benches and brings out Clefairy does he still have to flip to attack?
Master Trainer Pat: Nope.

  1. If I play a nightly garbage run, can I pick 2 cards from the graveyard and keep the NGR I just played?
    Master Trainer Pat: Nope.

  2. If an opponent attaches an energy card can they put it back in there hand and attach a different energy card?
    Master Trainer Pat: Nope.

  3. How do you get the English birthday Pikachu promo?
    Master Trainer Mike: Starting Dec 1st there will be a contest on our web site or wait until Jan 6th and the 1st season of League year 2.

Master Trainer Mike: Ok, since the questions have stopped and my singing stinks anyway we will cut it a few minutes early. Thank you all for coming! See you back here same Weedle time, same Weedle channel, next Weedle week!

Master Trainer Pat: Take care everybody, we’ll see ya all next week. Later.

Thurs. Nov 9, 2000 - Weekly Pokemon TCG Q&A

Pokémon Online Help
Offered every Thursday 3-5 PST in the TCG Forum of the Wizards.Community chat site!
Featuring Master_Trainers Mike and Pat from Customer Service

Nov 9,2000

Master Trainer Pat: Hello everyone, not much new to announce this week I’m afraid. MT Mike and I are busy getting ready for the East Coast STS next week. That means building new 15/3 decks and packing up the Space Weedle. So let’s get started shall we?

Master Trainer Pat: Yes.

Master Trainer Mike: BTW, check out the latest issue of Top Deck to see a picture of the Space Weedle and see the first puzzle MT Pat and I made.

  1. Any NEO info?
    Master Trainer Pat: Not really, we’ve told you it is on the way, but we don’t have a concrete date yet.
    Master Trainer Mike: I can’t wait to play a Flaafy deck!

  2. Just to clarify Rocket’s Mewtwo - Juxtapose Attack. Since that attack switches Damage Counters, I assume it isn’t affected by Plus Power, Defender, Weakness, Resistance or Pokémon Powers that prevent or reduce Damage from Attacks?
    Master Trainer Pat: Correct.

  3. If Lt. Surge’s Secret Plan is used to put a trainer card face down on the bench, does the card have to be flipped over when Scoop Up is used on it? In other words, does Scoop Up trigger the “Need to Know” clause, since it only returns the Basic Pokémon to your hand?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yes it would, you would have to flip over the Trainer and then the Scoop Up wouldn’t be playable.

  4. Last week’s announcements said that if Ditto vs. Brock’s Ninetales attaches an evo card, “when Ditto copies something else the card that is attached stays right where it is.” Can Ditto still use the attacks on the card or is it just “dead weight”?
    Master Trainer Pat: The card becomes ‘dead weight’ until or if Ditto is able to copy B. Ninetails again.

  5. Last week you were going to check on what happens to a Shapeshifted Brock’s Ninetales if the opponent uses Devolution Beam on it. Any word from the Bothans yet?
    Master Trainer Pat: The devo. Beam would only affect an evolved Pokémon. Since that card that is attached to B. Ninetails is not considered ‘evolved’ to. The devo beam would just affect B. Ninetails or the evolved Pokémon of your choice.

  6. Last week, you stated: “If Ditto uses the Shapeshift Pokémon Power to attach a Pokémon to it, and then Ditto’s Pokémon Power is turned off somehow, the card that is attached to Ditto stays right where it is and doesn’t have any further affect on the game unless that Ditto manages to copy Brock’s Ninetales again.” Would I correct in analogizing it as the card attached to Ditto would be like a Pokémon card with no net effect on Ditto’s abilities?
    Master Trainer Mike: I wouldn’t use that specific analogy (you may be introducing new terminology and that is scary) but your concept is correct.

  7. Is there an official date set for the release of NEO Genesis?
    Master Trainer Mike: Nope.

  8. Can you tell us anything about how Weakness and Resistance will be displayed in Neo: Genesis?
    Master Trainer Mike: Nope.

  9. On Brock’s Nintales. First turn. I attach a Blastoise. Next turn I attach a Charizard (without discarding Blastoise). Is this move legal since Brock’s Ninetales doesn’t explicitly state that I need to remove the Charizard before I attach the Blastoise? Furthermore, if this is legal, Blastoise will remain attached to Brock’s Ninetales but would considered to be a null card because Ninetales can’t use of any of Blastoise’s attacks because Brock’s Ninetales becomes a copy of the latest Pokémon attached to itself.
    Master Trainer Mike: Brock’s Ninetails is a lousy card. Do any of you actually PLAY it? Or are these just mental exercise questions?
    Master Trainer Pat: Yes, you can do what you’re asking, but the end result is the same.

  10. If Brock’s Protection is attached to a Brock’s Pokémon, which attacks Koga’s Muk, could Muk’s Pokémon Power “Energy Drain” still remove an energy (since the energy removal is not caused by the opponent’s attack or by Trainer cards)?
    Master Trainer Pat: Brock’s Protection won’t protect your Pokémon in this case.

  11. I’m a little confused… why does Sabrina’s Kadabra’s Life Drain allow you to place damage counters if it doesn’t do damage?
    Master Trainer Mike: Damage counters represent HP loss, not the same as actual damage done. Think of magic, you could place a -1/-1 counter, which would kill a 1/1 creature OR do 1 point of damage.

  12. Any news on southern islands or vending English?
    Master Trainer Pat: Nothing new yet.

  13. Is Brock’s Ninetails becoming as bad as Ditto?
    Master Trainer Mike: Only when combined with Ditto!

  14. So when Mew’s Devo Beam hits the Brock’s Ninetales, does the evolution card get discarded, or does it go back into your hand along with the Brock’s Ninetales?
    Master Trainer Pat: The card attached stays right where it is and has no further affect unless you re-evolve back to B. Ninetails.

  15. You said that you can have 2 cards attached to Brock’s Ninetales, and that Brock’s Ninetales would be a copy of the last cards attached? If that last card is then discarded, does Brock’s Ninetales become a copy of the other attached card again?
    Master Trainer Pat: Yes, it would.

  16. Would Sabrina’s Kadabra’s Life Drain knock out a Pokémon if it is in a combo with a pluspower?
    Master Trainer Mike: Nope, Pluspower only activates if DAMAGE is done to the defending Pokémon, NOT placing damage counters.

  17. When Koga’s Ditto uses it’s Expand attack successfully, and then retreats to the bench with something like 6 Damage counters it will be knocked out. What I want to know is: does your opponent draw a prize for this, or doesn’t it count as a KO?
    Master Trainer Pat: Yes, they would.

  18. Where will you be at the ECSTS?
    Master Trainer Mike: Pat and Dark Mike and I will be judges again like the West Coast event. Also will be around for playing in our free time too.

  19. Will the Birthday Pikachu card be legalized for tournaments unlike its disqualification in Japan?
    Master Trainer Pat: Nope.

  20. Therefore, the attached but useless cards would return to your deck if you played Mr. Fuji?
    Master Trainer Pat: Correct.

  21. Don’t you think that Chansey is much better as an attacker than as a “staler”?
    Master Trainer Mike: No.
    Will some Pokémon cards be banned from future tournaments?
    Master Trainer Mike: Nope.

  22. If you used Electrode’s Buzzap, could you name ANY energy type, including things like “Cheese Energy”?
    Master Trainer Pat: There’s no such thing as ‘Cheese’ energy. So nope.

  23. Can you do a STS in the Midwest?
    Master Trainer Pat: We’ll see.

  24. Is prop 15/3C being tried out at STS to see if it is good for tournaments or is it not changing?
    Master Trainer Mike: It was primarily made to see the results of trainer limits in competitive play AND to poke you guys into trying new things.

  25. All of these TCG events are in America. Are any events going to occur in the United Kingdom any time soon?
    Master Trainer Mike: They are looking into plans for possible premiere events next year.

  26. Is there any REAL use if Lt. Surge’s Secret Plans can’t be used in the combos Snorlax presented earlier.
    Master Trainer Mike: Use it to bluff but not even that very well.

  27. Would Electrode’s Buzzap work for Steel or Dark Energy types?
    Master Trainer Pat: We believe so, though we can’t give you the official rulings on it yet.

  28. Can Electrode Buzzap to 2 DCE since it does not specify Basic Energy, or maybe Full Heal and Potion and metal and dark with neo?
    Master Trainer Mike: You can choose Darkness or Metal as the type just like you could choose colorless BUT the extra abilities of Darkness and Metal and Full Heal energy CARDS do NOT come with those choices.

  29. And when does the TCG League start in the United Kingdom?
    Master Trainer Pat: Try getting in touch with WotC UK about that one, uk@wizards.com

  30. Mike, how many rounds will the MAIN event be?
    Master Trainer Mike: Depends on how many players partake, probably 7-9 rounds before the finals.

  31. So until Neo: Genesis comes out, it’s illegal to name “Metal” and “Darkness” as energy types for Buzzap?
    Master Trainer Pat: Right.

  32. What hotel will you MTs be staying at?
    Master Trainer Mike: Secaucus Courtyard Marriot.

  33. Why is some 1st edition sign on gym card blurred?
    Master Trainer Pat: Probably just production mistakes.

  34. If the 15/3 format goes well at the ECSTS, do you think we could see it used in other events?
    Master Trainer Pat: We really don’t know yet Magmar2k. We’ll see how thing shake out.

  35. If your opponent Knocks Out the card that was in play as a result of Lt. Surge’s Secret Plan, and it was revealed as a non-Basic Pokémon card, would your opponent take a prize?
    Master Trainer Pat: No.

  36. When the baby versions of Magmar and Electabuzz come out will you have to evole them from the baby? even though it doesn’t say so on the presant cards?
    Master Trainer Mike: You will not have to do that.

  37. If a card is placed face down on your bench due to Lt. Surge’s Secret Plan, and later your active Pokémon is Erika’s Clefable and you attack with Fairy Power and flip heads, can you return that face down card to your hand without exposing it?
    Master Trainer Mike: You have to flip it over when you attack to show what you are doing.
    Master Trainer Pat: You would have to reveal it, that’s what it says on the card.

  38. Why aren’t ______'s Chansey and Imakuni’s Doduo in Gym Challenge?
    Master Trainer Mike: Those are regional promo-like cards. We are not allowed to make Imakuni cards here and ____'s Chansey was just not chosen.

  39. Another thing, are you required to deny all knowledge of the existence of Neo 2 and later sets?
    Master Trainer Mike: No we are not, just don’t have any specifics on them for us yet.
    Master Trainer Pat: Just to let you know…we really have no idea how we’re going to release those here in the States. Honest.

  40. The Gym Challenge Sabrina’s Gastly LV.10, if you add energy you get +10, do you have to take a way HP if you take away energy?
    Master Trainer Pat: Yes, you do.

  41. Who at WotC makes the layouts for the English cards and could they come to the chat along with all you MT’s? (please)
    Master Trainer Mike: Various people in production and R&D do that, not anyone person in particular. They are usually very busy too.
    Master Trainer Pat: You think they’d want to jump in the pit with all you wolves? That’s what we get paid for.

  42. If you use Energy Flow. can you take back non-basic energy cards or the upcoming Darkness and Metal energies?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yes you could.

  43. Can a deck have no trainer?
    Master Trainer Pat: Can a trainer have not deck? (you don’t have to have any trainers in your deck)

  44. Who translates Japanese cards into English for WOTC?
    Master Trainer Mike: We have a translation department and then the licensors still must approve the translations.

  45. What is your favorite type of element to play with?
    Master Trainer Mike: I like to try them all, though to be honest I rarely ever play fighting (Haymaker and Hitmonchan burned me out with that).
    Master Trainer Pat: Probably, Grass or Fire…how about both.

  46. Is there any specific way Wizards chooses cards for Promos?
    Master Trainer Pat: Not really, though if the card wasn’t part of a complete set or it came out in a really small set, it’s a good bet that we’ll use it as a promo.

  47. If you have Ditto out and use Giovanni’s Magikarp’s attack Ancestral Memory, if you retreat next turn and send Ditto back out, could you use it again?
    Master Trainer Mike: No you could not. The Ditto would still remember having been the G’s Magikarp and using that attack once already. It would have to leave play and then re-enter for that to be forgotten.

  48. When Neo comes out, will Rainbow Energy count as Darkness and Metal energy?
    Master Trainer Pat: For the purposes of paying the cost of an attack, yes. Though the additional effects will not be provided.

  49. Will I be allowed to use all my Japanese Neo Cards when they are released in America?
    Master Trainer Pat: Regular rules apply for tournaments, but yeah you should be able to. Do you have a large collection already?

  50. Darkness and Metal will be basic energy types, and yet not basic energy cards? Is that what you’re saying?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yup. They are types of energy (like colorless or grass and fire are) but their energy cards are non-basic cards with extra abilities like Full Heal or Potion energies.

  51. Who do you contact to get the rights of Japanese cards? What is the company name?
    Master Trainer Mike: Various companies own the license. Media Factory, Gamefreak, Creatures, Nintendo, etc.

  52. Is the World Pikachu set an indication that we will see more Promo sets coming out in the future? Maybe Southern Islands and the 9 card Neo Promos?
    Master Trainer Mike: No it does not indicate anything like that.

  53. How likely will there be an STS or equivalent on the West Coast in 2001?
    Master Trainer Mike: No idea gang, still in planning stages.

  54. If you have Ditto and your opponent has Lt. Surges Rattata Lv. 7, and you use Focus Energy, if your opponent retreats for another Lv. 7 Surges Rattata, does Focus Energy stay in effect?
    Master Trainer Pat: Yes.

  55. Where can you find a birthday or a surfing Pikachu?
    Master Trainer Pat: The B-day has only been released in the Pikachu World Collection so far.

  56. Mike will you be taking CHALANGES at the ECSTS?
    Master Trainer Mike: If there is time, yes. They have us all pretty booked up though.

  57. How do I get the “W” stamp Dark Charmeleon?
    Master Trainer Pat: The W stamped D. Charmeleon is another Australia only card we dig those Aussies!

  58. I have heard rumors circulating throughout the underground about a master trainer called “Z”. I heard he is supposed to be one of the world’s greatest masters and will be at the East coast STS. Is that true?
    Master Trainer Mike: He works here at Wizards and if this is him then he is FIRED!!!

  59. If you use Focus Energy, and your opponent retreats for a Pokémon besides Surge’s Rattata that has an attack called Quick Attack, will that attack do more damage?
    Master Trainer Mike: Yup! Works for Ditto/Swords Dance as well.

  60. I think WOTC should have a Pokémon Fan Club like NCL does for Pokémon cards.
    Master Trainer Pat: Unfortunately, we tried to do that early on and were refused. We may try again sometime, I’m not sure.

  61. I have a question about Sabrina’s Golduck. Will Haunter’s transparency prevent damage shift? Can Chancy or Clefable prevent damage moved?
    Master Trainer Mike: Anything that “prevents” all effects from an attack would stop Damage Shift. But something that only prevents damage would not.

  62. If Charizard uses PP Energy Burn, then on my turn I play Goop Gas Attack, are Charizard’s attached energies still Fire or are they reverted back to what they were originally?
    Master Trainer Pat: Charizard’s Energy Burn only lasts until the end of the turn in which they were Energy Burned.

  63. So if haunter successfully stops damage shift, does all the damage to be moved disappear?
    Master Trainer Pat: No, the attack would do nothing, meaning you would not move the damage counters

  64. Chansey’s Scrunch prevents damage from all attacks, powers(such as Dark Golbat’s power), and trainers(such as Digger) if successful, correct?
    Master Trainer Pat: Well, anything that would do _damage?

  65. Was the error on Blaine’s Charizard fixed.
    Master Trainer Pat: Nope.

  66. Will you ever have a contest where the winner gets to make their own card?
    Master Trainer Pat: It’s been talked about although there aren’t any firm plans at this time.

  67. Which of the 8 gym leaders’ trainer cards do you think is the best?
    Master Trainer Mike: I like what Koga’s does the best.

  68. Who is the head honcho at WotC?
    Master Trainer Mike: Vince Calouri, the president of WOTC.

  69. What was your e-mail again?
    Master Trainer Pat: custserv@wizards.com if you want it to get to one of us just put Attn: MT in the subject line.

  70. Will you ever have Pokémon Cards as the prizes in boxes of cereal?
    Master Trainer Pat: I don’t think so.

  71. Who made the Blaine’s Magmar/Misty puzzle?
    Master Trainer Mike: That was an earlier author/editor who is so busy with other projects that we are helping out.

  72. Using Recall, will Energy Loop return the Psychic Energy to your hand with Sabrina’s Kadabra?
    Master Trainer Pat: If you have the correct Abra underneath S. Kadabra.

  73. Does it cost anything to have a DCI tournament?
    Master Trainer Mike: nope

  74. I read in a Topdeck that major supermarkets will have the TCG league. Has it happened yet?
    Master Trainer Mike: Don’t think so.

  75. How do you join DCI, my gym leader didn’t let me?
    Master Trainer Mike: What? If you join the league, you get a DCI membership card free, if they are out of them, have them call their supplier.

Master Trainer Pat: Well, let’s wrap it up for this week Mike.
Master Trainer Mike: Ok gang, its gotten a bit silly (Pat’s fault not mine!!) and no new questions so it is time to call it a day.

Master Trainer Pat: Thanks for coming and putting up with our general nuttiness today.

Master Trainer Mike: So, be here same poketime, same pokechannel next week for more adventures of Master Trainer Pat: Lata.

Nov 9th is the last archived entry.
