Additional FAQ sections that mostly seem composed of single questions from the above chat sessions.

Click on each spoiler to view entire log:

Pokémon Gameplay FAQ - Circa 2000

Pokémon Gameplay FAQ

RULINGS

  1. Metronome rules from the latest R & D meeting this week:
    Whenever Metronome is used to copy and attack that “refers to itself” like Chansey’s Double Edge, does 80 to defending Pokémon AND does 80 damage to Chansey, you would replace the self reference with Clefable or Clefairy. So the attack would read "does 80 damage to defending Pokémon and 80 damage to itself (Clefable or Clefairy).

  2. If an attack does refer to other Pokémon, like Bellsprout’s Call for Family attack:
    Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon named Bellsprout and put it onto your Bench, you would NOT replace the reference with Clefable or Clefairy. So if you used Metronome to copy this attack, you could only search your deck for Bellsprout’s.

  3. Also, when you use a trainer card, first you pay the cost (if any), then you resolve the effect of the trainer card, then you discard that trainer card. So you could NOT use Item Finder to bring itself back from the discard pile (you would discard 2 other cards from your hand, then pull a trainer card from your discard pile to your hand, THEN you would discard the Item Finder).

  4. If a card gives off energy of any type then that card COUNTS as an energy card of that type. This means a buzzaped Electrode that was chosen to give 2-grass energy COUNTS as a Grass Energy Card and can use Venusaur’s Pokémon Power Transfer Energy.

  5. Energy attached to Ditto COUNTS as all-basic energy types at once. So any energy type attached to Ditto could ALSO use Venusaur’s Transfer Energy.

  6. If you have a DCE or a buzzaped Electrode attached to Ditto, then those particular cards would still count as all basic energy types at once but that particular card would give you 2 energy of any type. This means you could use a DCE or the buzzaped Electrode to give you one of two different basic energy types (like 1 grass and 1 psychic). This also means if Ditto is copying, say, a Charmander, you could discard ANY type of energy card from Ditto to pay the Discard COST for the Ember attack.

  7. Clarification on the whole Moltres Wildfire/Confusion thing. When flipping for confusion, you must pay all Attack Costs BEFORE you flip for confusion. This means anything that is written as “IN ORDER TO DO THIS ATTACK,” such as Charizard’s Fire Spin. (Discard 2 Fire Energy card attached to Charizard IN ORDER TO use this attack.) However, anything that does not state IN ORDER TO gets done AFTER the Confusion flip, this means for Moltres’s Wildfire you do NOT discard cards for the effect of the attack until AFTER you see if the attack even occurs.

  8. More clarification for Ditto: His Pokémon Power is continuous–NOT invoked. You do NOT decide what energy attached to him counts as; it simply counts as all basic energy types. When a Pokémon hits the discard pile it reverts back to its normal type BEFORE you count it as a knocked out Pokémon or not. This explains why Mysterious Fossil and Clefairy Doll do NOT count as Knocked Out Pokémon as they revert to Trainer Cards when they hit the Discard Pile. So if you’re Ditto was Transformed into a copy of one of these. It would STILL count as a Knocked Out Pokémon as it would revert back to Ditto when it hits the pile.

  9. Clarification on Team Rocket (since it will be out soon). You can have 4 Charizards AND 4 Dark Charizards in the same deck as they have different names. The rule is that you can only 4 of a particular named card. This also means you could have 4 Porygon AND 4 Cool Porygon in the same deck for the same reason.

  10. Also, Dark Pokémon evolve from Basic Pokémon. There are no Dark Basic Pokémon. Only Dark Stage 1 and Stage 2 Pokémon. Once you evolve a basic Pokémon into a Dark Stage 1 Pokémon, it CANNOT evolve into a non-Dark Stage 2 Pokémon, only a Dark Stage 2. “Once you walk down the Dark Path, forever will it dominate your destiny” - Yoda the non-Pokémon.

  11. A ruling on Metronome and Dark Charmeleon (available in Top Deck #6). Metronome states that it copies that attack except for Energy costs and anything else required IN ORDER TO use that attack. The important part of this text is the IN ORDER TO part. This means that Metronome ignores anything listed in an attacks requirements but ONLY if it has the words IN ORDER TO in its text (such as Charizard’s Fire Spin). If the words IN ORDER TO are NOT part of the text then Metronome does NOT ignore it. So, in the case of Dark Charmeleon’s Fireball text: Use this attack only if there any fire energy cards attached to Dark Charmeleon, Metronome does NOT ignore this condition. This attack was specifically worded this way so that Metronome couldn’t copy it without the Clefable/Clefairy actually having fire energy on it. There will be other cards in the future that will use this same sort of wording to make it hard for Metronome to copy it.

  12. Just so you know, we DO read many of the unofficial Pokémon Online Helpweb sites and their forum cuz we care! We really do! <Was that a bit much? >. Anyhow, we’ve seen that there has been a debate about the Devolution Trainer card. Here’s the official answer; you CAN evolve a Pokémon that you devolved that turn. Playing the Devolution Trainer card has the same effect as evolving as far as removing attack effects but it does NOT count as evolving a Pokémon. So you could devolve a Pokémon, then evolve it that turn, then even Devolve it again! But then you would NOT be able to evolve it again that turn (you only evolve a particular Pokémon once per turn).

  13. Dark Charizard’s Continuous Fireball attack- A Buzzap’ed Electrode that was chosen as fire energy would count as ONE Fire Energy card (and would only give you one flip of the coin).

  14. Dark Dugtrio’s Sinkhole Pokémon Power is assuming a SUCCESSFUL Retreating of the Defending Pokémon. So if that Pokémon were confused, that player would pay the retreat cost, then flip to see if it is successful from the confusion. If it were, THEN that Pokémon would take the 20 damage from the Sinkhole Power.

  15. The Rocket MagicKarp attack Rapid Evolution does NOT count as evolving the Pokémon (just has the same effects thereof). What this means is that if you can RainDance 3 water energy onto it the turn you play the MagicKarp you CAN play this attack and pull out a Gyarados or Dark Gyarados and place it on the Magickarp, THE SAME TURN YOU PLAYED IT. Also Aerodacty; s Pokémon Power would NOT stop this attack from working.

  16. The Dark Rapidash attack Flame Pillar’s extra effect (where you may discard 1 fire energy to do an extra effect) works like the Moltres Wildfire cost as far as Confusion is concerned. You would flip for Confusion BEFORE you discard the fire energy for the extra effect. (Phew)…Lastly my boss Mike and I met some great players and people that work for the Pojo at the Team Rocket Release this last weekend. It was a fun event and you managed to chase away that dastardly Team Rocket.

  17. For the Rocket Magickarp’s attack Rapid Evolution: (Search your deck for an Evolution named Gyarados or Dark Gyarados and put it on Magickarp. Shuffle your deck afterward.) This attack DOES count as evolving Magickarp so it CANNOT be used the turn that Magickarp comes into play (you cannot evolve a Pokémon the turn it comes into play). The reason that this attack CAN be used even if Aerodactyl is in play (Its Prehistoric Power prevents evolution cards from being PLAYED) is that you are not PLAYING an evolution card but pulling one from the deck and using it. PLAYING a card means taking it from your HAND and using it. Also, if Rapid Evolution is Metronomed, the Clefairy/Clefable WOULD be able to evolve into a Gyarados or Dark Gyarados if that player has one of those cards in his or her deck. R&D is also talking with the creators of Pokémon back in Japan about confusion over Ditto and copying attacks like Metronome as well and we will keep you informed of what they learn from them.

  18. After R&D talked with Creatures Inc. in Japan last week, some rules changes (or corrections) that we need to pass on to you. First, for Ditto. R&D has reversed their ruling on Ditto Transforming into Mysterious Fossil or Clefairy Doll. When Ditto as-one-of-these-Trainer-cards is Knocked out the attacking player does NOT get to take a prize card. Many of you initially figured this out and R&D ruled differently. Well now, they are ruling it as you thought. Since Ditto is copying the Mysterious Fossil, it copies EVERTHING from it, including the text that says when it is knocked out the other player does NOT draw Prize.

  19. Now for Devolution Spray. Devolving a Pokémon DOES count as evolving it (again, a reversal on a previous ruling). This means that if you use Devolution Spray on one of your Pokémon you CANNOT evolve it again on that same turn. Sorry if these rule changes are confusing. It just shows again, how nothing is set in stone when it comes to Pokémon. And lastly I would like to thank the two people who have sent in Weedle cards for the Space Weedle so far.

  20. Can energy that has been changed to Fire energy with Charizard’s Energy Burn be moved by TR Charmander’s Gather Firepower?
    Yes, energy changed in this way will be Fire energy till the end of the turn, you can use TR Charmander’s power to move this energy.

  21. If you attach a Plus Power to your active Pokémon and then retreat and then advance that Pokémon, will the Plus Power still be in effect?
    Yes, it will.

  22. If you use TR Porygon’s Conversion 1 to change a Ditto’s(copying TR Porygon) weakness to Grass and then you retreat TR Porygon and advance a Scyther, will the converted weakness still be in effect on Ditto?
    Yes, any effects of attacks on Ditto will remain.

  23. Can Ditto(copying a Gengar) repeatedly retreat and advance so that he can do Gengar’s Curse over and over?
    Yes, every time Ditto advances and copies Gengar he can activate the Curse power.

  24. I was able to look at a translated copy of the Neo rulebook from Japan and it specifically mentions a rule regarding Ditto’s Transform power. It states: If Ditto transforms to the _same_ Pokémon more than once per turn, he is considered to be the _same_ Pokémon. Thus, he would be unable to do Pokémon Powers that can only be used once per turn more than once.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

  1. Are these official answers can they be used in a game, to settle disputes.
    Yes.

  2. What can we do if we don’t agree with your rulings? Is there anyway we can contact WOTC and tell them they are wrong?
    You can email cust serv and we will pass it along BUT R&D have the final say and usually aren’t swayed (even when we offer donuts).

  3. Regarding Moltres: If the opponent does agility does it affect wild fire?
    If Rapidash has the Agility attack, yes, the Agility attack from Rapidash would stop the Wildfire from Moltres (it stops ALL effects from attacks).

  4. Ok, if I have a ditto in play, and the other person has a Clefairy or Clefable, can we do anything (that does damage)?
    It’s a stalemate until someone retreats basically. You could still do the Sing or Minimize attacks though.

  5. If one-player defeats the other Pokémon with Ditto, does Ditto immediately turn back into Ditto?
    No, Ditto turns into a copy of whichever Pokémon it is opposite. It would turn into a copy of whatever Pokémon the other player moved up. (Unless it is asleep, paralyzed, or confused).

  6. Special power, can 3-5 energy cards be attached from your hand when used?
    Yes it could (assuming you have them in your hand), and Blastoise isn’t Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

  7. When electrode uses buzzap, does he count as 2 energy by itself? Or does electrode count as one and Voltorb count as one? This is because of energy removal…
    Electrode counts as 1 energy card that provides 2 energy of the chosen type.

  8. Regarding Porygon’s Conversion 1: How long does the effect last? If Porygon gets knocked out…does the effect wear off? If the defending Pokémon retreats…does it wear off? Or both?
    Conversion effects are removed (as all effects are) when the “converted” Pokémon goes to a Bench. Even if Porygon is retreated or removed, the defending Pokémon is still affected.

  9. My question is also about Porygon’s Conversion attack, if Porygon uses its conversion attack to change the defender’s type to what its strong against what would happen when its attacked by that type? Would they each cancel each other out, would it double damage then take away 30,would it take away 30 then double?
    Weakness is calculated first (damage would be doubled), then Resistance is calculated (you would subtract 30 from the damage total).

  10. Moves that have a Pokémon’s own name in the attack, like Scyther’s swords dance, does it mean ALL Scyther you have in play at the moment? Or does it only affect the Scyther that used it?
    Those particular attacks only affect the Pokémon that used it, Not all Pokémon of the same name, sorry.

  11. Scenario: I have a Fully powered Scyther Active…I have one on the bench…during my turn…I swords dance. During my opponents next turn (who has a F. Magmar) he smokescreens… If I retreat my active Scyther, bring up my unpowered one, switch him back for the powered one…do I hit for 60 w/o having to flip. Or does swords dance get cancelled too?
    When a Pokémon is benched, ALL effects from attacks are cancelled. In this case the Swords Dance effect is cancelled.

  12. According to my earlier question: the wildfire does not directly affect any Pokémon correct? It affects the deck… So things like Agility wouldn’t really make a difference…would they?
    Ok, after a consultation, the answer is that the Rapidash Agility attack would still stop it. Pokémon always attack the other active Pokémon, regardless of where the effect ends up.

  13. Regarding Mysterious Fossil: During a League session I delayed 7 cards at the start…I had no Basics and a Myst. Fossil. The Gym Leaders told me I had to play the Mys. Fossil as a basic while I argued that it should have been a mulligan. Who was right…and is there any limit to the number of times you can mulligan or draw from an opponent’s mulligan?
    You are correct, if you have Myst Fossil (or Clefairy Doll) and ANOTHER basic Pokémon, you can start. They do not count as Basic Pokémon when they are in your hand (they are trainer cards), so if you only had them and no other basic’s, then you would have to Mulligan. As for the Mulligan rule, you keep doing it until each player has a basic Pokémon in his or her starting hand.

  14. Say you have a Charizard as your active Pokémon. You put double colorless energy cards on it. If you use Energy Burn does the DCE turn into 2-fire energy?
    It turns into a card that gives two-fire energy.

  15. Base Set Charizard Pokémon Powers allows you to turn any energy card into fire, so if I attach two double colorless and I use his Fire Spin, which says discard two energy cards. Do I discard both double colorless or only one (it doesn’t say two energy, it says two energy cards)?
    Charizard states you have to discard 2 (fire) energy CARDS. So in this case you would have to discard both DCE cards.

  16. Regarding Evee’s Tail Wag Attack: Would it affect Scythers Sword Dance? (I would assume not since SD affects Scyther and not Evee).
    Tail Wag blocks ALL attacks. Sword’s Dance is an attack. All attacks by Pokémon are “targeting” the defending Pokémon whether they actually affect them or not. Evee’s Tail Wag prevents the defending Pokémon from attacking. However, benching either Pokémon ends this effect.

  17. How do Metronome attacks like Meditate, Water Gun, Hydro Pump work? Do you copy the base damage or do the effect too?
    Metronome copies the base damage, you would need additional energy on Clefairy/Clefable to do additional damage with those copied attacks.

  18. When Mew uses Devolution Beam on one of your opponents Pokémon, do they have to wait a turn before evolving that Pokémon?
    Yes, as long as the base Pokémon has been in play one turn your opponent can revolve his Pokémon.

  19. Do you have to attack if you have enough energy cards attached to your Pokémon?
    No, you always have the choice whether to attack on your turn or not.

  20. Are you allowed to have as many DCE as you want in a deck like normal energy or only four like any other card?
    Only 4 max, it is NOT a basic energy card (the only type you can have more than 4 of in your deck).

  21. Clefairy Doll here . . . Situation: Hitmonchan vs. Mime. Hitmo has 2 plus powers attached. He jabs mime for 20. Is this considered a KO, or do plus powers add 20 to the attack itself (for 40) and so fail due to Mime’s wall?
    Trainer card effects are added before Pokémon powers are figured, so the attack would do 40 total, which Mr. Mime’s Power would negate.

  22. Does Fearow’s Agility attack block Kangaskahn’s fetch?
    Actually it does not, Fearow’s agility says stops damage done to Fearow, and the Fetch just draws a card. This is the new ruling from R&D.

  23. Can the switch card be used to retreat a paralyzed, confused, or sleeping Pokémon?
    Yes, it can, the Trainer (you) plays NOT the Pokémon, a Trainer Card NOT the Pokémon, so it being Paralyzed, etc. does not stop a Trainer Card’s effects (generally).

  24. Can you Raindance onto a Shifted Venamoth?
    Yes you could do that.

  25. If I use Charizard’s Energy Burn on some Grass energy could I still use Venusaur’s Energy Trans on them, and if Charizard is confused, paralyzed or asleep and he had some energy burned cards on him would they still be burned or would they change back?
    Ok, 1st if the energy is changed to Fire energy then Venosaur can no longer Energy Trans them (they are no longer grass). If Charizard is paralyzed, etc. then the energy reverts (it also only changes to fire for that turn only).

  26. The potion card says to remove “2 damage counters”, some people play with 10 and 30 point damage counters. SO: Can a regular potion take off two 30point damage counters or just 20 damage total? And can you place energy on a mysterious fossil?
    Ok, whenever a card or effect or attack mentions damage counters, it is always assuming a counter to be equal to 10 points of damage.

  27. Snorlax’s Pokémon power says that it cant be paralyzed, poisoned, confused, or put to sleep, so why does it say that the power stops working if its paralyzed, confused or put to sleep?
    Well, say Muk was in play, all Pokémon Powers stop working. Snorlax gets confused, then Muk leaves play, and his power can’t turn back on until he is no longer confused.

  28. What happens if the opponent benches the Pokémon after the fossil Magmar uses smokescreen?
    Since that attack references the opponent’s Pokémon, if he benches it, the effect is removed.

  29. If you have a defender on a Chansey, and you use double edge, is 20 of the damage to Chansey prevented?
    Yes, it would be. Defender will protect your Pokémon from attacks form your opponent AND from your own attacks while it is in play.

  30. Can I lay a double colorless energy and another energy down on the same turn?
    No, you can only attach 1 energy card per turn.

  31. Does Magmar’s smokescreen still works if I switch Pokémon?
    Yes, it would. It references the opponent’s active Pokémon. If he benches THAT, the effect ends.

  32. If you have used Scythers swords dance and your opponent uses a gust of wind on your next turn you retreat the active Pokémon and put Scyther back out does it do 30 or 60
    If you retreat Scyther, of course, Swords Dance is canceled. So if he Gust of Winded, same thing.

  33. If one of your Pokémon was poisoned, and a few turns later it is KO’d by the poison, does your opponent take a prize card although the poison KO’d the Pokémon and not your opponents Pokémon? And what if you’re own Pokémon knocks itself out?
    Yes, he would still draw a prize card. Whenever a Pokémon in knocked out, the other player gets prize cards even if you knock out your own.

  34. If my opponent has an active Ditto and I switch my Pokémon, is ditto my new Pokémon, or Ditto with 50hp?
    Ditto always turns into a copy of whatever Pokémon he is facing when he is the active Pokémon (and not paralyzed, confused, or asleep).

  35. How long does Porygon’s conversion attack (changing weakness) last?
    It lasts until the Pokémon it was used on is benched.

  36. Is Porygon’s Conversion 1/2 canceled if Porygon or your opponents Pokémon is knocked out or benched?
    If the opponent’s Pokémon is benched, the Conversion effect ends, it doesn’t matter if Porygon is.

  37. Would Magmar’s Smokescreen stop Kangaskhan’s Fetch?
    Yes, it would since Fetch is an attack.

  38. If my Clefairy does metronome and I do Chansey’s double edge attack…does Clefairy do 80 damage to itself
    Yes, it does.

  39. Why doesn’t the Energy Search card tell you to show the card to your opponent?
    All moves in the Pokémon game, are public knowledge. You do not hide what you are doing.

  40. If a super energy removal is used on a Dragonair with two double colorless energies, do you remove one, or both?
    Your opponent can remove up to 2 energy CARDS, so he could take off both DCEs.

  41. Can fossil Gastly use his energy conversion to retrieve double colorless?
    Sure, he can retrieve 2 energy CARDS, either or both could be DCE’s.

  42. Does Mew do 10 times the energy card on the defending Pokémon or 10 damage for each energy card on the defending Pokémon?
    Does 10 damage times the number of Energy cards attached to the Defending Pokémon.

  43. If you use an attack that puts your opponents Pokémon to sleep (like haunter’s nightmare), and the defending Pokémon was already asleep before you attacked, Do you still have to flip a coin after the attack to see if it wakes up?
    Yes, they get to flip at the end of each player’s turn.

  44. If Mr. Mime is played against a Mewtwo with 20 damage on it, and uses Meditate, does it do ten, doubled, plus 20, or 10 plus 20, doubled?
    You calculate the base damage first, then double it for weakness, so 60 points damage total.

  45. Can you evolve a Pokémon right after Mew devolves it or do you have to wait a turn?"
    If you devolve your own, you just did an attack and your turn is over. If you devolved the opponent’s Pokémon, he can evolve it on his turn.

  46. If a mysterious fossil is the only “basic” card you have at the start of a game, does it count as a basic or do you have to shuffle and try again?
    You have to reshuffle, it counts as a Trainer card when it is in your hand.

  47. Does Charizard’s energy burn change an energy forever…or until the end of the turn?
    The energy changed using Charizard’s energy burn only stays fire energy until the end of the turn.

  48. Can I use Tentacool’s cowardice as many times as I want?
    No, once you scoop Tentacool back into your hand, you could put him on the bench again, but you can’t use the power the turn Tentacool comes into play.

  49. Can you use energy transfer after Charizard has energy burned a grass energy?
    No, since that energy was changed into fire energy (until the end of the turn), Venasaur can’t energy transfers it.

  50. Ditto is out against (F) Magmar. Magmar uses smokescreen. Then the trainer with ditto uses gust of wind and puts a different Pokémon out does Ditto still have to flip to attack?
    Yes, it does. The Smokescreen attack only references the defending Pokémon (in this case Ditto). Benching Magmar does NOT remove this effect (though benching the Ditto would).

  51. I was playing a game at the Pokémon TCG League and the kid used a Ditto. He transformed into my Electabuzz. I eventually did 60 damage to it so the Ditto had 50 damage. I than retreated and sent in a Hitmonlee, shouldn’t it have been KO’d. I though
    You’re right it should have, Ditto would have turned into the Hitmonlee (which only has 60 HP), since you had already done 60 to it, and Ditto would have been knocked out.

  52. If I have Zubat up and retreat him, can I bring him back as active or do I have to bring up another benched Pokémon?
    When you retreat a Pokémon, you are swapping it with another on the bench. So in this case, Zubat goes to the bench, and you bring up a different Pokémon from your bench.

  53. Is it legal to have a deck with absolutely no Pokémon so that you mulligan and the opponent will draw cards till he looses?
    It is legal but the opponent has the choice of drawing 2 extra cards, he does not have to. So what would be the point? The game would never start.

    No but it only lasts until the end of the turn.

  901. If my Pokémon use Agility and get heads then on my opponents tern he benches his Pokémon does that end and if that Pokémon was knock would agility be still their for the next Pokémon that he sends up.
    Since the Agility Attack references Rapidash, only benching or evolving him ends the effect.
    Also since it only refers to Rapidash it would still be effect if the other player benched.

  902. Is Tentacool and Alakazam a good damage removing strategy via Pokémon powers moving 20 damage to Tentacool then removing him from play then playing him again then repeating it until all damage is gone?
    Yup, saw someone use that at the Seattle Mall Tour. Good idea.

  903. What do I do when I use an Energy Retrieval, do I discard the card do I trade to the discard pile or put in my deck?
    You trade it to your discard pile (essentially discarding it) to pull 2 basic energy from the discard pile to your hand.

  904. Can you lay a energy that’s basic and another that isn’t on the same turn?
    Nope.

  905. Can you use the Trainer Pokémon Breeder to evolve a Basic Pokémon into a Dark Stage 2 Pokémon?
    Sure.

  906. Can you use the attack Call for Family just to shuffle your deck?
    If you have one of the Pokémon in you deck you must put it on the bench. If you don’t (even if you know you don’t), you could still use the attack, look and not find the card, and then shuffle your deck.

  907. If you have a Kangaskhan in play and want to retreat it (retreat cost of 3) and the only energy you have on it is 2 double colorless energy cards, what happens?
    You would have to remove both DCE’s.

  908. Can you use cards that let you search for Pokémon (like Pokeball) to get a Dark Pokémon?
    Sure.

  909. My opponent’s active Pokémon is Vulpix, on his turn he attaches Clefairy Doll to Vulpix and says Clefairy Doll will “shield” Vulpix (take all damage) from my next attack. Is this correct?
    Not at all. You cannot attach Clefairy Doll to any Pokémon.

  910. Dark Charmeleons attack states that the attack may only be used if any fire energy is attached. Does this mean that Rainbow energy doesn’t work?
    No, Rainbow energy can count as fire energy.

  911. If you have two different basic Pokémon on your bench, can you evolve them both on the same turn (assuming it’s not their first turn on your bench)?
    Sure.

  912. If Dark Charizard is confused, and it’s tails and does 20 to itself, it doesn’t discard any energy right?
    Correct.

  913. Anytime during a battle, is you, or your opponent allowed to shuffle your deck?
    NO!

  914. Can you move 40 damage to Mr. Mime with Damage Swap and will it be prevented?
    Mr. Mime’s Invisible Wall only protects against attack damage, not damage moved there from a Pokémon Power.

  915. Earlier I asked about the fire energy only on Dark Charmeleon. If Rainbow Energy works, then what is the card referring too?
    It is worded that way so the other player could NOT Metronome that attack without fire energy (or a rainbow energy) being attached to the Clefable/Clefairy.

  916. Let’s say I have a promo Eevee and I go second. On my opponents second turn he evolves a Pokémon can I evolve Eevee?
    Sure.

FAQs Continued:

Click on each spoiler to view entire log:

Pokémon Tournament and League FAQ - Circa 2000

Pokémon Tournament and League FAQ

ANNOUNCEMENTS

  1. Here is lots of info on the upcoming Super Trainer Showdown. When: July 22,2000 10 am- 7 PM Where: The Queen Mary Long Beach, CA. What is it? A Swiss Style Invitation-only tournament for 3 age division: age 10 and under, 11-14 years old, and 15+ and up.

  2. How do I earn an invitation? There will be qualifying tournaments at each stop of the Pokémon Mall Tour, which is listed on our web site. The top 10 ranked DCI Pokémon players will get an automatic invite. There will be International Invitations in each country to be earned/given out.

  3. And lastly, ANYONE who has earned 3 or more badges in the Pokémon league can take part! Other stuff: There is no admission to take part and there are lots of cool prizes to be given, including the winner of each age group will be given the “Master Trainer Champion” title!

  4. We are working on East Coast stops for the Pokémon Mall Tour, which should include Qualifying events for the Super Trainer Showdown in July in Long Beach, CA. Remember though, if you earn 3 badges through the Pokémon League, you can also be in it.

  5. We are aware of several misprints in the Team Rocket set. Any misprints that DON’T effect game play (such as Arbok’s 23000 copyright, Rapidash missing the word “length”, and the non-foil Dark FDragonite incorrectly numbered as 5out of 82, and Dark Raichu’s incorrect “Put Raichu on Pikachu” instead of Dark Raichu) will all be corrected in future print runs. The misprints that DO affect game play (The non-foil Dark Vileplume having Fighting as its Weakness and Grimer having a Poison Gas attack that puts the other Pokémon Asleep) will NOT be corrected. The game play effect misprints will be played as is, on the cards. When playing in an English League or Tournament, you will play these cards as is. If playing in an International event, then the cards will be played, as they originally should have been. This will be announced at those events beforehand.

  6. Pat and I (Mike) and our boss (Mike) will be at the Mall Tour Stop at the Sea-Tac Mall this weekend as well. Feel free to stop on by and show us your deck and try and stop Boss Mike’s “fearsome” Mr. Yuk deck!

  7. The STS Invitational Tournament (main event) will include three age categories: 10 & under, 11-14, and 15 and up. You must bring your badge book with three stamps, or invitation from a tournament win to participate in the main event. The event is Swiss format. Every player in this tournament will receive a minimum gift of a tee shirt and Tournament certificate.

Three first place winners (one from each age division) will receive a Gold Medal, 32 boosters, and a “Master Trainer Champion” Event Jacket and Cap. Three-second place winners (one from each age division) will receive a Silver Medal, 28 boosters, and an Event Jacket and Cap. Six third place winners (one from each age division) will receive a Bronze Medal, 20 boosters and an Event Jacket and Cap. Twelve fourth place finishers (four from each division will receive a Tournament Plaque, 16 boosters, and an Event Cap. Twenty-four fifth place winners (eight from each division) will receive a Tournament Certificate and 12 boosters. Forty-eight sixth place winners (16 from each division) will receive a Tournament Certificate and 8 boosters. Four hundred Sixteen runners up will each receive a Tournament Certificate. The 10 and under and 11-14 categories will be required to play with Base set and Jungle cards only.

The 15 and up category can use cards up to and including the Team Rocket set. There will also be King of the Hill Tournaments and various other side events. There will be NO admission fees charged for this event.

  1. Mall Tour changes: The June 24-25th Mall Tour stop in Oklahoma City has been changed to Houston, TX. The correct location for this event will be: The Woodlands Mall, 1201 Lake Woodlands Dr., and Houston

  2. Most of you have probably already heard that the STS format changed for the 2 youngest age groups. Here is the letter that is being sent out:

Dear Master Trainers,
Its true! Due to amazing customer feedback we have decided to add these two sets into the Pokémon card sets that can be used at this event in July. All age groups will be able to use Base Set, Base Set 2, Jungle, Fossil and Team Rocket. In addition all promo cards that have been released in English can be used as well. We feel that this will create the most exciting and interesting play experience for all the master trainers coming to the Super Trainer Showdown. Good Luck, Master Trainers, and have a great time!

  1. The STS will be a DCI Sanctioned event meaning some of the shenanigans we’ve heard about at some of the Qualifying events will NOT be allowed. If you are unsure of what the DCI rules for Pokémon Tournaments are check them out on our web site.

  2. Here is the TENTATIVE East Coast Mall Tour schedule. It is still being worked on and will most likely change but we wanted to give you an idea anyway:
    August 26-27 Troy, MI
    Sept 9-10 Towson, MD
    Sept 16-17 Cincinnati, OH
    Sept 23-24 Schaumburg, IL
    Sept 30-Oct 1 Independence, MO
    October 7-8 Alpharetta, GA
    October 14-15 Braintree, MA
    October 21-22 King of Prussia, PA
    October 28-29 Nanuet, NY
    Nov 4-5 Miami, FL

  3. Secondly Wizards is investigating the “alleged” incidents that took place at the Dallas STS qualifier. We cannot comment any further on this at this time.

  4. And last, we want to clarify about the STS. It is not a DCI sanctioned event (since it is tied in so closely with the Pokémon League) but it WILL follow and be run using the DCI floor rules along with the judging system.
    FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

  5. How can I tell where tournaments are being held?
    Check on our web site at events.wizards.com/dcitournament/Default.asp?game=PK

  6. Where will I get a dark Gyadose. Will I get it at the Pokémon league? there was none last week since it was Easter?
    The Pre-release Dark Gyarados’s were given out at all North American League locations last Saturday. If your location didn’t have any, call and check again, they might have been delayed.

  7. How do you join the league? I’ve looked on the website?
    Go to the closest league locations (such as Toys R Us) and sign up there. We have a list of all locations on our web site.

  8. What are the rules on foreign cards in DCI play?
    You can use cards that are copies of already released English cards only. And you must have at least 1 English copy with you for translation purposes.

  9. I’ve heard about a website that trainers can look up their own stats. Is that true? And If it is, what is the website?
    The web site is events.wizards.com/pARRanking/ . Keep in mind it takes us a while to get your stats in so it may be a bit behind.

  10. How much is it to join the Pokémon league? Is it free?
    Each location is different, most are free, some charge up to $5. Check your local location.

  11. How come the people who run the league at the wizards of the coast store charge a $1 every week to lay and $5 for a badge book when both of these are free at Zainy Brainy?
    It actually costs the stores money for the league supplies. Larger chains can probably afford to pay for it, and smaller stores probably cannot.

  12. Hey; I was wondering, what your plans were for the people who collected all 8 badges and 16 tms at the end of the Pokémon league and also when it is over will you guys be making a new league with the 16 badges and new tms from gold and silver?
    Hmmm, well we are still working on the plans for what happens at the end of this league (ends this July or so). Beyond that, we are still working on it.

  13. Are promos legal in tourney and league play? At one league store they say they are and at another they say they’re not?
    Promo cards are legal in tourney and league play (English promo cards that is).

  14. At my local Pokémon league, they gave away boxes and boxes of Mews (I got 64). Were they allowed to do that?
    Well, we did send out quite a few copies to make sure you all could get one. Exactly how they gave them out (as long as they are free) is up to each site.

  15. I’ve been to the Pokémon League personal web page and I want to know about the prices of cards and purpose there for do you send them to us or are they there just for show?
    They are just for show.

  16. Do you know if there are any plans to have Pro Tour type events with large prizes? Or is this the wrong person to ask?
    There are no plans for a Pro Tour yet. We are working on tournament formats for the future though.

  17. Any idea of plans for DCI accrediting of Pokémon Judges any time soon? I would assume that would go hand-in-hand with the tournament formats in the works? A customer service rep once told me that WotC considers Pokémon primarily oriented towards ‘casual’ play, but how can there be ‘serious’ play without accrediting and professional formats?
    Good question. There are no plans for official accrediting of Pokémon Judges at this time.

  18. Can online tournaments be sanctioned if the tourney director is a DCI judge?
    We don’t have any plans for sanctioned online tournaments at this time.

  19. Why do none of the Pokémon tours come to Canada?
    We are still working out this year’s Pokémon tour dates and locations, so I don’t know about this year’s yet. I believe the choices are made based upon population and mall interest.

  20. What plans are there for future Pokémon league giveaways?
    You join the League to earn your Pokémon badges. Anything else is just extra, it happens when it happens.

  21. I have agreed to run our Pokémon League’s first tournament in a month or so. Do you have to be a DCI member to be either the organizer or the head judge? In a related vein, is there a way to become a DCI member online, or only at existing tournaments?
    If you organize a tournament you automatically get a DCI number. Otherwise, you can get a DCI number through a tournament or through the League.

  22. What’s going to happen to league after all the cities have been traveled to?
    The League is in over 2700 locations in North America every week. If you mean the Mall Tour it is still being set up for this year.

  23. I am a DCI Member how come my personal web page won’t work?
    There are many thousands of league members and we are putting up your information as fast as we can. There is a bit of a lag though.

  24. How come the Pokémon tours always stop in NJ and not NY? So far only 1 tour has stopped in NY.
    Since the tour is so big, locations are based upon a mall’s willingness to host it.

  25. When do the seasons start of the Pokémon League?
    Different League locations are on different schedules, but I think season #4 should be starting soon.

  26. Will DCI sanctioned Pokémon tournaments allow Base Set 1 and Jungle Set after the release Base Set II?
    Yes, they will.

  27. How do you receive pre release Aerodactyl from a league?
    That card was sent out to Leagues last year. We do not have any more of them. Check the secondary market.

  28. Is there additional info on running DCI tourneys aside from the technical rules and regs available online?
    No, sorry there isn’t. I would contact others that have run tournaments and get their input.

  29. In The League, will Base 2 cards count towards completing the Base or Jungle Sets or must I complete Base 2 separately?
    No, they are different sets with different collector numbers.

  30. Will the web site continue to tell consumers about upcoming promos like with Mew and Jigglypuff?
    We certainly hope so.

  31. Can I get the Mew anywhere else besides the League?
    Like any card you can try to trade someone for a Mew if you were unable to get one at the Leagues.

  32. If I use Scotch tape to tape up one of my worn out card selves, will it be considered as “marked” in a Pokémon tournament?
    Yes, it would, sorry.

  33. Do you know of any stores that regularly host tournaments in the Seattle area? It seems like top-rated players talk of playing every week in a tourney though it seems around here (Seattle) it’s hard to find tourneys (ironic in the home of WotC).
    Have you tried our Game Center in the U district? I know they run them frequently.

  34. Do all Toys R Us 's have to have Pokémon Leagues? What if they don’t?
    In the US, yes.

  35. Do I have to have energy in my deck to play a DCI sanctioned tournament (ex: Super Stall with intent to deck opponent)?
    You don’t have to…how exactly are you trying to stall your opponent?

  36. How many badges are there total? So far I have seen 6 or 7 so far?
    There are 8.

  37. How does a store sign up to run Pokémon league at their location? (I want to run league at my store.)
    You would contact our Merchant Services department at 1-800-821-8028. They can help you with that.

  38. Do you have to sign up for the league to get the Arcanine promo card (my league is full)
    Probably, check other league locations in your area if that one is full.

  39. In DCI sanctioned tournaments can I discard a card because I don’t want it because it was an evolution I only had 1 of?
    No.

  40. Any plans for another Pokémon Card Tour (like current Stadium tour, but for TCG)?
    There will be a mall tour this year. I think they’re finalizing the schedule now.

  41. Are there any restrictions to using the “paper” coins that come with the preconstructed decks in tournaments or league play. ie: if they become worn, with curled up edges?
    None yet. When you start weighing one side down, I suppose we’ll have to do something.

  42. I have a Pokémon League question. My kids just finished up their first 6 weeks or “season”. Since they are new to this, they were unable to earn enough points to get a badge. Are these points now lost? Will they have the opportunity to get this back?
    They keep their points and continue working on badges until they get it. Then they start on the next one at that time.

  43. How long is each season of Pokémon TCG League?
    Generally 6 weeks.

  44. Any plans yet to have Wizards organize more ‘serious’ Pokémon gameplay, such as providing a means to become authorized DCI Pokémon judges, etc.?
    Again not that I am aware of. Pokémon is seen as a more introductory game into the world of TCG’s and strategy. Other games like Magic, or Star Wars, or 7th Sea, is a good place for people to go looking for more serious gameplay.

  45. If I did host a tournament for Pokémon, would it be counted as an official DCI tournament?
    If you get it sanctioned yes. Were have informational and the forms needed to get an event sanctioned available on our web site.

  46. Anyway to start an official Pokémon league without a store sponsor?
    Unfortunately, not at this time.

  47. Regarding the Pokémon League, is there a basic outline as to how they are run, or is it up to the location? Some I’ve seen only allow 12 and under to participate, while others don’t. Some give out Promos upon arrival, others when you get so many points, etc.
    This stuff is really up to the store or chain in question. We provide guidelines and suggestions, but every store has a different way of doing those things.

  48. Yesterday I received the new promo Mewtwo in the mail. Can I use it in a DCI tournament this weekend?
    If you’re talking about the movie Mewtwo, then yes.

  49. What is going to happen to the league after the seasons are all done and all the badges have been collected?
    Well, I do know that they are working out the logistics for a possible 2nd season. That’s all I know so far.

  50. Some of the gym leaders who run the league don’t know squat about the game, so many times I got screwed cause of it
    If you feel that the league location you go to isn’t being run well, first volunteer to help them run it. It’s a lot of work! Secondly you could talk with the manager of the store and thirdly you could email us about it as well.

  51. Speaking of Leagues and Gym Leaders unfamiliar with the rules and all… this was asked last week, but I think it was Pat who answered. In your opinion, what would be the best way for the masses (us) to impress upon WotC that we would like to see some sort of Pokémon Judge accreditation program, like MtG has? I think this would be a great step towards having Pokémon treated as more than just a ‘casual’ game.
    Well, pass along commentary to this forum like you have, send letters or email to WOTC but to be honest, I don’t ever see Pokémon being seen as more than a casual intro to strategy TCG games game. There are so many other higher level strategy TCG games out there, why would you want Pokémon to have banned/restricted lists, accreditation, etc? Most of the players are younger children that would have no chance against a hard-core card flopper, how fair would that be?

  52. I have a complaint about the Pokémon League I go to. Where should I send e-mail to Wizards about it?
    Send it to custserv@wizards.com and we will look into it for you.

  53. IF I REGISTER IN ONE OF THE LOCAL STORE, CAN I PLAY EVERYWHERE I WANT?
    Yes you could, though if you play at a location that is a season behind where you are at, they can let you earn points there, but you would need to go back to your original location to get the later badge.

  54. Is it Ok to use proxy cards with the original (like a Charizard) next to the deck in a top loader?
    As far as I know, proxies aren’t allowed in league or sanctioned events. Amongst your friends is up to you.

  55. I was reading the things set up a DCI tournament but I don’t know if you have to be approved in any way (I know you do for magic or to judge it)
    Not really, if you want to run a sanctioned event, you must submit the forms shown on our web site a few months in advance of the event and of course have space set up for the event.

  56. I read on www.wizards.com/Pokémon about a TCG tour in the UK. Will there be one in Ireland and if so, will they give out promo cards?
    Not sure, I would write to UK@wizards.com and ask them.

  57. How long does it take to have a personal trainer page on PAR?
    It should be up within 2-4 weeks after you earn your badges. If not, please ask your league to resubmit your DCI membership card information. Many leagues are not sending this in.

  58. ARE GYMLEADERS Allowed to give kids gym leader shirts for 20 dollars a piece and let them be gym leaders and give out free stamps to anyone that they want to?
    I don’t think so…

  59. How do you become a gym leader?
    You can become a coach by taking the coach’s test at the Pokémon Leagues, but to become a Gym Leader you have to work for one of the League Locations.

  60. So is the DCI number for LEAGUE and TOURNAMENT? And if it is for Tournament, how do we get tournaments in our area? I have not seen any yet!
    Yes, it is the same number for both. Check our tournament listings on our web site at events.wizards.com/dcitournament/Default.asp?game=PK. Just enter your state and change it to future events.

  61. So what if you have like 5000 points in the league already? Do you automatically get 2 mews?
    Nope, you start earning new points for the Mews when they come out.

  62. In the Official rules & regs for the Pokémon TCG League does it state anywhere that you may not battle a person twice in a row & still get the points earned? Can a Gym Leader make such a rule? We’re talking about 6 & 8-year-old boys here.
    Yes it does. It is stated in the rules that the Gym Leaders are being given.

  63. Where can we get more information about the Brock and Misty Challenge, if our league hasn’t heard about it yet? Or when will it begin at ALL the leagues?
    If it is not there yet, it should be there soon.

  64. My Pokémon Trading Card League Location allows trainers to battle a trainer up to three times. Is that legal?
    Nope, you are supposed to play a different Trainer after each match.

  65. How can I get a copy of the rules that the gym leaders are given so we don’t have any more surprises?
    Those are only available for the League Gym leaders. If you think that something is run awry, give us a call at Customer Service (1-800-324-6496).

  66. I registered with DCI at session 1 and haven’t seen my number on the DCI rankings (number is not valid) or some thing. Should I reregister we have a new gym leader I don’t know if the old gym leader sent them in?
    Yes you should reregister (but put your old DCI number on the form).

  67. Were there any world tournaments for Pokémon last year or was there something like that?
    There was the Tropical Mega Battle in Hawaii.

  68. What was that like? Did it have tournaments or was it just a show? And who won?
    We have several articles about it on our web site just search for Tropical mega Battle on our web site.

  69. Ok I am a gym Leader and is there any way to become an Elite Four Leader? Or is there such a Leader for the League?
    Not that I’ve heard of.

  70. What do you think of the thefts going on in many TCG tournaments, is Wizards taking steps to make TCG events a little safer for your cards?
    Of course we aren’t happy about that. We warn everyone to NEVER walk away from your stuff. You would never leave your wallet lying around, you should think the same way with your Pokémon cards.

  71. When will the Pokémon league end?
    This summer though there are already plans for another one after that.

  72. How are they going to keep track of the “points towards Mew”; is there going to be a separate League book for that?
    Nope, there should be a separate sheet for keeping trading.

  73. Do you know if there’s any time limit for earning the 250 points (i.e. eight weeks only)?
    Yes, you have the 6 weeks of the correct season to earn the 250 points.

  74. Does it cost anything to be a league center?
    No, but you must be a store.

  75. Since the players are taking Pokémon more seriously than planned will there be more and larger tournaments in the future?
    If the fan response continues to be high, yes.

  76. I’m from Fort McMurray, Alberta, Canada.we Don’t have a TCG league outlet. Could I still join in Edmonton, Alberta?
    Yes, you can still join there if they have room for you.

  77. Is Dark Charmeleon(from top deck) usable in DCI tournaments? By the way, the Rocket cards pictured in that mag look cool.
    Yes it is.

  78. I’m in the Pokémon league and they guaranteed that each member had a sort of dci ranking, yet I don’t have one. What’s wrong with the poke league?
    What do you mean? If you are not seeing yourself listed on our League Web Pages then your league didn’t send in your DCI sign up cards and you would want to ask them to re submit them.
    Actual DCI rankings are based on points you earn in sanctioned tournaments NOT through League play.

  79. If the Pokémon League has a DCI rating, then do just playing at the Pokémon League count for the rating or does the Pokémon League need to have some kind of tournament?
    No, they are two different things.

  80. Why are all the Pokémon leagues in Canada behind? I got my pre-release Aerodactyl 2 weeks ago!
    They started a few months later.

  81. Reading through transcripts sent to me, I noticed the past two weeks that you have said Wizards has another Pokémon event planed. And I know you are quite infamous for dodging the juicy questions! So all I want to know, is it going to be 12 and under again, or will you be doing it open to all ages or keeping it limited again?
    It will have 3 age groups, allowing all Pokemaniacs a chance to compete.

  82. Are gym leaders allowed to take all the extra promos and sell or trade them off? Because I know someone who does this?
    No, that is breaking the rules. If your league has this happening, please call cust serv at 1-800-324-6496 and report it.

  83. When I went to a mall tour the paper they gave me said you can post strategies on the official Wizards page of Pokémon. How do you post?
    We post strategies, but if you have some, send them in to cust serv.

  84. Regarding Proxies (copied cards): I have been using them for a while…and all of a sudden last week I get hounded for using them. I use black shield deck protectors. So there’s no cheating involved…can I be blamed for wanting to protect my Rare/Holos?
    Well, according to the DCI rules, the league and sanctioned tournaments don’t allow proxies. You still have to play with the cards to use them, sorry.

  85. First, I just want to say that you guys got good timing on releasing the holo mew the day before my b-day. And now to the Q: when I bought the Pokémon movie a few days ago, packaged with the Mewtwo card was a card saying “premier league qualifying events are on their way”. Whats that mean?
    Ah, there are plans for upcoming premier events similar to last year’s Tropical Mega Battle. When plans are finalized we will post the info on them on our web site.

  86. Is the promo Jigglypuff tournament legal, Is the promo #14 Mewtwo tournament legal and is my #10 GB Meowth tournament legal?
    Promo cards are only legal once they are officially released, so the Jigglypuff and the #14 Mewtwo are, the #10 Meowth is not.

  87. When is dark Gyarados coming to league?
    The pre-release Dark Gyrados will be in League stores starting April 22nd.

  88. What is the purpose of TM’s in the Pokémon league?
    Technical Machine stickers are something for league members to earn if they have already earned their badge for that current season.

  89. What happened to the contest for base set 2 and how down I get a winners list?
    Send us an email at custserv@wizards.com and we can send you a copy of the winner’s list.

  90. Will there be a Pokémon Trainer Showdown Battle (or something like that.) this summer?
    Yes, there are plans for a premiere event this summer. When we have details on it, it will be posted on our web site.

  91. The Pokémon League has a new activity called “Brock’s Challenge” where you get a special sticker if you get ten “victory points”. First question: is that 2pts.
    For win & 1 pt. for lose or ten distinct wins total? 2 points for a win, 1 point for a loss.

  92. What is the deal with the Brock and Misty Challenge in the League?
    They are just extra actives (like the TM stickers) for members to do once they’ve earned their badges.

  93. “Brock’s Challenge” rules state that you must play with “at least 5 Level 2 evolutions in your deck”, but what is considered a “Level 2 evolution”? Using the Gastly family as an example is Haunter considered Lvl 2 or is it Gengar?
    They mean Stage 2 cards, not level 2. So in this case it would be Gengar.

  94. What season (badge) is League supposed 2 be on?
    I think it’s the Soul Badge.

  95. Is it possible to get two badges in a season?
    Only if you are a new member and you are catching up.

  96. Are there any awards or “prizes” given away for completing the “Brock’s Challenge” and “Misty’s Challenge”?
    The cool shiny Brock and Misty stickers! woo hoo.

  97. What (if any) are the requirements for the Brock/Misty challenge?
    Once you’ve earned your badge that season, you can go for them.

  98. Is there a way to get the TM’s, after you get all of the badges, but you never got the TM’s.
    No sorry, the TM’s can only be earned in the current season after you win the current season’s badges. If you came in late, you missed out on the earlier TM’s.

  99. Do you have an idea what to do after the eight season ends?
    Seriously, there will be a new league starting soon thereafter.

  100. If you are a new member, can you skip the TM’s and go on for the next badge when you receive a badge before the end of the season, or will you have to wait until the next season?

Pokémon Miscellaneous FAQ

Nothing is set in stone here at Wizards and there are always ongoing discussions about Pokémon and its future. Please feel free to pass along any comments or questions you have to us here at Customer Service at custserv@wizards.com and we will always pass them along for you.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIIONS

  1. Ok, and will you put in Japanese rules soon?
    We don’t have anything to do with the Japanese rules per se.

  2. Do you plan on bringing the gold and silver Pokémon from Japan, into English conversion?
    There are no specific plans as of yet. We are still negotiating with Nintendo about that possibility though.

  3. Does WOTC release print run statistics? If not, why not (You are a publicly held company now?)
    Though we are a publicly held company, we are not obligated to release that sort of information.

  4. I heard that DCI is going to ban the cards Computer Search, SER, and Pro. Oak, is that true?
    There are no plans to ban any cards at this time.

  5. I don’t know if this is Wizards area, but what sets will be available in the Pokémon card game for the Game Boy. I know in the Japanese there is promos and up to Fossil but since we have none of the promos in the game, will you add cards from the Rocket version or any other sets?
    Sorry but that is up to Nintendo.

  6. Are there any plans for wizards to make their own Pokémon cards not from Japan?
    There are no plans at this time to do so.

  7. Some people are saying, with all the cards and added confusion, Pokémon will be like MTG. Any plans to avoid doing this?
    Pokémon is much more basic than Magic, think of Pokémon like Checkers and Magic like Chess (but with many more pieces).

  8. How much does 1st edition worth right now?
    Sorry, but we don’t keep track of card prices; a card is worth whatever you can get for it.

  9. I missed the Pokémon Jr. Adv. chat. When will Pokémon Jr. 2 be released? What licensing problems are you having? When will the more advanced version of Pokémon Adventure (RPG) be released?
    We are still working out schedules and negotiations with Nintendo for the expansions for the Pokémon Jr. Adventure game, so we don’t have specific dates yet, sorry.

  10. Does WotC have the ability under their contract to alter or adjust rules? And are they likely to?
    The answer is yes but we have no plans on doing so, outside of making it easy to understand.

  11. Is there any plan for a Pokémon Duelist style magazine?
    TopDeck has articles on Pokémon every month.

  12. Will anymore CDs be released with promos like Japan with there 10 promos in one CD?
    There are no such plans that I know of.

  13. Where can Pokémon TCG fans make suggestions to Wizards of the Coast?
    Send email to custserv@wizards.com

  14. Do you plan to have a card list like Decipher.com/ use to look at cards for Pokémon TCG?
    We do have card lists on our website already. We are working on an improved list that will be up soon.

  15. Will Pokémon accessories like coins, damage counters and such are sold separately licensed by Wizards of the Coast?
    We will be looking into making other Pokémon accessories available.

  16. Where can I get the Pokémon TopDeck magazine and is it ALL about POKÉMON?
    You can find it at hobby, game and bookstores. It covers a lot of different TCG’s and other games.

  17. When will the Pokémon Strategy guide come out?
    I believe the release date for that is March.

  18. Are planning on having an online Pokémon TCG game like you do with Magic the Gather?
    There are no plans at this time, sorry.

  19. Will the upcoming CD-ROM for Base Set 2 be released separately or only as part of the new Starter sets?
    Our plan for now is only with the starter sets.

  20. In Japan, Media Factory has Professor Ooyamo as the card expert. Who is the card expert for Wizards of the Coast?
    We have a staff of 14 trainers that exist on donuts and Mountain Dew that answer questions.

    Duelist Convocation International.

  48. I understand about it being an entry-level game, but having it taken seriously doesn’t mean that it can’t also stay a casual game. After all, MtG has Starter and Advanced and Expert rules… each one viable in and of them selves. But thanks for the comments anyway.

  49. With regards to Kori and accreditation, etc.: There are always people of varying skill with regards to any given game. With mtg., you aren’t going to see a lot of 8 year olds at PT.
